chapters.title: Chapter 1101: Beg Me To Hurt You
paragraphs: Up in the air, the dragons are spraying flames on each other, their roars of pain causing many to break into visible sweat.
The fact that Kent was able to command two dragons to attack each other is already a clear indication that he is much more monstrous than they gave him credit for.
"Unbelievable... How are we going to win against this?" an elder from the first-ranked Celestial Gate Sect said, her expression dull and filled with defeat...
"Even I cannot do what he is doing, how much more the disciples?"
The concept that a disciple can possess such terrifying powers never crossed their minds. To them, there is always a limit to how much a person can grow.
This is a medium world where everything has a limit. Reaching the Core Formation stage and refining your core is the end. This limit prevents people like Kent from appearing in medium worlds...
However, watching him dominate his opponent tells them what they needed to know...
"This competition is already won by the Supreme Immortal Sect... At this rate, even if they combine all seven sects in the quarterfinals, they wouldn’t be able to defeat him."
"What a monster."
"Just where did they get him from?"
"I was told he came from Sonox. I even heard some reports say this year, the number of talents that came from that washup world is just too staggering."
"Looks like the Supreme Immortal Sect is about to rise."

"That is only natural. I mean, aside from this monster, I saw how the rest of their disciples handled their battles. It was like they had seen danger and lived to tell the tale. Their expressions during the battles said it all."
Although Kent will be ascending, he plans to make the sect a powerhouse in the medium worlds. Kent knew he couldn’t go to every last medium world and become its guardian.
That is impossible.

So, he plans to become the guardian of the sect, Sonox, and the Celestial Ascendence Planetary Alliance. Then, using the sect and Sonox as his base, he will leave them powerful treasures and will keep sending them more, since he can come to any medium world he has been to through his tower.
This is to ensure that, even after thousands of years, powerhouses will continue to rise from his protected worlds.
Kent has both a long-term and short-term plan.
The short-term plan is to make the entire Alliance his Soul Essence farm. By making the alliance head his subordinate, all 54 planets in the alliance will become his.
This number will, of course, expand as more worlds join them. His ultimate plan for this short-term plan was to change the planetary alliance (system) into a star system.
As for his long-term plan, he learned it from Vexthra.

He isn’t aiming to reap the benefits now. His aim is to reach godhood and reap his benefits. The power of faith, as Vexthra calls it, is one way to strengthen one’s divinity and make one a powerhouse.
Kent knew his Soul Universe was the path for him to become the strongest there is, so his divinity would be linked to how many worlds he would become a guardian to.
So far, he is getting close to having so much Soul Essence that when he started throwing asteroids at people, he wouldn’t feel the loss.

So he has ambitions, and, as it happens, dominating the Primal Beast Sect is a way to achieve them. Today’s battle will become something to be told for years to come, and Kent is ensuring that everyone understands this.
"Octopuses cringe me up, so why don’t you go let the Manta Rayfolk over there electrocute you?" Kent used his mind manipulation on yet another two beasts.
Soon, he is only under the assault of three beasts—well, one of them has lost a limb, so only two and a half, and soon, it is about to be only two.
Kent evaded an attack from the seahorse and blocked a demi-shark’s attack. Then, stomping on the ground, the two beasts were blasted away, allowing Kent to move and stop before the crab...
"I don’t eat crabs, so know that this torture is merely a way for me to feel good about myself, and wipe away past humiliations. No hard feelings."
"AAaaarrrrgggghhHHH!"
The crab let out another scream as Kent yanked off yet another limb. But he didn’t stop there; he grabbed yet another one and pulled it off before teleporting away.
The seahorse and the shark were upon him, causing Kent to grin and use his mind manipulation ability again...
"You found this shark on top of your woman... As a loving husband, what will you do to him?" The seahorse, which was in the middle of an attack, halted, then turned sharply and glared at the shark.
The poor guy froze. However, Kent had no intention of making him feel relieved.

He placed his hand on the seahorse’s shoulder, almost like they were the best of friends, and whispered into his ear like a witch... "He didn’t even use a condom... can you imagine how that felt for him... and your woman?"
The Seahorse had no idea what a condom was, but he was triggered nonetheless, resulting in a quick and decisive lunge, one that took the shark by surprise.
The two engaged in fierce combat, one that allowed Kent to grin and move to the crab...
"Now that you have three limbs left, how about I take two and let you have one? They will grow back, but in order not to make me an evil person, I cannot in good conscience take all six legs."
Everyone who heard him paled...
Even taking three legs in Kent’s eyes was mercy. To them, that is the most evil thing a person can ever say to their fellow living being.
"Please, I am begging you, don’t hurt me anymore," the crab said, making Kent grin.
"No, no, no, no... We cannot have that. You losers planned to hurt my sect in ways nobody saw coming, so don’t beg me. Instead, beg me to hurt you."
With tears in the crab’s eyes and a smile that didn’t reach his eyes, he spoke... "Please, I want you to hurt me more. I deserve it."
"That is better."
Soon, two more screams came from the crab, who had no idea that the only reason Kent targeted him was that one of Kent’s bullies back on Earth was nicknamed Crab.
The man had a crab tattoo drawn on his back and claimed he was a "crab king."
Kent suffered so many humiliations and beatings from him to the point that he had to hide from him for a whole year just so he could have some semblance of peace.
So if he can’t have his revenge on him, he might as well channel all that hatred to the Crabfolk.

This crab won’t be the last beast to suffer under Kent’s torture. Every other crab out there will one day feel his wrath simply because of a trauma from his past life on Earth, which had followed him to this world.
An hour later, all seven beasts are severely injured, so Kent decided to free them.
"We-we surrender," the seahorse said, looking at Kent with eyes filled with fear and anger.
"That was satisfying," Kent exhaled, his mood brightening up a bit. Every last spectator turned pale.
’Looks like he is finally recovering from his time in the Paragon Universe,’ Vexthra said, and her sisters nodded with a smile... Lady Enzi included.𝕗𝚛𝚎𝚎𝐰𝗲𝗯𝗻𝚘𝚟𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝕞

chapters.title: Chapter 1102: Lord Munny
paragraphs: "You really traumatized them, Kent," Elaine said, walking toward Kent after the battle ended and he was declared the winner.
"They can only blame themselves for having shitty parents."

Because the Ancient Sea Race attacked Sonox, Kent showed them no mercy. If it were up to him, all of them should just die. However, he needed them to protect Sonox, so making sure they understood their place was only to be expected.
Of course, the crab was unlucky. He happened to bear the name of someone who bullied Kent when he was weak. So it was only his bad luck to be a crab.
Elaine only smiled and hugged him, using her healing spell on him. Kent was in no way hurt or drained. However, Elaine just wanted to make sure he was fine.
"Big brother, you were amazing." Of course, Nyss was overly excited to see Kent in action. "Are we still on about hunting them all down and slaughtering them?"

The faces of everyone who heard her broke into a smile, knowing that if care was not taken and Nyss managed to pull Kent into her evil desire to slaughter the Primal Beast Sect, the massacre would be very gory.
"We should let them go for now. However, we will keep a close eye on them. If they dare make any stupid move, we will be sure to wipe them out."

Nyss nodded and turned to the Primal Beast Sect disciples. She pointed her dagger at them and said, "Wipe your necks and wait for us. One day, when you least expect it, we will appear and send you packing."
Nyss laughed, and then she turned around and began to follow Kent and the rest of the disciples from the Supreme Immortal Sect. The match was over and they had won, so they could only leave.
Lord Munny is the Alliance Head. He achieved Core Formation 65,000 years ago. Naturally, if he were to base his existence on his lifespan, he would have long died.
A core formation cultivator can only live up to 15,000 years.
However, once one breaks a limit, their lifespan doubles, and Lord Munny had broken 14 limits.

In the entire Celestial Ascendence Planetary Alliance, he was the strongest. Many knew this, and they respected him for that. However, even someone as powerful as him had never met someone like Kent before.
From the start of the battle, he had seen something many hadn’t.
He saw someone so powerful he couldn’t even bring himself to measure his strength. Basically, he just couldn’t handle what he had seen.
Kent was powerful. There was no doubt about that. His presence was commanding when in battle, and after his trip to the past, he had become even more powerful.
However, for a being who was already at the peak of the Core Formation stage, the idea that even his strength couldn’t be quantified was already too much for anyone to handle.

Kent formed his Blood Core Gate and further absorbed a significant amount of Blood Essence back when he was in hell. This alone had taken his strength far beyond that of a normal Core Formation warrior.
Then, if that wasn’t enough, he had formed his Flame Core using a Supreme Grade Primordial Flame as the source energy.
But even with that, he went ahead and fully cultivated the first form of the [Primal Bone Tempering Art], making him awaken the Blood Runes that would fuel his strength for generations to come.
His strength, the speed, and just the aura around him told Lord Munny all he had to know.
Watching Kent walk away with his people, he knew what he had to do.

So in the evening, he secretly left his mansion and headed over to where the Supreme Immortal Sect was staying. He had to go there because meeting Kent and having a talk with him was the only way he could finally rest.
If only he knew his eagerness to see Kent was all his, but also amplified by Kent, who wanted to get things done much faster before he ascended.𝕗𝐫𝚎𝗲𝘄𝐞𝕓𝐧𝕠𝘃𝕖𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝚖
He had a very important mission he would embark on once he ascended, so finishing up here quickly would be both beneficial and delightful.
"You really shouldn’t be sneaking around, Lord Munny. People may mistake you for a stalker." Just when Lord Munny was about to take a corner, a voice spoke from behind him.
He stopped and sharply turned, meeting Kent’s gaze.
Kent waved his hand, and the next second, they were standing atop a small mountain overlooking the lit city bustling with life.
This was a cultivation world, so naturally, sleep was not something people did very often. So life was buzzing like crazy.
"I am a simple man, Lord Munny, so I will get straight to the point," Kent said, his tone turning serious. "How can I help you?"

Lord Munny, who had indeed come for help, sighed, and then, despite his position as the Alliance Leader, he bowed slightly and said, "I would like your guidance on how I can transcend beyond my current limit."
Kent expected nothing less.
Someone as important as Lord Munny wouldn’t drop everything and start following him just because he wants to become strong. He needed help, but he also had a reputation to uphold.

If he were to be heard following a brat like Kent around, many would laugh at him. So, as the face of the Alliance, he could only raise his shoulder a little and ask for what he wanted without sounding or looking too desperate.
"I understand," Kent said, his expression calm.
"To tell you the truth, I planned to come see you even before you did."
Lord Munny raised his brow at Kent’s words. He had never expected to hear that; however, once he did, he could only wonder why someone like Kent would seek him out.
Kent didn’t make him wait long.
"The reason I want to come see you is to discuss ways I can help this alliance grow into becoming a Star system.
I am already aware of the power dynamics in this Alliance and know that an ancient ruin is set to open in the next 100 years, which you would want to explore.
My aim this time is to ensure this alliance gets the most out of it. So, I plan to make you someone akin to my subordinate who would take care of that for me.
Of course, I will help you grow far beyond your current level. In fact, I plan to make you and others so powerful that surviving in a supreme High world will be possible.
However, it will come at a cost, and that cost is something only you can pay. All you have to do is become my subordinate."
"Become your subordinate?" Lord Munny asked with a calm expression.
"Yes."
"Just that?" he asked again, and Kent nodded with a smile.
"Deal."
Of course, Kent expected this answer. So the moment he heard it, he retrieved two pills from his space ring and handed them to him.
"The competition will end in two days. Use this time to see for yourself what I am capable of. Once you understand, see me here again in two days, and I will officially make you my subordinate."
"Try to play smart with me, and you wouldn’t know how you died..." Kent grinned, and Lord Munny shuddered. He was about to say something, but Kent vanished from sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 1103: Time With Vexthra
paragraphs: "How did it go?" Vexthra asked the moment Kent returned to the hotel after his brief meeting with Lord Munny.
"It went well. I gave him a Limit Breaker Pill and an Innate Talent Awakening Pill. In two days’ time, I will get my answer, and well, everything else will follow."

Vexthra nodded. Learning of Kent’s plan to build this medium-world planetary alliance into a star system was something she liked. The quicker Kent started making moves to secure people who would believe and have faith in him, the better.

Someone like Kent would not take the normal route to become a god, like she did, so the best move now was to secure people. One day, when he reached the stage of becoming a god, the process would be less difficult.

"That is a good start," Vexthra said. Then she added, "By making this planetary system powerful, they can swallow other planetary systems and become a star system. Of course, if things are planned well, one day they can even become a pseudo-galaxy system or even a galaxy system.
If that were to happen, then you will not only become someone powerful, but you will be able to reach the level of supreme much faster and even be able to make it to the Celestial stage."
"That is the plan, love. However, using faith power is not the only path I want to walk. Soon, I will become the strongest Immortal, God, Supreme, and Celestial there is."
Kent smiled, knowing full well the journey would be hard. However, one day, he knew his dream would be realized.
Vexthra smiled. She is spending the night with Kent, since her sisters wanted to attend a celebration in the city.
Kent offered that they could watch through the Soul Map, but they said they would go in person, citing that it is always more fun to see things in person.
Vexthra, who knew her sisters just wanted to let her spend the night with Kent, was grateful, so she planned to make the best of it.
"We should enter the tower, where we will have more time. I’d love to hear about your past experiences. Of course, we can start with a round or two."
Kent smiled and grabbed her by the waist, lifting her into his arms. Then, lowering his hand, he grabbed her ass, and soon they vanished into the tower.
Standing 30 meters away, Lady Liora saw this and sighed... ’Looks like I should be careful around him.’
She didn’t even want to consider the fact that her best friend had fallen under Kent’s charm and now had joined the league of shameless women.
Lady Enzi told her that she had taken the next step and was happy she did. She even suggested that she also make her move quickly, or else she would miss out on a lot.
However, the assassin beauty had more self-control than Lady Enzi, so she kept her emotions in check.
For now, at least, she wanted to observe from the side. And as an assassin, she was good at sneaking around.
If only she knew the dragon had already marked her, and no matter what she tried, his claws would sink into her...

Inside the tower, Kent ripped Vexthra’s clothes off and was already thrusting like crazy. It had been a long time since they had sex, so now that he had some time on his hands, making sure she sweated was the only path forward.
He will make sure all his wives are satisfied.
Selene had her time, then Enzi had her turn. Now, it is Vexthra’s turn, and so the dragon wanted nothing more than to make sure she was also satisfied.
Selene had even designed a solid plan.
She suggested that whenever it is time to spend time with Kent, they all should leave the tower and stay in whatever world they ascended to, since time runs rather slowly there.
Every two hours, one of them would enter the tower, where they would spend two days with Kent before rotating to the next lady.
Of course, this plan would take effect when they ascended, citing that their family would only grow larger.

So, to ensure none of them had to stay for several hours before getting a chance to spend time with their partner, spending two hours on the outside and finally spending two days alone with their partner was much more efficient.

chapters.title: Chapter 1106: Artemielle, The Love-Bound Huntress (1)
paragraphs: The story began during the Primordial Era when a Huntress fell in love with an emotionless Dragon, and despite family and friends warning her not to venture into said territory, she refused to listen, which ultimately led to her death in the most tragic way possible.
Artemis was the crown princess of the Shades family, a family of assassins and hunters. She was born a Huntress, for in her blood, she was destined to become one.
Her life was perfect.
She had loving parents, supportive siblings, and trusted relatives who would do anything to see each other happy. Artemis had it all: riches, support, and peace.
However, as a Shade, she was supposed to walk in the trade of the family—she was supposed to become a Huntress like her mother, her grandmother, and her great-grandmother.
So from a young age, she began her training.
She was brilliant and hardworking.
Her handling of the bow began to show when she was just six, and by the time she turned 16, she started joining the League of Shades on dangerous missions.
By the time she turned 30, her name had spread far and wide, earning her the titles Eye of the Eagle and Goddess of the Hunt.

She never missed her target, and no matter how staggering the odds were, she would always find a way to land her shot. Because of this, she became famous, and among the Shades, she was known as the Child of the Wild.
Artemis had done it. She became a True Shade, something that separated her from the ordinary folk.
However, one’s destiny cannot always be what it was written to be. There are those whose destiny is to mess with the destiny of others.
Artemis’s own came in the form of a Dragon.
One day, a mission was handed to the Shades family, a mission that tested the reputation of the Shades family. This mission was one that even the best of the Shades never saw coming.
However, they took it, and on this mission, Artemis was picked to join the hunt.

The mission was to kill a known Forsaken King, a being whose existence was not tolerated by anyone. If the Shades managed to complete this mission, their reputation would take a big leap, so they were determined to kill this Forsaken King.
However, when they came face to face with the Forsaken King, it turned out it was Kings, not a single King—ten of them to be precise.𝐟𝕣𝕖𝐞𝐰𝕖𝚋𝐧𝗼𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝗰𝐨𝐦
It turned out they had been set up by their rivals. Their plan was to kill the best of the Shades and swallow the rest.
And their plan was perfect. Five people going against ten terrifying powerhouses was a guaranteed mission failure, which would, without a shred of doubt, lead to the death of Artemis and her family.
However, just when they were in a bind, a vengeful Dragon appeared, and in under one minute, beings that even True Immortals would despair against were slaughtered.
The mission that guaranteed the death of Artemis and her family turned out to be a fateful encounter with the one who would be known across the universe as the Primordial Chaos Dragon.
This encounter also changed Artemis’s destiny. She was meant to rise and one day become the Goddess of the Hunt. She was meant to transcend and reach the peak.
However, meeting the Chaos Dragon, who was on a mission to kill all Forsaken beings and their allies, changed that.
Her destiny was changed, and so she became drawn into the world of the Chaos Dragon.
She left home despite her family and friends’ warnings and started following him.
For thousands of years, she followed him, tried to get close to him, and even risked her life just to be noticed by him.
However, the Chaos Dragon, who lost his heart and his one true love, had no room for another woman; thus, he maintained his distance.
One day, when the Chaos Dragon was in seclusion and was at a critical junction in his cultivation, the Forsaken race attacked.
They planned well, and so they came in full force.
Artemis, the Shadow Stalker, as Chaos called her, stepped in and fought for three days. She defended the Chaos Dragon, who had no idea he was under attack, for his soul was never in his body.
His training took his soul out of his body, so even if the enemy destroyed his body, he would have just built a new one.
However, because he didn’t know, Artemis fought, and on the third day, she fell defending someone she loved, but who never even trusted her.
She died defending someone who had no place in his heart for her.
She died without even having the chance to say goodbye.
Her death was tragic and sad. However, to her, she knew she died trying to protect the one she loved...

Because of this belief, because of her actions, the universe decided to give her a different life—a life she would get to live, a happy and fulfilling life, one she had never had the chance to experience before.
Thus, the Goddess of Love and Art, Selphina, was born.
Destiny is indeed a bitch, as they say.
Selphina was born a goddess, a being who transcended mortality and gained divinity. She was blessed with beauty, intelligence, and joy.
She had everything.
But as the Goddess of Love and Art, she had the power to paint beautiful love stories for those worthy of happy endings.
Those who had given their all, yet destiny had no plans to grant them happy endings, she changed it, painting them happy endings.
Because of the love in her heart, she took her role very seriously. She brought so much love and joy to the lives of billions.
However, destiny never bends, and so even as a goddess, her own destiny soon caught up to her in the form of a handsome young Spearman—the one destined to save the Void Era.
This young man was born ordinary but was meant for greatness. His destiny was to one day rise and battle the Void Beasts.
Nobody knew him, but soon, he was known all over the universe as the Blood Spear King. His legend spread far and wide.
During the Void Wars, the Blood Spear King fought with his significant other, the Blood Zither Princess.

According to destiny, the Blood Spear King would save the universe, but at the cost of his love. He would save everything he and her lover sought to achieve, but in the end, she would never get to enjoy it with him.

It was a tragic love story, one that moved the Goddess of Love and Art to tears. In her eyes, the one who stood against the destiny of the universe and fought to save it could not lose what he was fighting for.
So she chose to write a new ending for them.
However, going against destiny many times came at a cost, one that could not be paid easily.
To change one’s destiny, one must give up one’s destiny, and so the Goddess of Love and Art again chose to give her own life to someone who never even knew she existed.
She wrote the Blood Spear King, the reincarnation of the Chaos Dragon, a happy ending—the same dragon that was the cause of her death in her first life.
Destiny played ball with her a second time...
But can she play the same ball a third time...

paragraphs: Kent lifted his eyes, watching Unity hover in the air, and a wave of sadness filled his heart.
He had no idea where this sadness was coming from; however, at the moment, as he looked at Unity, his heart started to break.
Soon, Kent couldn’t hold it in anymore and started shedding tears.
In his eyes, he could see someone who had given everything she had but got nothing in return. Kent didn’t know why, but he felt a sense of guilt.

He had no idea that in his past life, he had failed Artemis. He could have at least tried to be her friend, or even better, a teammate, for they had fought many battles together. However, he was none of that.
And yet again, just when he seemed to realize that, she was taken away from him by the same forsaken race that took his one true love from him.
His nonchalance and complex destiny took away her chance to live a happy and fulfilling life.
But as if that was not enough, she again gave her life just so his incarnation could have a happy ending, one she deemed necessary for someone who fought for the lives of the innocent and weak.
Now, without him even knowing it, those guilts he felt back when he was Chaos and those he never knew he contributed to during the Void Era all started coming back to him.
Soon, the entire atmosphere changed, and Unity, who had been up in the air, was enveloped in a white cloud. Kent remained on the ground, wallowing in his unknown guilt.
However, as time slowly passed, he started to gather his thoughts and regain his composure.
Soon, he regained his calm self, and so he decided to get on with what all this was for...

Unity required a special type of awakening token compared to what her sisters needed. Naturally, Kent had been working around the clock to get her one. However, he had to leave and spend some time in the past.
While he was gone, his wives and legion challenged the 4th level of the Planet Killer Dungeon and cleared it. One of the rewards for completing the mission was the Destiny Awakening Token.
This token was now what Kent was using to awaken her true name.
As he gazed at her enveloped in the sea of clouds, he could only sigh...
"Cheated by destiny. Stripped of her will to live a fulfilling life...
Destiny hated her, but she was filled with love and compassion. Her love was eternal, even if she never received love in return. Her caring was genuine, even if she wasn’t shown the same care.
Her nature was to make others happy, yet happiness was but a fleeting memory to her. Thus, she lived for others when she should have lived for herself."
Kent sighed deeply, the words he was speaking slowly stirring the guilt in his heart...

"Life is beautiful with her in it. Her love, compassion, and care were what made life worth living. Life had cheated her, but now, with the third chance at life, what had been stolen from her shall be returned.
"Arise, Artemielle, rise and claim your life, for destiny owes you. Arise, Artemielle, The Love-Bound Huntress."

The moment Kent invoked her true name, six pairs of feathered, bluish-white wings burst out from the sea of clouds. Then, from the heavens, a powerful divine energy descended, sending Kent to his knees.
From the clouds, Unity appeared, radiating the aura of a goddess.
Before awakening her true name, Unity was a beauty; however, the one looking down at Kent with a smile on her lips was on another level.
If she went out without a veil, no man would be able to resist her charm.
Vexthra is beautiful, but Unity is charming and elegant. The aura, air, and everything about her is on a different level of elegance.

Her smooth skin, deep blue hair that cascaded down her back, her soft, cherry lips, big blue eyes, beautiful, round breasts, and refined body, along with the bluish-white wings behind her, made her otherworldly.
Kent remained on his knees, unable to move. It was as if he were being punished for the role he played in stripping Unity of her own happy ending in her first and second lives.
Suddenly, a Destiny memory key came out of Kent’s body, flew through the air, and entered Unity’s forehead...
The moment the memory key entered her forehead, the energy bearing down on Kent increased, and he was completely crushed to the ground.
Unable to bear it, he passed out.
It takes a lot to make Kent lose his consciousness with a mere aura. So, whatever aura surrounds Unity, it is both hers and not hers.
It is like how Val can take on her goddess form for a limited time.
After 30 minutes, Unity opened her eyes, and when she saw Kent lying passed out on the ground, she flapped her wings and appeared before him in an instant.
"He is fine." Before she could panic, Gaia’s voice entered her ears. She nodded and then focused her attention on checking if he was hurt in other places.
After making sure he was not hurt in any way, she wiped the tear marks from his eyes. "I will take him to rest. Inform my sisters that he cannot participate in the next match."
Gaia nodded and vanished.
The plan was to spend some time and then awaken her true name before going for the semi-finals against the 4th-ranked Blade Soul Sect.
However, they spent too much time having sex that when it was left with just a couple of minutes on the outside before daybreak, they stopped and decided to awaken Unity’s true name.
Now, however, he had passed out, and there was no telling when he would wake up.
But even if he were to wake up before the match started, Unity knew there was a lot to talk about.
She had recovered enough of her memories as Artemis to know why Kent was crying. So she wanted to spend some time making sure he was alright before going out...

On the outside, Gaia delivered the message, which came as a surprise, but one that everyone welcomed. Kent joining the competition was already too much. He was way stronger than they were, so he was basically bullying them.
However, with him off the battle lineup, it would be much more intense.
Naturally, Lady Enzi anticipated this happening, so she had already made plans to win without Kent’s help.
All five seeded disciples would fight. Nyss and Princess Elowen were also added to the match lineup. They planned to use the seeded disciples to win the individual battles.
That was the only way for them to win. If they managed to defeat them in individual battles, they would be able to crush them again in the team battles.

"Too bad Big Brother wouldn’t be joining us for this battle. If he were here, crushing these bastards who look down on women would be as easy as lifting a pinky," Nyss said with a chuckle, looking at their opponents.

Lady Enzi smiled and responded to her bold words, "Imagine how happy he will be if you manage to win this match for him."
Nyss smiled and lifted her shoulders high, saying, "Fear not, Lady Enzi, I got this."

After making sure he was not hurt in any way, she wiped the tear marks from his eyes.
"I will take him to rest.
Inform my sisters that he cannot participate in the next match."
Gaia nodded and vanished.
The plan was to spend some time and then awaken her true name before going for the semi-finals against the 4th-ranked Blade Soul Sect.
However, they spent too much time having sex that when it was left with just a couple of minutes on the outside before daybreak, they stopped and decided to awaken Unity’s true name.
Now, however, he had passed out, and there was no telling when he would wake up.
But even if he were to wake up before the match started, Unity knew there was a lot to talk about.
She had recovered enough of her memories as Artemis to know why Kent was crying.
So she wanted to spend some time making sure he was alright before going out...
On the outside, Gaia delivered the message, which came as a surprise, but one that everyone welcomed.
Kent joining the competition was already too much.
He was way stronger than they were, so he was basically bullying them.
However, with him off the battle lineup, it would be much more intense.
Naturally, Lady Enzi anticipated this happening, so she had already made plans to win without Kent’s help.
All five seeded disciples would fight.
Nyss and Princess Elowen were also added to the match lineup.
They planned to use the seeded disciples to win the individual battles.
That was the only way for them to win.
If they managed to defeat them in individual battles, they would be able to crush them again in the team battles.
"Too bad Big Brother wouldn’t be joining us for this battle.
If he were here, crushing these bastards who look down on women would be as easy as lifting a pinky," Nyss said with a chuckle, looking at their opponents.
She was the type of person who would use the strength of others to brag.
If she were to follow Kent, she would continually create problems for him.
Perhaps, because of these characteristics of hers, Val, who was also another troublemaker, hung out with her a lot.
As they say, birds of the same feathers flock together.
Lady Enzi smiled and responded to her bold words, "Imagine how happy he will be if you manage to win this match for him."
Nyss smiled and lifted her shoulders high, saying, "Fear not, Lady Enzi, I got this."

chapters.title: Chapter 1108: Hateful Opponents
paragraphs: The Supreme Immortal Sect and the Blade Soul Sect are all vying to reach the final, where they will either face the 1st-ranked Celestial Gate Sect or the 5th-ranked Everlasting Dawn Life Sect.
This is the semi-finals, so everyone wants to have a shot at winning.
A decade ago, they faced the Primal Beast Sect in the semi-finals and lost. But this time, they will be facing the Blade Soul Sect, which specializes in soul arts using weapons as the medium.
They are in no way to be underestimated.
Those who practice soul arts are dangerous, and Lady Enzi knew that, so she planned well for it.

"Remember, we just have to win three matches with minimal effort so they can call for a team battle. Winning three matches will mean they will either bring their big guns into the team battle or use them in the individual match.
Either way, one or two seeded disciples will fight, and defeating them will give them a clear picture of what we are capable of. So the individual battles are the priority now."
Lady Enzi merely wants to crush the enemy’s resolve before the battle even begins. She knew they would ask for a team battle if they were defeated three in a row, so she planned for that.
If they send three seeded disciples and they all lose, meeting in the team battles will give the Supreme Immortal Sect a good idea of what they should expect.
However, sometimes, things just don’t work out the way one expects them to...

"The Blade Soul Sect has opted for a team battle. They want to drop the individual battles altogether," the elder who would be overseeing the battle between the two sects said, and Lady Enzi’s expression changed.
"Change of plans, everyone: the enemy has a trump card, and so they plan to use it. This means we are in trouble."

Lady Enzi has attended many Interplanetary Sect competitions, so she is already familiar with how things work. The moment the opponent requests a team battle right from the start, it means they have a way to eliminate the majority of their opponents’ disciples, thereby allowing them an easy win.
Obviously, that is detrimental to the Supreme Immortal Sect.
Their formation has been altered, and so they can only play the opponent’s game.

"Just go all out if need be. Also, implement Plan B if necessary." The only way out is if they manage to end the battle much more quickly. If they allow the enemy too much time, they will become difficult to deal with.
The disciples nodded and entered the Arena.
"Looks like your trump card is not here, huh?" one of the disciples from the Blade Soul Sect said, his expression mocking.

The Blade Soul Sect only accepts male disciples, citing that they are focused on masculine energy. This made them hated by most females, so when their faces turned into grins, the ladies in the Supreme Immortal Sect became pissed.
Especially Nyss, who wanted nothing more than to wipe that smirk off their faces...
"Relax, Nyss, go with the plan, and you will have the chance to beat the crap out of them," Vanna, the Pill Princess, said.
"Okay, big sister Vanna." Nyss calms down a bit, but she is still pissed.
"Looks like this will be too easy, boys," the captain of the Blade Soul Sect said, and his teammates nodded.
Kent is the only one they are afraid of. Since he isn’t participating, they are confident in their win.
"Remember, once we take them out, the last one should be toyed with till they start crying," he spoke again, and the others nodded.
"I call dibs on the blue-haired Ice beauty. She looks like a good sport."
The Ice Maiden, who chose to keep her cool, looked at the bastard who was pointing at her, and her eyes changed color.
"Wow, chill girl, this is not the kitchen where you belong, so no need to look constipated."
"I know, right? With those slender fingers, having an apron on and cooking for her husband is the only way she will be useful."
"I know you have insight, Shaw. You are much more brilliant than I gave you credit for."
Shaw, one of the seeded disciples from the Blade Soul Sect, grinned. He held a scythe, and a streak of tattoos moved along his neck, giving him a dangerous yet unlikable look.
"You know me, Brian, when it comes to the woman’s role in the universe, I never disappoint," Shaw said.
"That you never did, and I like you for that. As a gift, I will give you the feisty one. I learned she is both feisty in bed and in the kitchen."
The other Blade Soul Sect disciples laughed, causing the Supreme Immortal Sect disciples to frown.

At the audience stand, Val saw this, and a frown appeared on her face. "This is bad. Although I am all about getting under your opponent’s skin before the start of the battle, these bastards are taking it too far."
"Yes. What a bunch of losers." Lani frowned too, and her hand reached toward her dagger. She wanted nothing more than to sever their heads before they continued to look down on women.
Although the insults aren’t directed at her, she is also a woman and has been where these disciples were, so she is pissed, and her sisters aren’t doing any better...
Even Vexthra had a frown on her face.
However, unlike her sisters, she didn’t have any plans to kill them. In fact, she was taken aback by something that her sisters had missed.
"Relax, everyone. I believe these male bastards are cooked," Vexthra said with a small smile, causing her sisters to wonder why she had a smile while she should be seething in anger like them.
Vexthra knew what they were thinking, so she pointed toward Princess Elowen. "You ladies can’t see because Princess Elowen is blocking a part of the battlefield with her glass element.
Aside from Nyss, the Ice Maiden, and the four male disciples, the expressions on Princess Elowen and Vanna’s faces are all fake.
She is merely reflecting a false image to everyone. This means she has a plan, and if she is anything like her master, then I have no doubt this battle will end much faster and more brutally."

The ladies didn’t know something like that was happening. They only heard the profane words of the Blade Soul Sect disciples, and they got riled up. But Vexthra, whose mental capacity is much stronger, saw through them.
Now, she also became curious as to why the two princesses chose to hide their genuine expressions...
"Start this battle already because this suspense is killing me." Vexthra sighed and decided to watch a good battle.
Soon, the elder officiating the battle had had enough, so he decided to start the battle.

"Remember, there is a no-killing policy, so be mindful of your attacks. Those who violate this rule will be banned for life, and the sect they represent will be disqualified from participating in future competitions for the next 36 years."
Both sides nodded.
"Begin!"
The moment the match began, the Blade Soul Sect brought out a skull and started channeling their soul energy into it. Everyone frowned, some turning pale.
"No way..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1109: Shameless Sect
paragraphs: A faint light began to flicker from the skull as eerie whispers echoed through the arena. The air turned heavy, and even the spectators felt the shift in energy. A cold, suffocating aura spread, making weaker disciples shiver.
"That’s... the Soul Devourer Ritual!" one of the Supreme Immortal Sect elders from the stands exclaimed, his voice trembling. "They’re insane! That ritual is forbidden in inter-sect competitions!"

Lady Enzi shook her head. "That is not exactly true. While the Soul Devourer Ritual is dangerous, it is only forbidden if the Devil Skull they are using is Tier 8 and above. This one is Tier 7, so it is within the grey area."
The elders and disciples watching the match frowned, knowing this was not something to be taken lightly.
The Soul Devourer Ritual is a technique used with the signature treasure of the Blade Soul Sect—the Devil Skull.
This skull is from a real human, but it has been refined over the course of seven thousand years by the best of the Blade Soul Sect into a treasure worthy of fear.
When used, it devours the user’s soul energy and then releases a howling sound, one that shakes both the heart and soul.

Those with weaker souls will receive soul injuries and pass out, or even worse, die. Those with stronger souls will be struck by a powerful soul attack that can disorient them for a couple of seconds.
Of course, depending on how much soul energy is devoured by the Devil Skull, the more devastating the attack will be.
So, to think these people are using one right off the bat.
"I am all about the Blade Soul Sect winning, but this is too much. Just look at the Supreme Immortal Sect disciples; they are being suppressed."
Even Princess Elowen was taken aback by the sudden treasure being used by the Blade Soul Sect.
"Yurei, Raizel, Xhan, Zeyrion, and Nyss, buy us some time," Vanna said, and five of her teammates made their move.
However, just when they moved, Zeev, the captain of the Blade Soul Sect, stepped forward and waved his hand, bringing out a soul flag.
He waved it, and seven soul spirits, each at the Core Formation Stage, appeared and attacked the five.
"Hahahahahaha!" Zeev laughed, watching as the advance made by the Supreme Immortal Sect was stopped by him.

"You really think we will let you destroy our plan? Just relax and wait for your doom." After saying that, he extended his hand toward the Devil Skull and continued channeling his soul energy into it.
Nyss brought out two short swords and started moving through the shadows, aiming to both evade and attack the soul spirits.
However, as spirits, attacking them head-on was just a bad idea.
Xhan, the Venom King, had already begun using his poison art against the soul spirits.
As for Raizel, the One-Eyed Demon Spawn who was also skilled in Soul Art, he was having a much easier time with the soul spirits.
Meanwhile, Yurei, the Ice Maiden, and Zeyrion, the Arrogant Crystal Dragon Prince, weren’t having an easy time.
Their ice and crystal affinities weren’t helping them fight against the soul spirits, so they resorted to using the same old brute method.
The skull glowed brighter, and the whispers became louder. The ground began to tremble as the Devil Skull fed on more soul energy from the seven Blade Soul Sect disciples.

A wave of howling sound rolled through the arena, forcing the weaker disciples to cover their ears. Even though the sound is being masked by the barrier surrounding the arena, those outside can hear the sound.
Nyss dashed through the shadows, slicing through one of the soul spirits. Her blades passed right through, leaving no mark.
The spirit roared with a furious growl, sending a shockwave that threw her back.
She landed on her feet and gritted her teeth.
"Damn it... physical attacks won’t work," she muttered.
Her brother, Xhan, poisoned the air, forming a green mist. It swirled, causing the very ground to begin melting.
Although he is no soul cultivator, his poison can, in a way, affect the soul. As the mist spread, it suddenly touched one of the soul spirits, and it screamed as its form began to fade.
But before it vanished, another spirit rushed at Xhan, slamming him to the ground.
However, while on the ground, he didn’t let the soul spirits get close. Using the poison mist in the air, he moved away and regained his stance before moving into battle again.
Raizel’s single eye glowed a deep red, filled with an overwhelming amount of soul energy.
"Soul Pierce!" he shouted.
A beam of energy shot from his eye and struck two spirits, blasting holes through their chests. The spirits wailed and vanished into black smoke.
However, killing two Core Formation soul spirits drained more than he expected, causing his face to pale.
Yurei raised her hands, freezing the ground beneath her.
"Frozen Seal!" she cried, her chilling voice freezing the hearts of many. If this were a normal battle, she would have been a menace to her opponents thanks to her overwhelming ice energy.
However, this was a soul battle where she was both outnumbered and outclassed.
Ice spikes shot up, slowing two spirits, but they shattered the ice and rushed forward again. Zeyrion jumped in front of her, his arms glowing with crystal light.
"Crystal Wall!" he shouted. A massive wall of crystal rose to block the attack. The spirits hit it, and cracks spread across its surface.
Zeev laughed from across the battlefield. "Pathetic! Your resistance is useless!"
He waved his soul flag again, and five more Core Formation soul spirits appeared. This time, all five soul spirits were from spirit beasts.
Two were tigers, while the last three were winged beasts. They had probably hunted them down from the Ancient Battlefield of Parting.
The five beast spirits rushed at the five disciples, aiming to further injure their souls.
On the stands, Lady Enzi gritted her teeth. She turned to her left and saw an elder from the Blade Soul Sect grinning at her.
"These bastards, they have emptied their treasure just to enable their disciples to win against us." Wasting so many soul spirits on their disciples is indeed a waste.
However, to them, this was their chance to win and either become the second-ranked sect or even the first.
"Looks like we underestimated the enemy," Lady Liora said with a faint smile.

"No, we didn’t. It’s just that their shamelessness knows no limits. Aside from giving a Tier 7 Devil Skull to their disciples, they even gave them a soul flag. That is just too much for a sect battle between disciples."
Lady Enzi spoke with a dark expression. She clearly never saw this coming.
Sect competitions are a way of testing the disciples’ strength. However, the moment the opponent begins to cheat, everything else becomes pointless.
Bringing out twelve Core Formation soul spirits is already above what a disciple competition should allow. However, the enemy didn’t even care and chose to prioritize winning above all else.
Lady Liora sighed.
She would never stoop to such a shameless act in the name of victory. However, knowing her disciple was in the arena fighting made her feel a sense of fear for her.
Soul attacks weren’t exactly something her disciples specialized in.
She was an alchemist, but aside from pill-making, she showed no interest in soul arts. This put her in danger as well.
Twenty minutes soon passed, and as one looked at the five disciples fighting against the soul spirits, it was clear that their souls were severely injured.
HUM.
Suddenly, the Devil Skull hummed, and a wave of soul energy passed through the arena.
Vanna clenched her fists. "Elowen, now!"
At the same time she shouted, the Devil Skull moved...

chapters.title: Chapter 1110: The Two Princesses
paragraphs: "Your struggle is futile," Zeev said, pointing forward. The Devil Skull moved toward the Supreme Immortal disciples, humming with eerie intensity.
The humming continued to assault the souls of the Supreme Immortal Sect disciples who led the charge against the soul spirits.
As for Vanna and Princess Elowen, they stood at the back waiting for the right moment to attack. Soon, that moment came, and so Vanna made her move.
Vanna clenched her fists. "Elowen, now!"
The moment she said that, three flame runes appeared on her right arm, causing the entire arena to heat up.
"Futile," Zeev smirked and formed a hand seal to unleash the soul attack using the Devil Skull as a weapon.
However, just when the eyes on the skull glowed red and were about to unleash the attack, Princess Elowen teleported close to it and formed a hand seal.
The moment the seal was completed, the sound of glass breaking filled the arena.
"Glass Domain."
The space around the Devil Skull cracked, and hundreds of pentagon-shaped glasses formed around it. Soon, the Devil Skull was encased.
Zeev, who was in control of the Devil Skull, suddenly felt the connection between him and the skull severed.
Then, as if that wasn’t enough, the soul flag shuddered on its own when a beam of soul energy from the one-eyed demon spawn landed on it.
All seven remaining soul spirits were pulled out by Raizal’s soul attack.
"Glass Vortex."
Smaller shards of glass formed into a vortex under Princess Elowen’s command, and the soul spirits in the air were pulled into it.

They tried to resist, even Zeev going so far as to command them to return to the soul flag. However, the pull was just too much. Once the last of them was pulled into the vortex, Princess Elowen made her move...
"Glass Chamber."
Thick translucent glass formed around the skull she had sealed in the Glass Domain.
"This is your punishment for being shameless even in disciple combat," Princess Elowen spoke coldly, looking not at Zeev but at the elders of the Blade Soul Sect.
Their expressions turned grim...
"Cold Flame."
For the first time since the start of the competition, Princess Elowen finally used her Cold Flame. In an instant, the entire arena turned cold yet extremely hot.
The feeling instantly made the seven disciples from the Blade Soul Sect turn pale.
Princess Elowen moved closer to the Glass Chamber and pressed her flame against it.
"NOOOOOOO!" Zeev and some of the elders shouted; however, it was already too late...

"Refine," Princess Elowen muttered coldly as her flame surged. In no time, the sound of howling souls could be heard. The skull was being refined, and the imprint left on it by the one who refined it was being erased.
Princess Elowen immediately turned pale from soul and energy exhaustion; however, she continued to refine her skills.
In under ten seconds, the howling stopped.
Princess Elowen waved her hand, and the Glass Chamber Domain shattered. Then she tapped the glass dome, and it shattered too.
A pale white bone with a hollow green eye socket was the only thing remaining. With a smile on her face, she grabbed it and tossed it to Raizal. "It is now yours."
He fell from the air and was caught by Nyss...
She immediately walked her out of the arena, and Elaine quickly cast a healing spell on her.
"You should leave the arena for me," Vanna said to the rest of her teammates. Of course, they would love to join her in the remaining battle, but they were in no shape to even consider that.
So, to not make things harder than they already were, they walked away...
"Be careful, Vanna. They are not weak," Yurei said before walking away. She and Vanna were rivals, but when it came to fighting for their sect, they set aside their rivalry and gave it their all.
She and the rest managed to buy Princess Elowen time to activate the Glass Domain, which severed the connection between the Devil Skull and Zeev.
Now, it was seven against one, but Vanna didn’t seem to care.
She scanned her opponents with her fiery gaze before summoning a sword that immediately lit up in red flames.
"I am going to hurt you bastards." Saying that, she moved, and the seven Blade Soul Sect disciples also moved. They had to either surrender or fight.
Vanna dashed forward, her sword blazing with red fire. The three flame runes on her hand were boosting her speed, stamina, and flame comprehension.
Lady Liora smiled, seeing her disciple use the technique she believed would be something she would depend on for the rest of her life.
The ground cracked under her feet as she launched herself into the first strike.
The nearest Blade Soul Sect disciple blocked with his soul spear, but the heat from her blade melted the metal. His weapon broke in half, and he was thrown back.
Blood seeped from the corner of his lips, showing he had been struck with a soul backlash.
Two others attacked from both sides, attempting to catch her off guard.
Vanna twisted her body and spun, her sword releasing a wave of red fire. The red flame rune enhanced her flame comprehension, pushing her Tier 9 flame to Tier 10.
The flames swallowed them, burning their robes and scorching their skin. They screamed and rolled away, trying to put out the fire.
However, Tier 10 against a core formation expert in a medium world is not as easy as it may seem.
"What a bunch of idiots. You think anyone in a medium world without a high flame resistance can withstand her flame attacks?" Lady Liora smirked, seeing this display as futile and aimless.
They had exhausted their energy thinking that they could use the Devil Skull to win.
Now, Vanna, who was at full strength and augmented by three flame runes from her Flame God Mercy technique, was having a field day with them.
A fourth disciple leaped into the air, holding two daggers covered in soul energy. He aimed for her neck and launched an attack.

Vanna raised her hand, and a wall of flame burst upward. The daggers coming for her melted before they reached her. Then she, with her right slender leg, kicked him in the chest, sending the poor bastard crashing into the ground.
The fifth disciple, Zeev, roared and charged, his weapon glowing with blue light.
Vanna parried the attack, sparks flying through the air.

Their swords clashed again and again, causing waves of both soul and flame energy to distort in the air. Suddenly, Vanna saw an opening, so she ducked low and slashed upward. The red fire cut through Zeev’s defense, and he was sent flying.
The last two circled her, their eyes filled with rage. One controlled wind, the other controlled shadow. They moved fast, disappearing and reappearing.
Vanna closed her eyes for a moment, feeling the heat rise from her sword. The flames on her blade turned from red to gold.
When she opened her eyes, her hair flowed in the wind like fire.
The wind disciple struck first. His attack came from behind, but Vanna vanished in a burst of flame. She reappeared behind him and slashed with her sword.
The attack connected, and his body hit the ground before he could react.
The shadow user screamed and attacked with darkness, trying to trap her. The black mist swallowed the arena floor.
But then a bright golden flame exploded, burning through the shadow.
Vanna walked out of the smoke, her sword dripping with molten heat. The last disciple stumbled back, terrified. The attacks all seven of them had used were their trump cards.
However, none managed to even shake her.
Obviously, they had no idea that Vanna was no longer a Core Formation cultivator. Thanks to the Flame Rune, she was akin to a Spirit Ascension stage warrior...
Of course, if they had attacked from the start when their soul energy was at its peak, they might have had some success in maybe defeating her.
Now, it was over for them.
"You should have surrendered," Vanna said.
With one clean strike, her blade cut through the air, and the battle was over.

chapters.title: Chapter 1111: Apology and a Promise
paragraphs: In the end, the Supreme Immortal Sect did win the battle against the Blade Soul Sect; however, it came at a terrible price.
Zeyrion (Crystal Dragon), Yurei (Ice Maiden), Raizel (One-Eye Demon Spawn), and Xhan (Venom King) all suffered terrifying soul injuries.
The battle against the Soul Spirits took a huge toll on them. So, despite winning, the outcome is that their next battle will be much more challenging.

Of course, Raizel and Nyss weren’t that injured in their souls compared to the others. Raizel is a soul cultivator, so his soul is much stronger, and as a result, he was able to withstand more attacks than the others.
During the battle, he managed to kill five of the Soul Spirits, so he gained something aside from Minor injuries to his soul.
Of course, he also received a Tier 7 Devil Skull that he can refine into a powerful soul weapon.
As for Nyss, she was barely tangible during the battle since she kept moving through the shadows, so the damage wasn’t much.

The only upside to all this, however, is that she will be ready for the final battle tomorrow, as will Vanna and the other two disciples who make up the ten disciples that are representing the sect in the competition.
As for Princess Elowen, she wouldn’t be able to fight for a while.
"Stupid disciple, I’ve already told you that before you can use the Glass Domain, your mental strength should be much stronger than it is now.
Why do you have to risk your own cultivation just to win?" Lady Enzi said, sitting beside Princess Elowen’s bed.
If she had known her disciple was able to make such progress in learning the ’Glass Art,’ she would have made sure that using the Glass Domain was the last thing she ever dreamt of.

However, perhaps knowing her master wouldn’t have allowed her to use it, she hid that crucial detail from her. Now, she had suffered from Soul, Mind, and Body exhaustion after using the Glass Domain skill.
"She is stable now, but she wouldn’t be able to fight in tomorrow’s battle," Elaine said after using a soul-healing spell on Princess Elowen.
"Thank you, Elaine," Lady Enzi said, and Elaine nodded.
Elsa was working on healing the souls of the other disciples; however, aside from Nyss and Vanna, the rest wouldn’t be ready for tomorrow’s battle...
This means they can only rely on Kent if they want to win.
However, Kent is still unconscious, and the final battle is 25 hours away. Hopefully, Kent will be awake by then.
Meanwhile, inside the tower, Kent was still sound asleep on the bed. His head resting peacefully on Unity’s inviting lap.
The pressure that bore down on Kent during her True Name awakening was a result of her bloodline awakening. Her bloodline contained divine energy even as a Core Formation cultivator.
From now on, she can harness divine energy, provided her body and meridians can handle it.
It turned out she had a divine bloodline in both lives she had lived before this one.

When she was Artemis, her destiny was to become the Goddess of the Hunt — someone meant to climb the ladder and one day transcend to become a Celestial. However, that destiny was changed when she met Chaos.

Then, in her second life as the Goddess of Love and Art, she became a goddess from the start and had lived that life for thousands of years before she gave her life to give the Blood Spear King a happy ending.
So this True Name awakened both bloodlines she had back in those lives and merged them to become one powerful bloodline that even the heavens had never seen before.
If she were in control during the awakening, she would have made sure Kent didn’t take on the full blunt end of the divine aura...
Now, watching him sleep, Unity couldn’t help recalling the cold look in Chaos’s eyes when he came to her and her family’s rescue during that one fateful mission back during the Primordial Era...
"I was still too young and full of energy that I failed to see the pain in your eyes. If I had, I may have approached you differently."
Unity was not denying that during the Primordial Era, she would have made a different decision. What she wouldn’t have done was go for what she wanted without caring about Chaos’s opinion.
Back then, she wanted to become his woman to the point that she even started spreading rumors that she and Chaos were an item. Perhaps due to this, Chaos had further distanced himself from her.
"I was young and stupid," Unity smiled.
She was indeed young and very stupid. Perhaps she was so charmed that she failed to see Chaos was in pain.
She may have seen some clues, seen some signs that pointed to his mental state at that time, but because she was so absorbed in her feelings, she didn’t care.
"Now that I think about it, I can’t help but wonder what those forsaken bastards had done to make you that mad and ruthless back then."
The majority of the time they spent together was hunting down the forsaken race and other criminals. They never went a week without killing someone.
Back then, Artemis thought they were finally connecting, and so even if they went a few days without battle, she would start questioning him.

Sometimes, Chaos would ignore her; other times, he would scream at her to stop bothering him. However, to Artemis, whenever Chaos spoke to her, regardless of the nature and tone of his voice, she never minded.
To her, they were finally connecting.
"Maybe I was just stupid in believing he would ever love me, but he also called me his Shadow Stalker. I say he loved me, just that he was too stubborn to show it."

Unity blushed, and then she lay down beside Kent and hugged him. Even now, recalling how she almost died several times just trying to win over Chaos, she couldn’t help but wonder if she was indeed an idiot.

"Idiot in love." She smiled and brought her head closer to Kent’s ear. "You may have been emotionless back then due to reasons I don’t know yet. I may have been persuasive and annoying, now that I think about it — I apologize for that.

However, now that I have you in my clutches, don’t even think I will let you run off. I also promise I won’t mark you with my shadows again since I have no reason to keep tracking you whenever you run off to escape me.
Now, I am your wife, so don’t even think about running away."

Unity’s possessiveness started to bloom, and from the look of things, she was about to ensure that Kent understood that even if he managed to run from her in her first life, this time around, she would never give him that chance.
"I should probably mark you... just in case you suddenly decide to make a run for it."
Unity formed a rune in the air and pressed it against Kent’s chest, leaving a small arrow tattoo there. She smiled and placed her head on his chest, enveloping them in her bluish-white wings.
Meanwhile, Kent, who had been awake for a couple of minutes, heard all that Unity said. The more she spoke, the more he felt his heart break.
He had yet to remember his time with Unity’s first incarnation, but somehow, he knew he was at fault, and he had a clear idea why.
Suddenly, just when the arrow tattoo appeared on his chest, a system message also appeared.
⟦You have attained Shadow Affinity. Current comprehension: Weak⟧

chapters.title: Chapter 1112: Glimpse of the Truth
paragraphs: Kent smiled inwardly, watching the message.
Before the shadow affinity, he had Flame and Lightning affinity. However, aside from the flame, he had made no plans to focus on the lightning.
Perhaps he hadn’t had much opportunity with the lightning element. However, with the flame, he made so much progress.
Now, he had attained shadow affinity, which was perfect for his nature as the faceless assassin.
’Thank you, Unity,’ Kent sighed and decided to do something he had been putting off for a while now.
’Tower, if I want to review the next part of my memories as Chaos, how would it be?’ Kent asked the tower, knowing full well he could not experience what he had been through in the last memory.
It was either he got a Memory Diary or a POV in the third person, where he would get to watch the memory happen. If that were the case, then he was ready to see what happened next.
⟦The master can choose between a Memory Diary and a Third Person Memory POV⟧
’I suppose I will go with the latter. In any case, I think it is time for me to learn what happened after Chaos discovered Elina’s dead body.’

Kent wanted to learn more about Chaos’s life now that he could tell Unity was also connected to him. If he managed to discover what had occurred between them, he would get a fair idea of how to face Unity.
’I am sorry, Unity, but I have to fake my sleep for a while until I am ready to handle things properly.’ After saying that, Kent commanded the tower to use the memory key.
He felt his world spin, and then soon, he was back to Chaos’s memories...
[Chaos’s Memories - Minutes After Discovering Elina’s Dead Body]
The air around Chaos, as he held Elina’s body, was chaotic. Kent could clearly see the shift in the air and the craziness in his eyes.
Chaos was very angry, and from the look of things, he would be angry for a very long time. The emotional rollercoaster he had found himself in was one he wasn’t prepared for.
Before meeting Elina, he was all about killing all those who dared invade his world. Planet Lumen was under his protection, and so all those who set their sights on it were dealt with.

However, after meeting Elina, he began to learn more about being human. He was a dragon, a predator who only knew slaughter. However, Elina started to teach him to be more human and behave like a civilized person.
She taught him how to resolve conflicts without resorting to violence.
She taught him how to coexist with humans in a peaceful and more civilized manner.
Elina was shaping him to become someone who could live in peace rather than war. However, just when she was making headway, tragedy struck, and she was taken from him forever.
Now, looking into Chaos’s eyes, Kent could tell he was back to his bestial self.
However, with what he had learned from Elina, he spent three months burying all those who fell under the assault of the forsaken race.

He buried them all, with Elina being the last to be buried. He just couldn’t bring himself to bury her. However, knowing that was what humans do when their relatives die, he managed to will himself to bury her.

Standing in front of her grave, tears rolling down his face, Chaos spoke his final words... "Thank you, Elina. Because of you, I learned how to live in peace and make friends. You showed me there is more to life than just fighting and shedding blood.
I am grateful for all that and then some.
However, I am afraid I cannot follow in your teachings for now. I cannot remain calm and peaceful while the ones who took you away from me are out there.

So I will, as you used to say, put a pin in the life you wanted for me and become who I am. I will resort to slaughter once again, and when all of them are down, I will try to live like you wanted me to." Chaos wiped the tears from his eyes.
"I know you will be disappointed in me for choosing the path of slaughter, but to avenge you, I have to become the real me.
Sorry, Elina. But for now, I will have to say goodbye."
The moment Chaos finished those words, his eyes turned from golden to red, and then his horns grew and wings spread on his back.
He took to the skies and soon vanished into thin air.
Chaos traveled through the void for three months just to return to Lumen, his world. When he arrived, the humans who survived had settled in and started to live among the beasts.

He didn’t care about any of them since, in his mind, only Elina mattered. However, knowing he would be leaving for a while, he ensured they were safe and that the planet would be safe while he was away.
After making sure he had everything in order, he left and headed straight to the Blood System. It was a star system where the worst kind of people, beasts, and abominations lived.
Chaos had already cultivated the first form of the Primal Bone Tempering Art and had awakened the potential to wield 90,000 Blood Runes.

He had unlocked 20,000 of them and could use all of them. However, Chaos, who knew that wasn’t enough to propel him on the bloody path he is about to walk, chose to start cultivating the second form too.
He planned to strengthen his body and bones to the point where wielding all 90,000 Blood Runes would be possible.
However, since he planned to commit a massacre, he was going to use the second form of the Primal Bone Tempering Art to form Blood Tattoos by merging the Blood Runes.
Chaos was so angry and determined to the point that he planned on forming at least 20 Blood Tattoos before he started his massacre. Once he began, the universe would be painted red.
So he left for the Blood System, and for many years, he remained there, killing, slaughtering, and growing stronger. Just two years into his stay, his name started to spread.
Soon, the name Chaos was known by all. Many challenged him, and some ran from him. However, Chaos killed all he could see and, using their blood, he continued to grow stronger.
690 years later, after becoming a True Immortal, forming 25 Blood Tattoos, and awakening the infamous yet terrifying Chaos Heart, the Primordial Chaos Dragon left the Blood System.
The day he left, many cheered.
Their one true nemesis had left. However, a year later, his name started to spread again.
The first world he visited was a world of demons that had some connection to the forsaken race. Overnight, he turned the surface of the planet into a pool of blood.
Then the next planet followed, and within ten years, 35 planets fell thanks to Chaos’s carnage; however, none of said planets had even a single forsaken being.
However, he didn’t care.
Word spread of a dragon with a vengeful heart, killing all who were in one way or another linked to the forsaken race.
Many panicked, and those stupid enough challenged him, only to die in the most gruesome way possible.
Forty-five years into his massacre, his big break came when he received word that a family of hunters and assassins had received a mission to kill a forsaken king.

chapters.title: Chapter 1113: The Truth
paragraphs: Chaos had no idea who this person was. However, they had knowledge of his life, Elina, and the tragedy that had driven him to become a butcher.
He knew too much about his life, more than even he did, and so he believed him when he told him where to go next if he wanted to actually reach the Forsaken race.
"There is a world that will take three weeks of travel to get to. In this world, a family of hunters and assassins exists, known as the Shades.

Recently, they have received a mission to kill a Forsaken King. This family of assassins had no idea it was a setup and that they were all going to die. However, if you want to get to the bottom of the mission you have taken on, then this is your chance."
The mysterious person said, and Chaos nodded in response.

He had indeed killed billions, but he never got to kill even one of the bastards who took his Elina away. He wasn’t sad about that, for he knew that one day his big break would come and he would be able to go after those who truly deserved his wrath.
"Would I ever meet you again?" Chaos asked, looking at the shadow of the mysterious man who gave him the information.
"Hopefully, Chaos dragon, your journey has just begun, and my existence is to make sure your destiny is fulfilled, so we will meet again."
After saying that, the person vanished, and Chaos received the location of where he had to go next.
Three weeks later, he arrived in this world. It was a world of humans; however, these humans were different from Elina.

These humans had long ears and slightly bigger eyes than the humans he had met in his travels with Elina. Of course, he knew they were not Elves, for he had met plenty, and neither were they demons — he had killed enough of them to know.
However, Chaos didn’t care; instead, he started tracking the Shades, who were easy to find, considering they were beings with a shadow-type bloodline in their veins.𝓯𝙧𝙚𝒆𝙬𝙚𝒃𝙣𝙤𝒗𝓮𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢

He spent three more weeks shadowing them, especially a dark-haired beauty who he saw to have potential, yet she had been chained to the same ambition as her family when she should be out there spreading her wings, figuratively speaking, of course.
Not that he cared.

His mission was to follow these people who would lead him to his targets... And so he did. He followed them, and when they reached the location of the mission, he finally came face to face with a Forsaken being.
His anger boiled, and so, he chose to slaughter.
Killing them gave him more than their blood essence. He also gained their memories thanks to a skill he learned during his time in the Blood System.

Chaos had no plans of even making sure the Shades were left out of harm’s way. The sight of the ten Forsaken Kings was enough to rile him up, and so he went for the massacre, and it was brutal and swift.
Once he was done with the last of them, he left without looking back. Chaos had a massacre to commit, and so he had no plans of waiting behind to even speak a few words with the Shades.
In his mind, the Shades were a means to an end, and so when he got what he wanted, he left...
However, three years later, he spotted a shadow trailing him.
He had no idea how long she had been following him. However, the day he spotted her, the urge to kill her overwhelmed his senses.
However, he held himself back and decided to confront her first.
"Come out. I can see you jumping like a maggot from one shadow to another."
There was a minute of silence, then a dark-haired beauty emerged from the shadows with red cheeks. She looked at Chaos and pouted.
"I am not a maggot," she said.
"Who are you then, and why are you following?"
"My name is Artemis Shade, and I want you to become mine," Artemis said, her eyes radiating an aura of possessiveness as she looked at Chaos.
"And what makes you think I can keep myself from killing you instead?" Chaos didn’t even want to think about her words since, to him, his life now was meant for killing.

Artemis smiled and moved much closer to the terrifying dragon and said, "If you wanted me dead, you would have done that two years ago when you spotted me. However, you convinced yourself I wasn’t there.
This means you want me to follow you, and so I will, and I will make you mine no matter how long it takes."
Chaos ignored her and continued moving. In his heart, Artemis wasn’t there, and she never would be.
Kent’s mind suddenly returned to his body, causing him to sigh inwardly.
The memory had been long... it took several days, but finally, he had seen the truth of what he was searching for.
’She was someone who wanted to get into my heart, but she had no idea I had long closed my heart to all forms of love and affection.’
Kent used the soul map to look at the beautiful face sleeping on his chest.
’What a pitiful soul. You could have had a beautiful life, yet you chose to fall in love with an emotionally dead dragon... how pitiful.’
Kent clearly felt a sense of pity looking at Unity’s beautiful, sleeping face.

He hadn’t seen much of his life with her, but he knew it would go on for a long time between them. She and Artemis would have many adventures, for he heard some of the things Unity said, and he knew she had stayed with Chaos for a long time.
However, from her tone, he could tell she never had any luck with the emotionless dragon, which was why she wanted to possess everything about him in this life.
’I am sorry about my past life and how I treated you. I promise to do better this time around, and that starts by making sure you never feel alone or abandoned.
I will fulfill all your wishes and ensure that in this life, you get to have it all.’
Kent slowly opened his eyes and looked at Unity, who was merely faking her sleep. The moment Kent opened his eyes, she also did.
"Look who is finally awake," Unity said. She lifted her body and sat on Kent’s chest. "Good to see you are awake. Now, before you get mad, know that I didn’t mean to—"
Before she could finish her words, Kent pulled her in and locked lips with her. The kiss was deep, heartfelt, and emotional.
It contained Kent’s complete love and affection for Unity. All the love he should have given her back then, he added it all and was now conveying it through the kiss.
After five minutes, he pulled his head back and looked Unity in the eye.
"I love you, Unity."
The happy goddess smiled and hugged him, planting his face between her chest, making sure he understood that she was no longer flat-chested.
"I love you too, my little dragon." She closed her eyes, a small smile playing on her lips.
Kent didn’t know when he became a little dragon. However, he didn’t mind her and instead focused on the hug.
