chapters.title: Chapter 1114: Sealing The Promise
paragraphs: "How are you feeling?" Kent asked right when they broke their kiss and hug.

Unity smiled and answered, "I feel complete. Well, I still have no idea how my shameless pursuit of love from someone who had given up on love ended. Also, I am yet to know anything about my life as the Goddess of Love and Art, but in all, I feel complete."
Kent nodded with a small smile. "I am sorry for how I treated you back then. In my defense, I was going through a heartbreak, so sorry."
Unity smirked, "I don’t care about what happened between us back then. What matters is that now that we have a second chance, we might as well make the best out of it."
"You are right. We should make the most of this second chance. It is not always that we get to have this."
"That is absolutely true."
The two lovers looked into each other’s eyes and smiled.
Things aren’t always black and white, so since they have a second chance, making the most out of it is the only way forward.
"On that note, we should probably commemorate our new promise with sex. It is only right... right?" Unity asked, looking at Kent with eyes filled with lust and attention.
Kent didn’t deny her the fantasy she knew Unity was thinking at the moment. Naturally, he has a lot to apologize for, so sex to get things started was only right...
Time quickly passed, and in no time, there was only an hour left before the final match in the Interplanetary Sect Competition started.
As expected, it would be between the Supreme Immortal Sect and the Celestial Gate Sect.
Naturally, the Celestial Gate Sect had a sure chance to win if Kent didn’t come, so they were already looking forward to the battle.

Meanwhile, the disciples of the Supreme Immortal Sect began to panic. Despite Elsa personally healing the souls of the four seeded candidates, they were still in no shape to fight. If they were to fight in the upcoming battle, it would be detrimental to them.
So only Vanna, Nyss, and the two other disciples would be going against the seven disciples of the Celestial Gate Sect.
"The only upside we have is the individual battles. This time, we get to decide, so we can call for it, and hopefully, we win all four battles.

However, I doubt they will accept fighting all the battles if they were to lose three. This can only mean that, regardless of how many individual battles we win, they can request a team battle where we will be outnumbered and outclassed."
Lady Enzi sighed and then looked toward Princess Eshira, who was seated with a weak expression on her face. She was still weak from exhausting her mind, soul, and body.
Elaine had already used up all the ’Leaf of Life’ when they went to the Paragon Universe, so she couldn’t restore her energy to normal. But even if she had one, using it would have been a waste.
Objectively, they could have let them rest in the tower. If that had happened, all of them would have recovered by then, since that would have been 25 days for them. Plenty of time for them to heal.
However, Vexthra said no when her sisters suggested that. To her, this was a sect competition where disciples were competing against the best from other sects.
Using the tower would, in a way, cheat and deprive them of a very valuable lesson. Losing five teammates is already a lesson to them.
Sometimes, an unexpected action can put you in a situation where you either forfeit or fight against the odds and win.
"Looks like you guys have found yourselves in a weird one, huh?" Suddenly, just when everyone was out of options, Kent appeared... alone, causing everyone’s expressions to brighten up.
They surrounded him, especially Nyss, who was taking more room than even Kent’s wives.
Not that they cared. They will have him for themselves soon enough...
In a way, his wives had become more invested in the competition than even the disciples. They also wanted to participate in a competition like this.
Vexthra had already told them that when they reached the Immortal World, she would allow them to experience true sect life. So for now, they could only fantasize about it.

"Big brother, with you here now, we will win for sure," Nyss said, sounding very happy. The idea that she was several years older than Kent, yet behaved like a child, baffled everyone. However, she didn’t seem to care about that.
"Oh...I will defeat them with a wave of my finger." Kent, of course, was on the same level of energy as Nyss.
His response seemed to have made everyone calm down. Kent’s presence was indeed a welcome one.

Kent looked at the four seeded disciples and Princess Elowen. "You all did well. Now, allow me and the others to win. Afterward, we can just ascend knowing we won an interplanetary competition for our sect."
They nodded to his words.
Kent smiled. Then he waved his hand, and five pills landed on his palm. He tossed them to the five, who caught them with careful demeanors.
"These are Tier 9 Soul Strengthening Pills. They are all perfect pills, so the potency is high. They will repair and strengthen your soul."
They nodded and swallowed them in one go. Soon, the effect took hold, and they closed their eyes to begin cultivating the overwhelming soul energy that was entering their bodies.
"So, when is the battle?" Kent asked, and Nyss was quick to answer.
"We have just an hour more to go."
"Okay then. Looks like we still have some more time to go. In any case, we should be ready to kick their ass," Kent said and sat down to meditate too.
Nyss followed suit, although she didn’t need to. Kent was merely meditating to ask the tower to place limits on his body.
After recalling more of Chaos’s memories, Kent’s strength took another leap. If he didn’t put measures in place, he might just accidentally kill somebody.
It was rather delicious to think someone would place limits instead of breaking them. Kent had become so powerful now.
It was all thanks to Chaos, who spent centuries killing. Both Kent’s killing intent and understanding of combat in both his demi-dragon and true dragon forms had surged.
Now, he had become so powerful that if he were to face the same angels he faced back in Paragon’s Universe, killing them wouldn’t be too hard.
This also meant his foundation had become much stronger. The only thing left for him now was to ascend, and breaking past the Core Formation would come much faster than one would think.
After a couple of minutes, making sure he had limited himself enough, he opened his eyes.
Unity was not with him simply because her presence would cause chaos.
Unlike Vexthra, who had sealed her divinity and even lowered her appearance to blend in, Unity could not do that yet. Her divine energy was like a magnet.
Her walking around would attract and create too much chaos.

Before she could come out and roam the outside world, she had to first learn how to control the divine energy in her bloodline. So for now, to make sure nations and kingdoms didn’t fall, she had to remain inside the tower.
After a few more minutes, Kent and everyone left for the final battle between the Supreme Immortal Sect and the Celestial Gate Sect.

Despite Elsa personally healing the souls of the four seeded candidates, they were still in no shape to fight.
If they were to fight in the upcoming battle, it would be detrimental to them.
So only Vanna, Nyss, and the two other disciples would be going against the seven disciples of the Celestial Gate Sect.
"The only upside we have is the individual battles.
This time, we get to decide, so we can call for it, and hopefully, we win all four battles.
However, I doubt they will accept fighting all the battles if they were to lose three.
This can only mean that, regardless of how many individual battles we win, they can request a team battle where we will be outnumbered and outclassed."
Lady Enzi sighed and then looked toward Princess Eshira, who was seated with a weak expression on her face.
She was still weak from exhausting her mind, soul, and body.
Elaine had already used up all the ’Leaf of Life’ when they went to the Paragon Universe, so she couldn’t restore her energy to normal.
But even if she had one, using it would have been a waste.
Objectively, they could have let them rest in the tower.
If that had happened, all of them would have recovered by then, since that would have been 25 days for them.
Plenty of time for them to heal.
However, Vexthra said no when her sisters suggested that.
To her, this was a sect competition where disciples were competing against the best from other sects.
Using the tower would, in a way, cheat and deprive them of a very valuable lesson.
Losing five teammates is already a lesson to them.
Sometimes, an unexpected action can put you in a situation where you either forfeit or fight against the odds and win.
"Looks like you guys have found yourselves in a weird one, huh?" Suddenly, just when everyone was out of options, Kent appeared... alone, causing everyone’s expressions to brighten up.
They surrounded him, especially Nyss, who was taking more room than even Kent’s wives.
Not that they cared.
They will have him for themselves soon enough...
In a way, his wives had become more invested in the competition than even the disciples.
They also wanted to participate in a competition like this.
Vexthra had already told them that when they reached the Immortal World, she would allow them to experience true sect life.
So for now, they could only fantasize about it.
"Big brother, with you here now, we will win for sure," Nyss said, sounding very happy.
The idea that she was several years older than Kent, yet behaved like a child, baffled everyone.
However, she didn’t seem to care about that.
"Oh...I will defeat them with a wave of my finger." Kent, of course, was on the same level of energy as Nyss.
His response seemed to have made everyone calm down.
Kent’s presence was indeed a welcome one.
Kent looked at the four seeded disciples and Princess Elowen.
"You all did well.
Now, allow me and the others to win.
Afterward, we can just ascend knowing we won an interplanetary competition for our sect."
They nodded to his words.
Kent smiled.
Then he waved his hand, and five pills landed on his palm.
He tossed them to the five, who caught them with careful demeanors.
"These are Tier 9 Soul Strengthening Pills.
They are all perfect pills, so the potency is high.
They will repair and strengthen your soul."
They nodded and swallowed them in one go.
Soon, the effect took hold, and they closed their eyes to begin cultivating the overwhelming soul energy that was entering their bodies.
"So, when is the battle?" Kent asked, and Nyss was quick to answer.
"We have just an hour more to go."
"Okay then.
Looks like we still have some more time to go.
In any case, we should be ready to kick their ass," Kent said and sat down to meditate too.
Nyss followed suit, although she didn’t need to.
Kent was merely meditating to ask the tower to place limits on his body.
After recalling more of Chaos’s memories, Kent’s strength took another leap.
If he didn’t put measures in place, he might just accidentally kill somebody.
It was rather delicious to think someone would place limits instead of breaking them.
Kent had become so powerful now.
It was all thanks to Chaos, who spent centuries killing.
Both Kent’s killing intent and understanding of combat in both his demi-dragon and true dragon forms had surged.
Now, he had become so powerful that if he were to face the same angels he faced back in Paragon’s Universe, killing them wouldn’t be too hard.
This also meant his foundation had become much stronger.
The only thing left for him now was to ascend, and breaking past the Core Formation would come much faster than one would think.
After a couple of minutes, making sure he had limited himself enough, he opened his eyes.
Unity was not with him simply because her presence would cause chaos.
Unlike Vexthra, who had sealed her divinity and even lowered her appearance to blend in, Unity could not do that yet.
Her divine energy was like a magnet.
Her walking around would attract and create too much chaos.
Before she could come out and roam the outside world, she had to first learn how to control the divine energy in her bloodline.
So for now, to make sure nations and kingdoms didn’t fall, she had to remain inside the tower.
After a few more minutes, Kent and everyone left for the final battle between the Supreme Immortal Sect and the Celestial Gate Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 1115: Battle Over
paragraphs: The moment the disciples of the Celestial Gate Sect saw Kent, their expressions changed. Obviously, their enthusiasm had taken a hit.
They witnessed how brutal and powerful Kent was during the quarter-final battle against the Primal Beasts sect. Due to this, they all came to the conclusion that they would lose against him.
One can say that their tendency to give up easily shows weakness. However, there is no weakness involved when a mortal runs from a god.
To them, Kent’s strength is akin to a god.
He is overpowered, so they are afraid of him.
Kent just smiled and shook his head. The opponents had already given up before the battle even began.
Soon, Kent, Vanna, Nyss, Tom, and Ellis entered the arena to face the Celestial Gate Sect.

"Looks like you guys don’t feel well... Are you not feeling well?" Nyss asked, flashing a mocking smile. The disciples from the Celestial Immortal Sect grit their teeth, feeling helpless against the Supreme Immortal Sect.
’Just where did they get this monster from?’ That was the thought on their minds as they watched Kent slowly walk into the arena.
With Kent around, the Supreme Immortal Sect called for a team battle right off the bat. They wanted to get things done much faster.
"Nyss, stop teasing them. They are just not used to being the second-ranked sect," Kent replied, also flashing a mocking smile. "They will get used to it next time."
"I understand, big brother. In any case, I don’t blame them for being weak."
Of course, despite Kent’s strength, he never failed to enjoy the moment. Thankfully, the shameless Nyss was with him.
"Blaming them is useless. They have tried and reached second; that is good enough."

"True," Nyss looked at the disciples of the Celestial Gate Sect, "unlike some beasts who didn’t know their place, at least you golden-faced, handsome, and beautiful ones know when to concede. That shows guts and character growth."
"Who said we are conceding? In your dreams. You think we are conceding just because you have a cheat?" the captain of the Celestial Gate Sect said, her expression dark despite having a golden face.
Nyss, who heard her unexpected words, smirked. Kent also smiled, hearing them refer to him as a cheat.
"First of all, big brother is not a cheat. He is a person just like you and me. The only difference is that he is much more impressive, handsome, and brave than you.
Also, no need to put on a brave face. We both know I alone am enough to handle you seven," Nyss finished her sentence with a wink, causing everyone’s mouth to twitch.
The shamelessness was just too much.
Not that most of her words were wrong; she definitely had the right to defend her big brother. It was just that she had done so in the most exaggerated way possible.
Claiming she could defeat all seven of them without Kent’s help was already too much. However, her words seemed to have done the magic.

The seven disciples started to doubt themselves. They were being underestimated and looked down on by someone they knew, deep within their hearts, they could defeat. However, because she had a strong backer, they were now her prey.
’Damnit, why did such a monster come from that backwater sect? This was supposed to be my big win before I ascend... Now, lasting even a minute is not possible against him.
And this bitch, how I wish I could wipe that smirk off her face.’ Antlia, the captain of the Celestial Gate Sect, said inwardly.

"Elder, please start the match so we can get this over with." In the end, if she were forced to listen to Nyss much longer, she would explode, so she could only ask to start the battle that she knew deep down she would lose.
"I know we all know the rules. But one last warning, ’No killing.’"
After saying that, the elder stepped into the air to let the disciples have the field to fight in.
Kent stood at the back, allowing Vanna, Tom, Ellis, and Nyss to take the lead. They would handle the captain and three others, while he would take care of the rest.
"BEGIN!"
"Golden Dragon Strike!"
The moment the elder started the battle, the Celestial Gate Sect disciples decided to go all out by using one of their signature skills, the Golden Dragon Strike.
A large golden dragon made from spiritual qi suddenly appeared in the air and roared, causing the very air to shake and quake.
Kent became intrigued when he saw this. The technique clearly had the potential to do some damage to the enemy. However, that wasn’t what intrigued Kent.

Antlia, the captain, was the one who activated the skill; however, the six remaining teammates standing behind her formed a hand seal, and all their spiritual energy was channeled into the dragon, making it appear much denser and extremely robust.
’So they can transfer their energy to one person, huh... Looks like this sect is decent. They have more potential than the Supreme Immortal Sect.’
Kent smiled and moved forward, creating a distance between himself and his team. "Stay back."
They nodded and hid behind him, knowing full well this attack was beyond them.
’Making them a direct competition to the Supreme Immortal Sect will force them to work hard.’ Kent smiled and extended his hand, forming a flame ball.
"This technique of yours is decent; however, mine is the real deal."

The flame ball in his hand formed into a small dragon, which slowly rose into the air and began to expand. In three seconds, just when the golden dragon was ready, his own green dragon made from flame was ready.
"Now, let’s see whose dragon is the best."
Kent gestured forward...
ROAR

The two dragons roared at the same time, causing both heat and spiritual energy to distort in the air. The heat spread to everyone, causing the disciples from both sides to pale in fear. The heat was just too much.
Kent waved his hand quickly, forming a shield over them.
He even protected the Celestial Gate disciples from the heat, showing he had no interest in hurting them.

Up in the air, the two dragons met, and the ending was decided instantly. Kent’s dragon easily tore through the golden dragon. After doing that, it rose into the air and gave one powerful roar before turning its gaze on the Celestial Gate disciples.
"Well... Should we continue?"
All seven disciples, despite being protected by the dome that Kent had created, felt their backs break out in sweat. The green dragon looked very terrifying.
Being stared at by the dragon was like being stared in the eye by death.

"We surrender," Antlia said, saving herself and her team the trauma. They were not ready for such a battle, not with their current drained bodies. One could see the thankful look in their eyes when she surrendered.
Kent smiled and gestured forward. The flame dragon moved toward him, and by the time it reached him, it had turned into a miniature dragon that landed on his palm and vanished.
The kind of control and flame essence that went into manifesting a flame dragon and controlling it flawlessly was something many could not do.
But thanks to Chaos, Kent could now do it. In fact, he could do more than that now.

chapters.title: Chapter 1116: End Of Competition
paragraphs: The battle ended much faster than one would have hoped.
However, despite the battle ending, everyone couldn’t help staring at Kent like he was some freak of nature. Of course, he is a freak. Everything about him is freaking monstrous.
Nobody in a medium world is supposed to have that much control over flame manipulation - not even the most powerful.
Creating a dragon from mere flame qi and controlling it that cleanly is unheard of.
In fact, even high worlds wouldn’t have such a freak.
"Even with my understanding of flames, I can only cast spells to manifest beasts. Just how deep is his understanding of flame manipulation?" Lady Liora muttered, looking at Kent’s back.

"This is my first time seeing him do something this bizarre. It is like he has become stronger again," Vexthra responded to Lady Liora, who, despite her nature as an assassin, had made a life for herself as an alchemist in order to blend in.
She had wandered many worlds and met many powerful and brilliant people, but this was her first time meeting someone like Kent.

Of course, she is already aware of Kent’s monstrous nature. She had witnessed him do the impossible; however, what he had just done was not something that could be easily achieved, just by anyone, especially in medium worlds like this.
Flame manipulation at such a molecular level is near impossible.
There are people out there who can do it; however, even they have to put their entire concentration into it before they can manifest such a large dragon.
However, Kent merely opened his palm and manifested a ball of flame. Before they could wonder what he planned on doing, a flame dragon appeared in his palm. Then it enlarged, and there it was.
But the shock didn’t end there. Just when the heat exploded, he waved his hand and opened a dome that protected both his team and his opponents.
That is just too much for anyone to handle.
"He is a monster," Lady Liora said, shaking her head.
"Oh, he is indeed a monster, both on the battlefield and in bed." Selene deliberately moved close to Lady Liora just to say those words into her ears before moving back.
As expected, the poor lady shuddered not from fear, but from how alluring Selene’s voice made the whole thing sound.
’Damnit...’

She, after all, was doing her best to hold herself from falling for the Chaos Dragon. However, now, with such alluring words spoken into her ears, she cannot help but think more about Kent than she should.
There is just something about Selene’s voice that seems to turn on any woman. Kent even suspected she was secretly a succubus in disguise. However, that idea cannot possibly be true.
After all, he was the one who awakened her true name and witnessed her transformation. Selene is a Celestial Human Hybrid. So, a succubus is merely something she behaves like, but not the actual her.
Kent’s wives giggled, seeing the struggle Lady Liora was going through.
’Soon, she will fall like a meteor,’ Vexthra said inwardly and then focused her attention back on Kent...

"It is of no use to look sad and broken just because you lost. The only reason you lost is that you are not strong enough. However, if you keep training, one day, you will be able to do more than what I just did."

He waved his hand, and all the heat still in the air vanished into thin air. "My advice to you all is, ascend fast because, be as it may, there are more opportunities in the high worlds than in the medium worlds."

Kent then added, making sure the disciples from the Celestial Immortal Sect didn’t feel defeated. "Because you managed to make it to the second rank, I will bestow upon you several series of gifts that will help you become much stronger.

Finish up everything here in about a week, and then come to the Supreme Immortal Sect. I will help you break three more limits, strengthen your soul, and awaken an innate talent. I will also help you upgrade your Spirit Root.
Then, when all that is over, I will help you safely ascend to a Supreme High World. The rest will then depend on how much you want to grow."

After saying that, Kent walked away, leaving everyone in shock. All he had just said is not something that can be done easily. It would take people thousands of years to even accomplish one of the many things he had listed.
However, Kent casually said them as if it were no big deal.
Well, to him, it is indeed no biggie; however, to the ordinary folk, it is like hearing him say he will hand them planets as gifts for winning second place.
"You heard him. Big brother is that rich and resourceful, so be grateful you have won his favour. Of course, I played a part, so in the future, be sure to call me Big Sister Nyss."
After Nyss also said her piece, she walked away too. Her words and demeanor made them believe that Kent indeed had what it took to help them, as he had promised.
The disciples from the other sects began subtly pinching their elders, telling them to make a move for them, too.
They are, after all, also planning on ascending. If they can gain Kent’s favour, then they will be able to grow much stronger in the Supreme High World.
Kent, of course, knew what he was doing.
With this bold declaration, if he came through for the seven disciples, his credibility would be cemented in their hearts.

He can do all he said since he has the means. As for the Supreme High Worlds, thanks to Gaia fixing the Pill World Chamber, the planet teleporter was able to record the coordinates of the planets he had been to when he travelled to the past.
All he needed was to build an ascension platform inside the Tower or add the coordinates to the ascension tower already built in Sonox.
Either way, he had been to quite a few Supreme High Worlds, so he would be more than ready to send them on their way...
Soon, he will have more worlds connected to him, further strengthening him.
After the shocking words Kent had spoken had receded, the winners were announced, and the competition came to a close.
Everyone went their own way while Kent went to meet with Lord Munny again.
Since he promised to meet him again when the competition came to an end, he went to meet him and have a talk. Of course, it would be more about Kent stating terms and Lord Munny replying with a nod.
There would be High and Immortal Worlds to take under his wing; however, making medium worlds a part of his strength is also good enough.
With many worlds joining him, he will only keep growing.
Lord Munny was already there when Kent got there. It seemed he was more than eager to become Kent’s subordinate now more than ever.
He had awakened an innate ability and broken his 15th limit. All this, added to the fact that Kent could send one to a Supreme High World, spoke volumes.𝙛𝓻𝒆𝓮𝒘𝙚𝙗𝒏𝙤𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝒐𝙢
So he came to hear what he had to say and see if he would be earning more than he could have ever dreamt of.

chapters.title: Chapter 1117: Kent’s Plan for the Alliance
paragraphs: "Looks like you are much more punctual than most people," Kent spoke, seeing Lord Munny already at the peak of the mountain waiting for him.
The golden-skinned man smiled and answered, "I have already seen what you can do, so being punctual is my way of making my stance very clear."
Kent smiled, "I like it when people see what they want and go for it. Makes them more likable and easy to work with."

Obviously, the golden-faced man was now more than ready to toil just to become powerful. The primary reason most people in medium worlds dislike ascending is due to their perceived strength and potential.
In most high worlds, the strongest and most brilliant from a medium world can become the weakest there. Kent had been there and saw firsthand the gap in strength and potential.
Only a few monsters from the medium worlds have ever made it to the high worlds.

Due to this, Lord Munny and many are determined to become somebody when they ascend. Of course, it isn’t only about strength and potential that makes them eager to ascend; there is also the situation of wealth.
In essence, most fail in high worlds due to their low wealth. The richest from medium worlds can easily become the poorest in a high world.
The difference in spirit stones is rather huge. One hundred medium-grade spirit stones are equivalent to one high-grade spirit stone. So the medium-grade spirit stones are practically useless there.
However, if one becomes strong here, they can utilize their strength to make a living in the high worlds.
"So, what do you think?" Kent asked Lord Munny.
"I have decided to follow your arrangement if it means me becoming strong enough to survive the high worlds."
"Don’t worry, I will make sure you do more than survive. If you follow my arrangement to the dot, then making it big in high worlds will become the least of your problems once you ascend."
Lord Munny nodded with a sigh, "In that case, I am ready to follow your arrangements." A man who knows what he wants and goes for it is a man who would never fail, regardless of the situation.
Kent sighed in his heart and then went ahead and narrated his plan for Lord Munny and the whole of the Celestial Ascendence Planetary Alliance.
Kent’s plan was simple.
He would make the Half-Elves on the planet Sonox his main powerhouse. He would build many Ascension platforms there and fortify the city, making it nearly impossible to attack.

Then, under his command, there would be a Dragon Guardian. This Dragon Guardian could only be from the Half-Elves race. However, thanks to the tower creating a binding contract, every last Dragon Guardian could not betray the alliance.
They would be Kent’s right-hand men or women who would have access to the Tower.
Every one thousand years, he would come for resources by entering the Tower thanks to an item Gaia would create. They would be responsible for distributing resources in a fair and just manner.
This Dragon Guardian would work for 10,000 years before they could ascend.
However, under them, there would be System Guardians, Planetary Guardians, and Sector Guardians.
Lord Munny will be the System Guardian. He will work directly under the Dragon Guardian, and he will also have access to the Tower. However, he can only come when Kent wills it.
His job will be to ensure the planetary system expands and grows stronger. He will ensure that one day, the planetary system becomes a star system.
Of course, he will have the chance to ascend, but only after 5,000 years have passed. Once he ascends, the Dragon Guardian will appoint a new System Guardian.
Then come the Planetary Guardians, who would work directly under the System Guardian. Their job is to ensure the planets in the planetary system are protected and taken care of.
They will receive resources from the System Guardian and use them to better their planets.

The Sector Guardians, however, will be unknown individuals selected by the Dragon Guardian to monitor other planetary systems and report on which worlds can be easily pulled and which systems they can easily swallow.
In essence, Kent had plans to expand this planetary system, so he left a detailed plan that all those who would fill this role would use.
Of course, he wouldn’t ask anyone to swear, but he knew for a fact that none would misbehave since the tower and Vexthra would ensure that.
If he was going to spend his wealth to make planets grow, then he might as well make sure his investment was protected.
"That is the plan, so what do you think?"
Lord Munny took a moment to gather his thoughts. This was his first time hearing such a meticulously crafted plan that sought to ensure a whole planetary system grew and became much stronger.

If possible, he would need a few minutes to digest everything. However, he already knew, regardless of how much he thought, at the end of the day, he wanted to grow stronger, and so he could only become the System Guardian.
"I think it is an excellent plan. And I, for one, would love to work hard to grow and also ensure your dream is managed."

"Wonderful," Kent smiled and then added, still with a smile on his lips, "By the time you are done with your commitment, I will make sure you have broken 20 limits, awakened at least three innate talents, and learned not less than five divine-grade skills.
There is also a large sum of money attached so that when you ascend, life wouldn’t be unbearable for you."
Lord Munny smiled at Kent’s words.
He indeed was looking forward to all these goodies. If only he knew Kent was already planning to give him more than he could carry.
This person would be working for him for the next 5,000 years. Although it sounds like a long time, to someone like Lord Munny, 5,000 years could also be equivalent to 50,000 years.
It would pass in the blink of an eye for him, so he was more than eager to see what destiny had in store for him. Kent would ensure he had it big when he is done with his role as the System Guardian.
He was going to the high worlds, so he would surely make sure all who ascended under his command didn’t face much difficulty there.
This was the best he could do for people who would work for his gain. He had no plans to use them, only to discard them and move on to the next.
They would work, and he would reward them for their hard work.

Kent retrieved a storage pouch and handed it over to Lord Munny. "Use it to start your training. In a month’s time, come to Sonox and meet the Dragon Guardian. She will have the next phase of the plans waiting for you."
Lord Munny received the pouch with a nod.
Kent planned to ascend soon, so by the time he came back, he would be gone. However, with the Tower, he could very easily come back and have a meeting with them.
After he and Lord Munny parted, Kent teleported back to the Tower and started spending time with his wives.
Before he ascended, he had to ensure they were satisfied...

Of course, while that is life-threatening, it also has its benefits.
Kent will be attacked three times, and if he survives, he will be granted access to a higher world. However, while that is the main goal, there are also benefits that come with it.
The lightning strikes contain Tribulation Runes, which, when absorbed, cleanse the meridians and remove impurities from the body.
It also strengthens the bones and tempers the body.
On top of that, if one possesses Lightning Affinity, their lightning element will see an upgrade thanks to the tribulation lightning.
So, Kent is looking forward to that, and that alone is more than he could have asked. If he gets to a high world with some added bonuses, then that is cool.

"You are a freak of nature for sure. Many will run from the idea of even standing under the judgment of the heavens, yet here you are not even looking forward to it." Mara chuckled, and her sister Nara also shook her head.
"Well, I am a dragon, so sooner rather than later, I will have to undergo my first Dragon Tribulation, which will be several times more dangerous than this ascension tribulation.

Also, as an Alchemist, once my pills reach Tier 15 upwards, I will always have to face the heavens whenever I make a pill. Of course, the heavens are fair, so they wouldn’t make things difficult for me or anyone.
However, it is always good to be ready."
Kent smiled, already thinking ahead.

Chaos had undergone the Three Dragon Tribulations when he went to the Blood System. That bastard went there as a Heavenly Ascension Stage cultivator and came back as a True Immortal with five freaking Immortal Qi.

Kent cannot afford to lag behind, and so he must face the dangers now and emerge stronger in the end. Like Vexthra told him, he must make good use of his time in the high world to grow stronger than he is now.
"There is also the concept of moving through the Immortal Stages. You will have to face the heavens every step of the way. I guess this is the best thing that could happen to me."
His wives just smiled...
"By the way, Li Hua is now 15 and a half, so Nyxara has taken her to the Dark Region to awaken her shadow element and physique. I am sure by now they will be back, considering it has been weeks."
Kent smiled weakly, knowing he had some apologizing to do.
He promised to take Li Hua to help her awaken her element and Atomic Divine Body. However, he had missed that, and knowing Li Hua, she was already planning to bill him.
Her love for money knows no limit.
"She will understand you were busy. However, you should probably bribe her with something she will be extra happy with."
Vexthra and her sisters laughed. Since they had been scammed by Li Hua before, they knew how persuasive she could be.
"Now, why don’t you tell us more about the wonderful and amazing people you met when you travelled to the past?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1120: Fate Of Past Friends (1)
paragraphs: [Planet Blue Haven - Sylvara’s POV]
It had already been over 370,000 years since Kent parted with his pals from the past. To him, it had been only a few days, but to them, thousands of years had passed.
A lot had happened in the lives of his lovers, friends, and companions.
Sylvara, who met Kent with her clone body, had now merged with her main body and eagerly started waiting for the time she would meet Kent again.
360,000 years ago, when she and the others ascended to the immortal world, as Kent had planned, they arrived in the "Beasts Kingdom."
It was as they’d heard — a haven for all beasts. She and the others, of course, faced some opposition from the beasts living there.
However, since they had spent 10,000 years strengthening their foundations before ascending, it took them less than a thousand years to make their stance clear to every beast.
They were not to be messed with, and that message was heard loud and clear.
Sylvara remained in the Beasts Kingdom for 60,000 years and raised her strength to Spirit Immortal before leaving. She managed to sense her main body, so she left to become whole.
At the moment, she had reached the Immortal Monarch stage, a powerhouse in her own right. However, despite reaching such a terrifying stage, she couldn’t help missing Kent every single day.
She had her fair share of troubles. Of course, someone of her standing and beauty was bound to have her share of troubles.
Her mother had passed through the God Tribulation and ascended to godhood, so Sylvara was the one taking care of her clan.𝗳𝚛𝚎𝚎𝘄𝕖𝕓𝕟𝕠𝚟𝚎𝕝.𝗰𝕠𝐦
There were demigods in their clan, and even a god — her grandmother. However, Sylvara was now in charge of affairs, being a royal, now that her mother was no longer around.
Of course, once she had consolidated her power, she would return, and Sylvara could reunite with her brothers and sisters.
She missed them terribly; however, the one she missed the most was the purple-haired brat who swept her off her feet.
From the very second she parted with Kent, she had been missing him like hell. However, she had already known it would take a lifetime before they met again.
That had given her a reason to wait. However, as the days passed and more trouble found her, she couldn’t help but sit and only miss the handsome dragon who made her heart skip a beat.
"I will meet you one of these days, Kent," she muttered, looking at the taming bracelet on her wrist.
She had not, even once, taken it off, since she knew doing so would be akin to showing she was tired of wearing it.
She can’t take it off, not even in the slightest.
"My lady, the people from the Great Sumin Immortal Family are here again," said a lady — a Snakekin who needed no introduction — to Sylvara, her expression filled with annoyance.
She clearly hated the people who dared worry her mistress.
"Tell them to go away. I have no interest in marrying that useless bastard. If they try to make a fuss, you have my permission to kill them."
The lady smiled upon hearing the command given to her. "I will do as you say, my lady." She walked away, and Sylvara could only sigh.
"Hurry and come to me, Kent, or else I will lose my mind."
[Beast Kingdom - Ignarok’s, Orvath’s, and Balrion’s POV]
Inside a large hall made purely out of gold, three men, each a powerhouse, sat drinking wine made from a rare, immortal fruit.
They looked relaxed, but one could tell Orvath was troubled. He, after all, had been traveling the Beast Kingdom for the past 40,000 years in search of ways to grow stronger.
To rise from one immortal stage to the next can take hundreds of thousands of years. It is also one of the reasons why the strength gap between immortals is as vast as heaven and Earth.
Orvath had just returned from his trip, so they had to bring him up to speed.

"It has been over 370 thousand years since we last saw the master. I know only Vey and the rest of the ladies will say this, but I kind of miss him," Balrion, the Flame Titan Monarch that Kent tamed back in the Flame Sea, said, taking a sip from his drink.
Ignarok, the Tyrant Flame Dragon, and Orvath, the Flame Minotaur Monarch, nodded with silent smiles on their lips.
"It is only normal to miss him. Even I miss him sometimes," Ignarok also admitted his weakness, something he wouldn’t have done in the past.
Now, all seven Flame Monarch Beasts that Kent had tamed had grown much closer. They didn’t feel any threat in telling their weaknesses and secrets to each other.
That was how much they trusted each other.
"Have you heard from the others?" Orvath suddenly asked the question on his mind. Balrion nodded and answered...
"Sylvara is now the matriarch of the Divine Flame Serpent Clan since her mother has ascended into godhood and is now in seclusion. She said she will pay us a visit when her mom is out.

As for Vey, she is currently having issues with her family. We asked if she needed help, but she rejected the offer, citing that she would handle it herself. Of course, we sent three Phoenixes to go help her despite her stubbornness. You already know how she can be.
As for Kaelith and Zeraphine, we don’t know where they are."
Ignarok took over, "The last I heard, Zeraphine went to the Chaos System to help a friend, but that was the last I heard from her. As for Kaelith, we heard nothing from him.
We also cannot reach either of them since the distance is too vast. However, I am sure they are well."
Ignarok smiled, "I mean, who would dare hurt them? They are subordinates of the Primordial Chaos Dragon. The one who dares lay a finger on them is doomed for all eternity."
The three immortal beasts smiled.
Ignarok had already reached the peak of the immortal stage — Immortal Lord — while Balrion and Orvath were both at the Immortal Monarch stage.
"I guess I will go see Sylvara next since she is available compared to Vey," Orvath said, and his two brothers nodded.
"You should. I can tell you have made a lot of progress. Use this time to strengthen yourself before the Chaos Rift opens. We are only 100 years away."
Orvath nodded to Ignarok’s words and soon left.

He had indeed made a lot of progress over the past 40,000 years, so now was the best time to harness his strength and prepare for what was promised to be one of the most dangerous yet rewarding expeditions of their lives.
The Chaos Rift opens to the Chaos Region, allowing immortals to go and explore. Demigods can even enter, but they will be suppressed to the immortal stage.
This Chaos Region can be a world from the Chaos Era or even a large planetary, stellar, or galactic system from the Chaos Era.
This means there will be treasures, and where there is treasure, there is danger.
Everyone was preparing, and Orvath had to prepare as well.
"I will go to Vey’s star system and keep a low profile just in case she needs help." Balrion also made his decision, and Ignarok nodded.

"Even though dragons and phoenixes don’t see eye to eye, if her life is in danger, summon me without any delay. She is stubborn and strong, but she is also one of the master’s lovers, so she cannot die."
"Okay. See you later then," Balrion left, and Ignarok also went back to cultivating.

chapters.title: Chapter 1121: Fate Of Past Friends (2)
paragraphs: [Planet Pyronos - Divine Golden Phoenix Clan - Veyara’s POV]
Just like how Sylvara stayed in the Beast Kingdom for years before leaving, Vey did the same. However, unlike Sylvara, who left 300,000 years ago, she left a little over 30,000 years ago.

The reason she left was that she learned that her siblings had been mismanaging the Golden Divine Clan since her big sister, who took charge after their mother vanished, ascended to godhood 120,000 years ago.

Their mother left the clan to her big sister, since she was the wisest and strongest of them all. However, because their mother didn’t return even after hundreds of years had passed, she had to ascend, which she did.

But after she was gone, the rest of her siblings started mismanaging the clan’s affairs, which, to Vey, was an insult to their mother’s dignity, name, and hard work in ensuring the clan thrived all these years.
So, she decided to take over the clan and restore it to its former glory, like how it was under her mother and big sister’s management.

Of course, it wasn’t going to be easy, considering she was going against three of her siblings. However, Vey was no weakling, so she had been working for the past 30,000 years to ensure that the clan her mother had worked hard to build was protected and guarded against all forms of danger and misappropriation.
Vey had worked hard, and so she managed to reach the Immortal Monarch stage. But even with her strength, she wasn’t having it easy.

"My lady, maybe we should ask Lord Ignarok and Balrion for help. I am sure with them coming here, your sisters will have no choice but to bow," Arpina, a redheaded phoenix, said, handing a glass of wine to Vey.
She was one of the three phoenixes that Ignarok had sent to assist Vey: Arpina, Shula, and Tana.
"Arpina is right, my lady. Lord Ignarok is an Immortal Lord; with him here, this rebellion will be handled easily," said Shula, another redheaded phoenix.
Vey sighed, knowing deep within that her two assistants were indeed right. Ignarok’s presence would indeed change things.
"I know you ladies are just worried about my safety. However, worry not, I am more than strong enough to protect myself.
Also, if I bring external force, I will indeed be able to suppress them; however, they will not truly accept me as their leader, especially if I use a dragon to do so.

So I will use my own hands to take back what my mother built. Of course, it will be hard and long, but I have no doubt that one of these days I will achieve my goals and make my mom and big sister proud."
The three ladies could only look at her with calm expressions.𝒇𝒓𝙚𝒆𝔀𝓮𝓫𝒏𝓸𝙫𝓮𝓵.𝓬𝙤𝙢
Vey is stubborn. That much they are well aware of. However, her dedication to her mother and her commitment to reclaiming what she had left behind only seemed to grow by the passing second.
Shula and her two sisters sighed. They had been following her for a very long time, even back in the Flame Sea, so they were aware of her temperament.
"I hope Lord Kent makes it here within the next 100 years," Tana said, and her sisters nodded.
"With him here, I am sure these angry birds will have no choice but to scram," Shula added, and again her sisters nodded.
They were already aware of their big sister’s feelings for Kent, so they knew the only person who could talk some sense into her head was him.
Too bad Kent was nowhere to be found.
Hearing the words spoken by the two redheaded phoenixes, Vey sighed slightly. "Kent, where are you now? I miss you."

She sighed again and decided to rest for a while. She had managed to win back some of the elders and those who believed in their clan, rather than making a profit. Soon, she would make a move to claim more.
However, going against three Immortal Monarchs while only an Immortal Monarch herself was no easy thing to do.
But she is trying, and hopefully, one day, she will be able to achieve her goal.
[Unknown Planet in the Chaos Star System - Zeraphine’s POV]
"Damn it!" Zera, as she prefers to be called, parried a sword attack from an Immortal Monarch and evaded an arrow from an Immortal Emperor.
It came narrowly at her heart, but she managed to evade.
"Just die already, plant!" The Immortal Monarch attempted to utilize his superior strength to overpower Zera; however, the latter had more combat experience from her thousands of years of combat.
She utilized her bloodline ability, which enabled her to project her consciousness into plants, to move and appear behind the Immortal Emperor, stabbing a wooden sword through his back.
"Aaaarrrggghhh!"
The Immortal Emperor screamed when he felt his soul pierced. The sword emitted a faint purple immortal energy that seemed to possess a corrosive poison aspect.

Zera didn’t linger and moved away before surrounding herself with purple flames. Then she slid through the many plants around and created a raging storm of fire, causing the Immortal Monarch to frown and move back.
By the time the flame storm dispersed, Zeraphine was long gone.
"Sneaky little bitch," the Immortal Monarch cursed, feeling his prey slip through his fingers. He turned toward the Immortal Emperor and sighed.
"How bad is it?" he asked.
"That bitch got me. She wounded my soul. Had it not been for the soul protection charm that Lady Idalia gave us before this hunt, I would have been taken out from that one attack."
The Immortal Emperor gritted his teeth as blood drooled from the corner of his lips. He came this close to death, just like the many others who fell to Zeraphine’s wooden sword.
Several thousand miles away, Vey materialized from the ground as a lotus flower and soon transformed into her humanoid form.
COUGH
She coughed up a mouthful of blood and fell to her knees, her face pale. After catching her breath, she sealed the space she appeared in and started to heal.
"It will take them a month to be able to heal and chase again. Hopefully, by then, no other team will come after me," Zeraphine sighed.

Thirty-nine thousand years ago, she received an invitation from an old friend who needed help retrieving a specific flower treasure that would enable her to make significant progress in her cultivation.
Zeraphine, of course, didn’t hesitate. She owed her for helping her long ago, so she bid Ignarok and the others goodbye and left.
However, who would have expected the friend she knew and trusted like her own family to actually be after her life—well, she was after her immortal qi, to be precise.
In the Immortal stage, the only thing that determines one’s strength is their immortal qi. A Root Immortal with two immortal qi can easily contend with a Core Immortal with only one immortal qi.
Zeraphine is an Immortal Monarch who has nine immortal auras, something that shook the Beast Kingdom.
Everyone called her a genius, but who would have thought that, among the many people who wanted her immortal qi, her best friend would be one of them?
This betrayal shattered Zeraphine to the point that she nearly died many times. For thousands of years, she had been trying to escape one ambush after another.

sentences.text: [Planet Pyronos - Divine Golden Phoenix Clan - Veyara’s POV]
Just like how Sylvara stayed in the Beast Kingdom for years before leaving, Vey did the same.
However, unlike Sylvara, who left 300,000 years ago, she left a little over 30,000 years ago.

The reason she left was that she learned that her siblings had been mismanaging the Golden Divine Clan since her big sister, who took charge after their mother vanished, ascended to godhood 120,000 years ago.
Their mother left the clan to her big sister, since she was the wisest and strongest of them all.
However, because their mother didn’t return even after hundreds of years had passed, she had to ascend, which she did.

But after she was gone, the rest of her siblings started mismanaging the clan’s affairs, which, to Vey, was an insult to their mother’s dignity, name, and hard work in ensuring the clan thrived all these years.
So, she decided to take over the clan and restore it to its former glory, like how it was under her mother and big sister’s management.
Of course, it wasn’t going to be easy, considering she was going against three of her siblings.

However, Vey was no weakling, so she had been working for the past 30,000 years to ensure that the clan her mother had worked hard to build was protected and guarded against all forms of danger and misappropriation.
Vey had worked hard, and so she managed to reach the Immortal Monarch stage.
But even with her strength, she wasn’t having it easy.
"My lady, maybe we should ask Lord Ignarok and Balrion for help.
I am sure with them coming here, your sisters will have no choice but to bow," Arpina, a redheaded phoenix, said, handing a glass of wine to Vey.
She was one of the three phoenixes that Ignarok had sent to assist Vey: Arpina, Shula, and Tana.
"Arpina is right, my lady.
Lord Ignarok is an Immortal Lord; with him here, this rebellion will be handled easily," said Shula, another redheaded phoenix.
Vey sighed, knowing deep within that her two assistants were indeed right.
Ignarok’s presence would indeed change things.
"I know you ladies are just worried about my safety.
However, worry not, I am more than strong enough to protect myself.
Also, if I bring external force, I will indeed be able to suppress them; however, they will not truly accept me as their leader, especially if I use a dragon to do so.
So I will use my own hands to take back what my mother built.
Of course, it will be hard and long, but I have no doubt that one of these days I will achieve my goals and make my mom and big sister proud."
The three ladies could only look at her with calm expressions.𝒇𝒓𝙚𝒆𝔀𝓮𝓫𝒏𝓸𝙫𝓮𝓵.𝓬𝙤𝙢
Vey is stubborn.
That much they are well aware of.
However, her dedication to her mother and her commitment to reclaiming what she had left behind only seemed to grow by the passing second.
Shula and her two sisters sighed.
They had been following her for a very long time, even back in the Flame Sea, so they were aware of her temperament.
"I hope Lord Kent makes it here within the next 100 years," Tana said, and her sisters nodded.
"With him here, I am sure these angry birds will have no choice but to scram," Shula added, and again her sisters nodded.
They were already aware of their big sister’s feelings for Kent, so they knew the only person who could talk some sense into her head was him.
Too bad Kent was nowhere to be found.
Hearing the words spoken by the two redheaded phoenixes, Vey sighed slightly.
"Kent, where are you now?
I miss you."
She sighed again and decided to rest for a while.
She had managed to win back some of the elders and those who believed in their clan, rather than making a profit.
Soon, she would make a move to claim more.
However, going against three Immortal Monarchs while only an Immortal Monarch herself was no easy thing to do.
But she is trying, and hopefully, one day, she will be able to achieve her goal.
[Unknown Planet in the Chaos Star System - Zeraphine’s POV]
"Damn it!" Zera, as she prefers to be called, parried a sword attack from an Immortal Monarch and evaded an arrow from an Immortal Emperor.
It came narrowly at her heart, but she managed to evade.
"Just die already, plant!" The Immortal Monarch attempted to utilize his superior strength to overpower Zera; however, the latter had more combat experience from her thousands of years of combat.
She utilized her bloodline ability, which enabled her to project her consciousness into plants, to move and appear behind the Immortal Emperor, stabbing a wooden sword through his back.
"Aaaarrrggghhh!"
The Immortal Emperor screamed when he felt his soul pierced.
The sword emitted a faint purple immortal energy that seemed to possess a corrosive poison aspect.
Zera didn’t linger and moved away before surrounding herself with purple flames.
Then she slid through the many plants around and created a raging storm of fire, causing the Immortal Monarch to frown and move back.
By the time the flame storm dispersed, Zeraphine was long gone.
"Sneaky little bitch," the Immortal Monarch cursed, feeling his prey slip through his fingers.
He turned toward the Immortal Emperor and sighed.
"How bad is it?" he asked.
"That bitch got me.
She wounded my soul.
Had it not been for the soul protection charm that Lady Idalia gave us before this hunt, I would have been taken out from that one attack."
The Immortal Emperor gritted his teeth as blood drooled from the corner of his lips.
He came this close to death, just like the many others who fell to Zeraphine’s wooden sword.
Several thousand miles away, Vey materialized from the ground as a lotus flower and soon transformed into her humanoid form.
COUGH
She coughed up a mouthful of blood and fell to her knees, her face pale.
After catching her breath, she sealed the space she appeared in and started to heal.
"It will take them a month to be able to heal and chase again.
Hopefully, by then, no other team will come after me," Zeraphine sighed.

Thirty-nine thousand years ago, she received an invitation from an old friend who needed help retrieving a specific flower treasure that would enable her to make significant progress in her cultivation.
Zeraphine, of course, didn’t hesitate.
She owed her for helping her long ago, so she bid Ignarok and the others goodbye and left.
However, who would have expected the friend she knew and trusted like her own family to actually be after her life—well, she was after her immortal qi, to be precise.
In the Immortal stage, the only thing that determines one’s strength is their immortal qi.
A Root Immortal with two immortal qi can easily contend with a Core Immortal with only one immortal qi.
Zeraphine is an Immortal Monarch who has nine immortal auras, something that shook the Beast Kingdom.
Everyone called her a genius, but who would have thought that, among the many people who wanted her immortal qi, her best friend would be one of them?
This betrayal shattered Zeraphine to the point that she nearly died many times.
For thousands of years, she had been trying to escape one ambush after another.

chapters.title: Chapter 1122: Fate Of Past Friends (3)
paragraphs: As an immortal, just one strand of immortal qi is extremely valuable to the point that an immortal will kill just to have it.
One’s strength as an immortal is determined based on their immortal qi. It is what they depend on, just like how Spirit Kings depend on spiritual qi.

Of course, that doesn’t mean immortals don’t use spiritual qi. They do depend on it; however, in a battle where the opponent is using immortal qi, using spiritual qi against them is akin to courting death.
So, immortal qi is extremely important.
Of course, there are three ways of obtaining immortal qi.
The first is the basic, which is as simple as refining spiritual qi into immortal qi. It may sound easy; however, refining spiritual qi into immortal qi is extremely difficult.
In fact, it is borderline impossible to achieve that.
One would have to spend thousands of years in seclusion just to refine one strand of immortal qi.
The second is refining the immortal qi in treasures such as immortal herbs, crystals, and bones that once belonged to immortals.
Many use this method because obtaining such treasures is, in a way, easier than spending thousands of years refining spiritual qi into immortal qi.
The last, of course, is what Zeraphine had landed herself in.
It is similar to the second method; however, in this case, the goal is to kill the immortal and refine their entire body into immortal qi.
Their immortal qi will become yours, provided you manage to refine it.
This method is frowned upon by many; however, people do it because it is the easiest way to obtain immortal qi.
Zeraphine’s friend wanted to do that to her; however, thanks to Zeraphine’s nature as a Plantkin and the fact that she possesses nine immortal qis, she was able to escape.
However, the predator wouldn’t let her prey run off just like that.
"Idalia, if I don’t kill you, then my name is not Zeraphine." The angry Purple Flame Lotus Monarch gritted her teeth, blood coming from the corner of her lips.
She had been running for years, and she had even forgotten how much time had passed.
Naturally, she knew if she couldn’t make it back to the Beast Kingdom, then she must become a demi-god to survive.
However, she had no time or safety to even take the Immortal Lord Tribulation despite reaching the peak of the Immortal Monarch stage thousands of years ago.
"Ignarok warned me not to go anywhere, yet I ignored his warning." Zeraphine didn’t want to, but she started blaming herself.
In her bid to repay a favour, she had now found herself in a hide-and-seek game with a jealous friend and her cronies.
"Kent, I really hope I live long enough to meet you again."
She sighed and continued to recover when suddenly a voice spoke from behind her, causing the poor Lotus Queen to jump to her feet and pull her wooden sword.
"Looks like you have found yourself in a sticky one, Zeraphine."
A handsome dark-haired man who seemed to be in his early 40s asked, his expression friendly thanks to the smile at the corner of his lips.
Zeraphine took a few steps back, feeling a dangerous presence coming from this man.
"Who are you?" she asked, pointing the weapon. "Are you one of her playthings?"
The man smiled and shook his head. "I am nobody’s plaything. I am just a concerned friend who merely wishes to offer a helping hand."
Zeraphine took another step back. ’This man is dangerous.’
The man before her is merely at the Death stage—not even a Root Immortal; however, for some reason, Zeraphine felt a sense of danger toward him.
Of course, if they were to fight, she would be able to take him down easily... She was an Immortal Monarch with nine immortal qis, after all.
However, a part of her hesitated to go into melee against this man. The danger she kept sensing from him was already enough to tell her she shouldn’t.
"Who are you?" Zeraphine asked again.

The man maintained his smile and answered, "Who I am is not important. The most important thing here now is how to get you out of here and to safety. Of course, I have a way to do that, so the most important question should be—do you trust me enough to save your life?"
The concept that a mere Death stage cultivator would ask an Immortal Monarch to trust them enough to save them was very shocking and insulting.
No immortal would fall that low to the point that they would need Death stage cultivators to save them.
However, Zeraphine had found herself in a situation where she truly needed saving
However, because she had long abandoned the idea of anyone coming to her rescue, despite the welcoming smile on the man’s face, she was inclined to reject his proposal.
Perhaps, if this person were an Immortal Lord, trusting that they had what it takes to save her would be much more believable.

Zeraphine gritted her teeth and released her immortal qi, causing the space around her to twist. The man raised his brow. "I wouldn’t do that if I were you. After all, we wouldn’t want the lackeys to find us easily now, do we?"
Zeraphine seemed to have realized her mistake, so she took back her immortal qi. Then she asked for the third time...
"Who are you?"
Just looking at the man made her feel like she should kill him and run with her broken body. However, she couldn’t—not when she didn’t know how this man had snuck up on her.
As an Immortal Monarch, being snuck up on by a mere Death stage cultivator is not something to downplay.
The man sighed and then decided to go on and tell her who he was. Perhaps that would make her believe him and allow him to save her...

"A very long time ago, they called me Karl Duskbane. However, now, you can just call me Uncle Drew." Uncle Drew smiled and added, "I am a Knight Rider, and a direct subordinate and chauffeur of the Primordial Chaos Dragon."
Zeraphine’s expression changed when she heard the family name. "You know Chaos?" she asked, feeling some form of happiness.
"I believe his name in this life is Kent Madson. However, sure, I know Chaos; he saved my life and gave me a purpose. Now, if you will, we really have to go."
Zeraphine sensed several presences coming, so she nodded after a slight hesitation.
Uncle Drew snapped his fingers, and a portal opened. He walked through, and Zeraphine followed after a few internal struggles.
The portal closed the next second.
Five seconds after the portal closed, five Immortal Monarchs arrived at the location where Zeraphine had been a few seconds ago.

"I truly hate this plant lady. She can always see you coming from millions of miles away." One of the Immortal Monarchs, with bronze skin and a metallic sheen, golden eyes, and hair of silver threads, spoke, and the rest nodded in response.
One of the reasons why Zeraphine manages to remain alive this long is her uncanny ability to see danger from millions of miles away.
"Annoying bitch." Seeing their prey had yet again slipped away, they also left, frustrated.
Meanwhile, in a large dark mansion built from strange-looking stones, a portal opened in a large hall, and Uncle Drew and Zeraphine stepped out.
"Welcome to Nythra. I am Nyx, the Queen of Eternal Midnight." Seated on a throne, an extremely beautiful lady spoke, causing Zeraphine’s body to freeze.

chapters.title: Chapter 1123: Fate Of Past Friends (4)
paragraphs: It is like jumping from a frying pan into molten lava.
Just a few seconds ago, Zeraphine was running from the Immortal Monarchs; however, now she is facing a literal demigod who can become a god at any time.
If she wanted, she could pinch her to death like it was a normal Monday.
That is not something she can handle.
However, the portal is closed, and the man who brought her is already walking toward an obsidian chair. Zeraphine can only panic and start wondering how she can make a run for it.
Clearly, she is terrified of Nyx, a being who is leagues above her. If possible, she will offer her soul if it means surviving this terror.
However, Nyx merely smiles.
"Relax, young lady, I have no interest in hurting you."
"T-then why did you bring me here?" Zeraphine managed to ask. It made no sense why a demigod would save her.

"Well, a little birdie told me you are in trouble, and so, as someone connected to Kent, I saw it best to save you. After all, saving you when you truly needed help will make me look good when facing him.
This is completely for my own benefits...After all, I am a selfish person, you see."
"I did the saving, just in case we are keeping score," Uncle Drew said with a small smile. Nyx smirked and focused her attention on Zeraphine.
"The main issue is you are now safe and sound. You can spend the next couple of thousand years here until Kent comes for you, or until this lazy rider finds a way to return you to the Beast Kingdom."
Uncle Drew smirked...
"How would Kent know I am here?" Zeraphine asked, and Nyx smiled.

"Don’t worry, he will find out soon enough." Nyx waved her hand, and Zeraphine felt her body lifted off the ground. She panicked, but before she could say anything, her entire body was sent flying through a door.
She appeared in a green field despite the gloomy environment in the sky.
"You can cultivate here and prepare to form your tenth Immortal Qi and become an Immortal Lord. In here, you have nothing to worry about." Nyx’s voice entered her head one last time.
Zeraphine sighed and then sat down. Even now, she is still skeptical about the situation she has found herself in.
Her life taking a turn that sharp is already too much for her fragile mind to comprehend. In fact, she didn’t even know if this was real or merely an illusion.
So it will take her a while to come to terms with what all this is about.
Meanwhile, inside the large hall, Nyx looked at Uncle Drew and asked, "Why save her and not the other one? She seems to be doing better than he is."

Uncle Drew smiled. "The young master used to say something along the line of ’hoes before bros.’ I had only one chance to save two of them, so following in my young master’s footsteps, I saved the lady.
The guy can only blame himself for having bad luck."
Nyx smiled, knowing full well Uncle Drew was just messing with her. However, knowing Kent from their time in Hell, she can see him actually say something like that.
"I want the true reason," she asked again, and Uncle Drew just smirked.
"Saving the male Bird would be hard and near impossible. I would have to fight, and while I would love that, the current me is no monster who can face immortals in the dozens.

Of course, even if I could, there is also a demigod who can pinch me to death. This means saving him is impossible, so I saved her instead and hoped that soon, the young master would find out about him."
"I see. So does that mean you are planning on leaving?"
"Not yet. I can’t go back just yet. The master will first have to ascend before I can go to him," Uncle Drew sighed.
He came back to the underworld years ago to train. Back then, he planned on creating dozens of Night Agents to strengthen his army and, in essence, his master’s army.
However, a fateful encounter in the underworld allowed him to also become much stronger than he was supposed to.
In essence, instead of getting stuck at the peak of the Core Formation stage, Uncle Drew became something—someone akin to a forsaken being.
Now, he was able to transcend beyond the rank of a Core Formation stage cultivator and even went beyond the rank of a Heavenly Ascension stage expert.

"If and when I get back, I would have to awaken the unique Knight Rider trait of my teammates and allow them to become limitless beings. This way, even when I leave again, I wouldn’t worry about my Young Master’s safety."
Nyx nodded.

She sure knows what Uncle Drew is capable of. Years ago, when he came and asked her to send him to the Black Castle—one of the most dangerous places in the underworld—she hesitated; however, she did send him there in the end.𝓯𝓻𝒆𝙚𝒘𝓮𝙗𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝒍.𝙘𝓸𝙢
However, who would have thought the weak night rider she had sent there would one day be known as the King of Black Castle?
Uncle Drew’s fame in the underworld cannot be replicated. He had made a name for himself, and it is all thanks to a fateful encounter with someone.
Now, he can grow beyond the limit placed on him, despite being linked to Kent.
If anything, his coming to the underworld is the best thing that has ever happened to him.
"I just hope that poor guy is okay," Nyx sighed.
"I will go check if the lady has settled in. She seemed scared of me." Nyx stood up and left, leaving Uncle Drew alone in the hall.
"Master is going to kill a lot of people for sure." He smiled and also left to go handle some business he had saved up in order to keep himself busy.
[Planet Gemini - Guillotine Prison - Kaelith POV]
Inside a small room featuring four thick chains, each crackling with red lightning energy, a worn-out man with a pale expression sat, his hands and legs bound by these chains.
His skin was cut from what appeared to be whip strikes. Dry blood could be seen coating his body and wounds.
His left eye is blinded, and his heartbeat has slowed down.

This person is, of course, Kaelith, the fastest beast monarch Kent had tamed back in the Flame Sea. Before he was tamed, he and Zeraphine ambushed and tried to kill Kent; however, he later became one of his most loyal subordinates.
Twenty-eight thousand years ago, while traveling the universe, Kaelith was ambushed by a group of hunters working for his family.
Kaelith left his family several years ago to pursue his dreams after his mother died. As a Flame Roc Beast, traveling long distances is something they enjoy thanks to their speed.
So after the one person who seemed to always make him happy died, he left. Apparently, his leaving didn’t sit well with the family.
The claim was that his mother had left him a treasure technique she had stolen from the family, and that was why he was able to leave and remain safe out there.
So, they had been looking for him, and on that day, they finally caught up with him. It took twenty-four immortals, of which fourteen died, before they caught him.
However, he refused to talk no matter how many times they asked. In the end, they imprisoned him in the Guillotine Prison, where nobody dares to step in.
Once in there, your life is practically over. However, Kaelith remains calm, waiting for the day his master will come.
