"I want the true reason," she asked again, and Uncle Drew just smirked.
"Saving the male Bird would be hard and near impossible.
I would have to fight, and while I would love that, the current me is no monster who can face immortals in the dozens.
Of course, even if I could, there is also a demigod who can pinch me to death.
This means saving him is impossible, so I saved her instead and hoped that soon, the young master would find out about him."
"I see.
So does that mean you are planning on leaving?"
"Not yet.
I can’t go back just yet.
The master will first have to ascend before I can go to him," Uncle Drew sighed.
He came back to the underworld years ago to train.
Back then, he planned on creating dozens of Night Agents to strengthen his army and, in essence, his master’s army.
However, a fateful encounter in the underworld allowed him to also become much stronger than he was supposed to.
In essence, instead of getting stuck at the peak of the Core Formation stage, Uncle Drew became something—someone akin to a forsaken being.
Now, he was able to transcend beyond the rank of a Core Formation stage cultivator and even went beyond the rank of a Heavenly Ascension stage expert.
"If and when I get back, I would have to awaken the unique Knight Rider trait of my teammates and allow them to become limitless beings.
This way, even when I leave again, I wouldn’t worry about my Young Master’s safety."
Nyx nodded.
She sure knows what Uncle Drew is capable of.
Years ago, when he came and asked her to send him to the Black Castle—one of the most dangerous places in the underworld—she hesitated; however, she did send him there in the end.𝓯𝓻𝒆𝙚𝒘𝓮𝙗𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝒍.𝙘𝓸𝙢
However, who would have thought the weak night rider she had sent there would one day be known as the King of Black Castle?
Uncle Drew’s fame in the underworld cannot be replicated.
He had made a name for himself, and it is all thanks to a fateful encounter with someone.
Now, he can grow beyond the limit placed on him, despite being linked to Kent.
If anything, his coming to the underworld is the best thing that has ever happened to him.
"I just hope that poor guy is okay," Nyx sighed.
"I will go check if the lady has settled in.
She seemed scared of me." Nyx stood up and left, leaving Uncle Drew alone in the hall.
"Master is going to kill a lot of people for sure." He smiled and also left to go handle some business he had saved up in order to keep himself busy.
[Planet Gemini - Guillotine Prison - Kaelith POV]
Inside a small room featuring four thick chains, each crackling with red lightning energy, a worn-out man with a pale expression sat, his hands and legs bound by these chains.
His skin was cut from what appeared to be whip strikes.
Dry blood could be seen coating his body and wounds.
His left eye is blinded, and his heartbeat has slowed down.
This person is, of course, Kaelith, the fastest beast monarch Kent had tamed back in the Flame Sea.
Before he was tamed, he and Zeraphine ambushed and tried to kill Kent; however, he later became one of his most loyal subordinates.
Twenty-eight thousand years ago, while traveling the universe, Kaelith was ambushed by a group of hunters working for his family.
Kaelith left his family several years ago to pursue his dreams after his mother died.
As a Flame Roc Beast, traveling long distances is something they enjoy thanks to their speed.
So after the one person who seemed to always make him happy died, he left.
Apparently, his leaving didn’t sit well with the family.
The claim was that his mother had left him a treasure technique she had stolen from the family, and that was why he was able to leave and remain safe out there.
So, they had been looking for him, and on that day, they finally caught up with him.
It took twenty-four immortals, of which fourteen died, before they caught him.
However, he refused to talk no matter how many times they asked.
In the end, they imprisoned him in the Guillotine Prison, where nobody dares to step in.
Once in there, your life is practically over.
However, Kaelith remains calm, waiting for the day his master will come.

chapters.title: Chapter 1124: Fate Of Past Friends (5)
paragraphs: [Unknown Planet - Pill Immortal Nefeli’s Location]
A couple of months ago, when Kent’s name first appeared in the Universe, Pill Immortal Nefeli embarked on a journey to an unknown place.
She had been on the move for several months now.
At the moment, in a place filled with demonic-looking skeleton beasts, Nefeli held her sword firm, her expression calm as she cut through them like weeds.

She is an Immortal King, a relatively low cultivation base compared to the likes of Ignarok or Sylvara. However, despite her weak cultivation base, even the Immortal Emperor stage skeleton demons aren’t having it easy against her.
To many, she is just an Immortal King with 5 Immortal Qis. To many, that makes her an ordinary Immortal King.
However, to those who had faced her and lived to tell the tale, she is a Sword Immortal, someone who has both Immortal sword qi and Immortal sword intent.
She also has a Level 9 Immortal Sword Domain, something only a few swordsmen have managed to achieve.
But as if that isn’t enough, she also possesses an Immortal sword body and has cultivated her body to the Immortal Body stage. This meant she had already achieved the Nirvana Body.
Of course, the idea that she is also a Pill Immortal doesn’t even apply in the concept. However, when it comes to lethality, Nefeli is far more dangerous.
Now, she is facing one of the dreadful obstacles she has faced yet on this journey.
After an hour, she had dismantled them all and was on her way...
"Master, I think it is time for you to come out of seclusion. Your idol is back, and meeting him in person will be much more beneficial than refining his sword aura."
Nefeli smiled.
When she met Kent back in Pyris Pill World, she found out he was the Primordial Chaos Dragon. However, Kent hinted he was more than that.
Initially, she had been skeptical about his other identities; however, when Kent’s name appeared on the Sword Dao Tablet, her suspicion was validated.
Kent was Lord Genesis, the Father of Swordsmen.
There is no denying it.
Now, she wanted nothing more than to reach the place her master had been in seclusion for the past 450 thousand plus years.

"At this rate, I will reach there in two more years. I hope by the time I make it back, Kent will come looking for me." She smiled and increased the speed at which she was flying, a whirlpool of sword qi swirling around her.
[Planet Brima - Lady Kami’s POV]
In another immortal world, Lady Kami sat calmly in an immortal cave, her eyes closed, a halo of eight immortal qi swirling around her.

She had been in this place for the past 20,000 years, learning a new technique she had received from a sect she and her daughter joined when they ascended to the Immortal World along with Yuna, Nefeli, and the others.
Life has been pretty chill for her and her daughter. However, she wanted to become so powerful that protecting her man and her sisters when she is needed wouldn’t be hard.
Her mission is to learn the technique, refine her 9th Immortal Qi, and, if possible, reach the Immortal Lord stage before 100 years.
However, regardless of the situation, she will be walking away much stronger and more determined.
In essence, she is very determined, and as a result, she has spent all these years in seclusion. Soon, she will come out of seclusion, ready for when the Chaos Rift opens.
[Planet Olive - Supreme Fate Sect, Core Region - Lady Azela]
"Have you heard?" a disciple said, rushing into an inn filled with dozens of disciples from the Supreme Fate Sect.
"Heard what?" a different disciple asked, looking at the disciple who was starting the conversation.
"Big sister Azela had formed her 8th Immortal Qi while still at the Immortal Emperor stage."
"WHAT!" the disciples in the inn shouted, feeling their expressions change from nothing to shock and amazement.
What they had just heard was something beyond them.

75,000 years ago, two sisters, Azela and Kami, arrived at the Supreme Sect with immense potential. Their arrival changed everything because, according to the sect elders, they had never seen two people with such a profound understanding of Fate.

Naturally, Lady Kami and her daughter were already legends in walking the Path of Fate before they ascended. However, their big break came when they explored the Tomb of an ancient immortal and found a manual on the Fate Path.
This knowledge changed them to the point that a powerful and mighty sect like the Supreme Fate Sect wanted nothing more than to spend their wealth on them.
So instead of becoming outer disciples, they straight away made them inner disciples.
Lady Kami and her daughter, Azela, became the subject of every conversation from the moment they arrived in the sect.
Four hundred years later, they became core disciples, and it was then that they began spreading the good name of the sect and establishing their own reputation.
Lady Kami is an Immortal Monarch, while her daughter is an Immortal Emperor.
However, for most Immortal Emperors, the maximum Immortal Qi they have is just six. But Lady Azela had seven, and just now, she had formed the eighth.
"How long was it when she formed the seventh?"
"If my memory serves right, that is about 1,200 years ago."
"Damn... She is a monster among monsters. Not even the Supreme Fate Queen and King are this amazing."
"True. Big sister Azela had proven that title or no title, talent is all that matters."

"That is indeed true. This should also be a lesson to us all. Just because we come from weak and virtually no backgrounds doesn’t mean we are useless and that we should become rags for the wealthy and fortunate.
We have Big Sister Azela as proof of that. She came from no background, yet she is amazing."
"You are absolutely right, Wade. We have a mentor, and so we should also work harder to make it."

Just like that, the fate of thousands of students in Lady Azela had strengthened, and so had her own strength. She is a master of Fate, and so having people with Fate in her is like having gallons of petrol.
"Now, all I want to see is how the Supreme Fate Queen will handle it. I was told she is a rival to both Big sister Kami and Big sister Azela."
"Me too. I want to see how she will handle this."
"She is going to explode for sure. The last time she learned the Supreme Fate King talked to Big sister Azela, she nearly burned the sect to the ground."
The disciples chuckled, and some even grinned.
This is their safe space. It is somewhere they can meet and let out their frustration for having to put up with the nuances of the Supreme Fate Sect’s high-standing disciples.

The disciples from the powerful backgrounds tend to look down on them and ridicule them. However, whenever they meet in the Cabin Inn, they let out their frustrations and finally get to badmouth their rich heirs.
In a way, they all see Lady Azela as their idol, and now that she has yet again set the bar high enough, they can only be happy for her and hope that soon, she will become even stronger.
In essence, everyone wanted to see a violent confrontation between the Supreme Fate Queen, one of the most popular and brilliant disciples in the Supreme Fate Sect.
With how high Lady Azela had set the bar, everyone would love to see her reaction to it.
"It will end badly for her. After all, Big sister Azela has two servants, a Phoenix and a Dragon. Unless she wants her scalp burned, she would do well to stay away."
Everybody burst out laughing.

chapters.title: Chapter 1125: Fate Of Past Friends (6)
paragraphs: [Planet Qilin - Everlasting Pill Mountain - Pill Immortal Flura’s POV]

Tribulation lightning fell from the sky, judging a pale white Tier 21 Pill that had just been formed. Standing below it, forming complex hand seals, is a beauty whose name had reached several star systems and even galaxies.
She is Pill Immortal Flura, one of the most accomplished alchemists in the universe at present.
Thousands of years ago, when she arrived in this world as a Pill Monarch, many looked down on her. After all, she was merely a Pill Monarch in an Immortal World.
Nobody took her seriously; not even the Pill Sect’s factions and alliances accepted her.
However, Pill Immortal Flura didn’t give up.
She slowly built herself up, using every chance she could get to learn something new. Soon, however, her name started to spread.
Eventually, the name Pill Immortal Flura reached many worlds, planetary systems, star systems, and even galaxies.

It was only then that the powerful pill factions and sects that rejected her started to try to recruit her again. However, as someone who has achieved such great success that she even has demi-god customers, she had no reason to join them.
Thus, for thousands of years now, she has been working extremely hard to enhance her understanding of pill making, and hopefully, when she meets Kent again, she will be able to defeat him.
At the Pill Immortal stage, there are three tiers of pills that can be made: Tier 20, 21, and 22.
The pill in the air is a Tier 21 Immortal Pill, and the fact that the heavenly tribulation judging it has five layers of color indicates that the pill will be of high grade.

Ten minutes later, the cloud receded, announcing that her pill met all requirements of the Heavenly Pill Dao. It had two violet pill rings around it, which means the pill’s potency had been enhanced by 12 times.
But since there are two violet rings—one from her effort and the other from the Heavenly Pill Dao—the potency of the pill is now 24 times more potent.
That is how much more valuable the Immortal Pill is.
If there were three violet pill rings, the potency would have been 36 times greater.
The moment the tribulation ended, the pill transformed into a bird and tried to fly away. However, Pill Immortal Flura was ready. She formed a hand seal, and a triangular shield formed around it.
With a simple gesture, she then dragged it back.
"Let me go, human. In case you are not aware, I am an Immortal-grade pill. You will do well—"
A pill bottle appeared in Pill Immortal Flura’s hand, and she placed the talkative pill inside and put it away.
From Tier 15, the Heavenly Pill Dao judges pills and determines which ones meet all requirements of a good pill and which should just be discarded.
At Tier 18, the pill, after judgment, gains intelligence and can even transform into humans or any other form the Heavenly Dao deems them worthy.
The pill Flura had just formed is a Tier 21 Pill with two violet pill rings. However, looking at the expression on her face, one can see she isn’t happy.

Ursa, the phoenix that Kent gave her as her guardian and friend, walked toward her. "Little sis, no need to look dull. You have just formed your first Tier 21 Immortal Pill with two violet pill rings. That is something to be happy about."
"I know, Ursa. It is just that I can’t help but think Kent has long surpassed me," Pill Immortal Flura said, taking a deep sigh.
"He is a monster, Sis. People like him shouldn’t be the targets one should chase after." Ursa smiled, recalling the mischievous smile on Kent’s face when he bid them goodbye 370,000 years ago.
"He is a monster, but you are also a monster. I mean, just look at you. An entire Pill Faction with three Pill Gods is scared of you simply because they are threatened by your talent.
I say that is something to be proud of. Just like how you have a Kent, they also have a Flura."
Pill Immortal Flura smiled, hearing Ursa’s words. "You always know how to cheer me up."
"Lord Kent said I should always keep you happy, so I am just doing that."
"Oh, so if it wasn’t for him, you wouldn’t have made me happy?"
Ursa smiled and answered, "Probably not."
"Tch, what a shameless sister I have." She took Ursa’s hand, and they started walking toward a small yet elegant mansion sitting atop the same mountain they were on.
Ursa is an Immortal Monarch, while Flura is an Immortal Emperor.
Naturally, Ursa is in charge of all battles since she is a martial cultivator and a terrifying blue flame phoenix.
She had been protecting Pill Immortal Flura from the Blaze Pill Valley for thousands of years already, and she would continue doing it for thousands more to come.
[Planet Bakora - Lady Wu and Veth’s POV]
Planet Bakora can be regarded as the capital planet in the Bakora Wealth Star System. It has many planets, of which even Planet Qilin (the planet on which Pill Immortal Flura lives) is a part.
In this star system, the most powerful thing is money, and so many engage in all kinds of businesses and dealings just to make a living.
It is a wealthy planet, and this is evident in the buildings, people, and the natural beauty of the planet itself.
On this planet, there are many businesses, but two of them stood out.
The Brown Maple Auction Empire and the Dream Pill Emporium.
Lady Wu and Lady Veth are two of the most powerful women on this planet and in the Bakora Star System.
Their businesses extend far and wide to the point that even the powerhouses from other star systems try to go into business with them.
At the Dream Pill Emporium, all kinds of pills that you want can be procured for you and sold at a reasonable price. They have connections with numerous alchemists, sects, and alchemical factions.
Lady Veth, the owner, is not only beautiful but also intelligent and dedicated. She has many suitors, but in her head, only one person matters.
Then comes the Brown Maple Auction Empire, whose roots can be traced back to High Worlds and is also one of the biggest and grandest auction empires there is in the star system and beyond.
They have three events that cannot be missed unless, of course, you want to miss out on heaven-defying opportunities.
They hold mega auctions every 1,000 years, 10,000 years, and 100,000 years, where items that have never been seen before are sold.

In 65 years’ time, the third mega auction, which is hosted every 100,000 years, will take place. So Lady Wu and Lady Veth are working around the clock to organize a big auction, even bigger than the one that happened 100,000 years ago, which had even drawn the attention of the gods and demigods.
This time, they want to make it even bigger because they have received so much that needs to be sold.
This auction lasts for 5 whole months, as that is how much needs to be sold. One would say buying a 0.002% stake in this business will make you a wealthy man, no matter what.
In essence, these two ladies are doing way better than Kent had imagined. He merely wanted them to have a good life; he never expected them to become this wealthy and powerful in just 370,000 years.
However, they are, and as the person who made all this happen, Kent will certainly get to enjoy the fruit of his labor.

They have three events that cannot be missed unless, of course, you want to miss out on heaven-defying opportunities.
They hold mega auctions every 1,000 years, 10,000 years, and 100,000 years, where items that have never been seen before are sold.
In 65 years’ time, the third mega auction, which is hosted every 100,000 years, will take place.
So Lady Wu and Lady Veth are working around the clock to organize a big auction, even bigger than the one that happened 100,000 years ago, which had even drawn the attention of the gods and demigods.
This time, they want to make it even bigger because they have received so much that needs to be sold.
This auction lasts for 5 whole months, as that is how much needs to be sold.
One would say buying a 0.002% stake in this business will make you a wealthy man, no matter what.
In essence, these two ladies are doing way better than Kent had imagined.
He merely wanted them to have a good life; he never expected them to become this wealthy and powerful in just 370,000 years.
However, they are, and as the person who made all this happen, Kent will certainly get to enjoy the fruit of his labor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1126: Fate Of Past Friends (7)
paragraphs: [Planet Gangis - Autumn’s POV]

Planet Gangis is one of the major warrior planets in the Immortal Worlds. It is a world of warriors, and Princess Autumn, who became Empress Autumn before ascending with her sisters and friends, chose to live there.
She had been living there for thousands of years already.
Over the years, she had done so much and proved her status as a warrior, earning the title Scarlet Archeress.
Among the dozens of people Kent had met and befriended in his time at the Pill World 370,000 years ago, she was the second to reach the Immortal Lord stage with 9 Immortal Qi.
She is a terrifying Archeress, someone who has even caught the interest of the gods and demigods.
Rumour even has it that during an expedition into an Ancient Ruin 12,000 years ago, she severely injured a demigod while just at the Immortal Monarch stage.
Due to this, she had entered seclusion and started preparing for when the demigod would come for revenge.
Nobody had seen her for the past 12,000 years. However, she is still alive, and for that, everyone wanted to wait for when she comes out.
Meanwhile, inside an Immortal Cave somewhere on the outskirts of Planet Gangis, Eris, a green-haired dragon lady, stood beside Autumn, attending to an injury on her shoulder.
Obviously, the battle between the demigod happened, but she didn’t come out unscathed like many had believed.
She was injured, and that was evident on her shoulder now.
"How is the pain now?" Eris asked, putting medicine on the small but painful cut on her shoulder.
"The divine energy is almost gone, so the pain has lessened."
Eris nodded. "If you had relaxed and healed first before taking the tribulation to become Immortal Lord, the pain would have long subsided."
"I know, Eris. However, if I had become Immortal Lord before meeting that bastard, his death would have been swift." Autumn smiled, recalling how close she came to killing the demigod.

"I know you are an overachiever, Autumn, but Lord Kent said your health and safety are important, so maybe next time don’t go fighting demigods." Eris didn’t want to say it, but she is darn proud of Autumn.
As a dragon, this level of arrogance in Autumn is to her liking.
"Just don’t go looking for trouble for now. The Chaos Region will open in the Star System that Big Sister Sylvara lives in. She sent word that we should come.
Naturally, that bastard will also come. He wouldn’t miss the chance to kill you, so I have sent word to Big Sister Brianna. She will come with Kenina."
"I see. How is she, by the way?"

Eris smiled. "She is just like you. The last I heard, she and her mercenary group had taken on an entire cult of zealots and eradicated them, even killing their Immortal Lord leader in a one-on-one battle."
Autumn smiled, missing her sister, best friend, and guardian.
[Planet Panara - Brianna’s POV]
Planet Panara is also a warrior planet, perhaps even more competitive than Planet Gangis. However, they are both in the same Star System but different planetary systems.
General Brianna, the reason why Kent got to meet Princess Autumn back in the Flame Sea, is now a prominent figure in this world.
Planet Panara is vast and largely inhabited by demons. However, a lone human managed to build a power there that cannot be questioned, not even by the Demon Kings.
When they ascended thousands of years ago, General Brianna wanted to pursue her own dreams of forming a mercenary team and dominating the world through blood and iron.
She had achieved her dreams, forming the Red Scarf Mercenary Group, an all-women mercenary team featuring some of the most beautiful yet lethal women a man could ever meet.
Over the years, they had undertaken hundreds of missions and completed every single one of them.
Their recent victory had to do with them taking on a church of demons whose evil ways had claimed the lives of many.
This mission was one that many mercenary teams avoided, yet the Red Scarf Mercenary Team took it on, and they came back victorious.
"Big Sister, Eris has sent word. She said Big Sister Sylvara had sent an invitation to visit her star system within the next 100 years.
A rift that leads to a Chaos Region, said to be from the Chaos Era, will be opening, and she has secured slots for us."
Kenina, a Phoenix lady, said as she combed Brianna’s blonde hair after washing it. Being a mercenary doesn’t mean she must have disheveled hair.
"Oh, I see." General Brianna smiled. "How is the Empress, by the way?"
"After her battle with the demigod, she has been in seclusion, attending to her injuries. However, she will be ready by the time the Chaos Rift opens."
"Good then. We must finish up here fast enough and go see her. It has been thousands of years since we last met. I miss her."
Kenina nodded with a smile..."Me too"
Meeting the Empress, as her sisters call her, will indeed be fun.
[Planet Kyros - Yuna’s POV]
After Nefeli left, Yuna became lonely. She is a troublemaker; however, she only causes trouble when her big sister is around.
Now that she is gone, she dares not cause any trouble with her Root Immortal strength.
"Why the gloomy look?" A pale-skinned human woman asked, sitting by her after appearing from thin air.
This lady is Purity, Yuna’s Primordial Purity Soul Flame. After spending thousands of years together, the Primordial Flame Spirit Kent had given her had finally managed to form her humanoid form.
Seeing her sister and master sad and lonely, she decided to console her.

Yuna turned and looked at Purity before placing her head on her shoulder. "I just miss Big Brother Kent. He said he would be gone for only a while, but it has already been thousands of years. A while shouldn’t be that long, right?"
Purity sighed, knowing Yuna was right. A while shouldn’t be that long. However, she also knew that to cultivators, the passage of years is normal.
But then again, she couldn’t help wondering if Kent is even alive out there. For all they know, he is already dead.
Of course, another thought popped into her mind, which she couldn’t help but form a bad plan from.
"Maybe he is not in the Immortal Worlds. Maybe he is still in the High World."
Yuna lifted her body and looked at Purity. "Are you sure?"
Purity smiled and gave Yuna’s hand a gentle squeeze. "Not one hundred percent sure, but there is no harm in checking out that theory."
"Are you saying we should go to a High World to look for Big Brother Kent?"
"I mean, that is the only way to see if he is still alive."

Yuna chewed her lower lip for a few seconds before nodding. "I like this plan. However, we will be suppressed from the Immortal stage to Tier 19 (Heavenly Ascension Stage), so we should prepare before leaving."
Purity smirked. "I am a Spirit Flame, Yuna. I will not be suppressed. I will remain a Tier 22 (Death Stage) Flame, so there is nothing to worry about."
Yuna seemed to have recognized something, so she smiled. "You are a bad influence, Purity. However, if we will indeed be meeting Big Brother, it is worth the risk."𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
Obviously, the two troublemakers are about to cause so much trouble in the High Worlds they will appear in.

chapters.title: Chapter 1127: Messenger of a Demigod
paragraphs: Lyna had been on the move for the past 7 months straight. She went from one planet to another, one teleportation channel after another, always on the move, not even stopping to have a moment of respite.
She had faced many challenges along the way, but because of the importance of the trip she was on, she persevered through it all.
Finally, looking at the blue planet just within arm’s reach, she allowed herself to breathe and smile a little.
"I am finally here."
A few minutes later, a flying ship so large that it was able to transport thousands of people landed on Planet Mekyn, home of the Flame Humans, Ice Demons, and Elves.
The moment the ship landed—well, hovered a meter off the ground—Lyna jumped down and vanished into the crowd. Soon, she approached a teleportation platform.
"Hello, beauty, where do you intend to go today?" an Ice Demon, not too handsome nor too ugly, asked, a line of smoke escaping the corner of his lips as he pulled back a long pipe.
Lyna studied the man as if checking if he was bad news.

She had been on the move for a very long time, so she had come to know all the bad seeds that should be avoided and which ones to be friendly with. This allowed her to see the true character of anyone at first glance.
Thankfully, this person was not bad news.
"I would like to go to the Elven Kingdom today," Lyna said, keeping a polite smile on her face. She had learned to always smile, even when she didn’t want to.
Smiling while talking to strangers in a way makes them like you and actually deters them from having bad intentions, causing them to think twice before acting negatively.
"Elven Kingdom, huh?"
"Yes. I have business there, and the earlier I get there, the better for me."
The man nodded. "It will cost you, though."
"How much then?"
"Just 20,000 high-grade spirit stones."
Lyna narrowed her gaze at the man. Of course, 20,000 to ordinary folk is a lot. However, to someone like Lyna, it is nothing at all.
She was from an Immortal World, and as an immortal herself, she used Spirit Crystals and, on occasion, God Stones. Just one Spirit Crystal is equivalent to 10,000 high-grade Spirit Stones.
So she was rich. However, she learned that to avoid suspicion, making people perceive you as poor would make them less likely to rob you.
As expected, the man smiled guiltily and raised his finger. "Of course, there is a discount going around today, so that will be 15,000. That is already good enough, don’t you think, fairy?"
Lyna looked at him for a few minutes and then gave him the money. "Thanks for your generosity, Mr."
The Ice Demon smiled weakly and activated the teleportation formation.
"Have a safe trip, fairy."
With that, Lyna nodded and stepped into the open channel. Soon, her body vanished into thin air, leaving the man to sigh. Soon, however, a grin formed on his face.
"That is 5,000 profit for me. Less than I had hoped, but good enough." He pocketed the 5,000 spirit stones and only logged the 10,000.
Somewhere in the Elven Kingdom, a teleportation gate lit up and Lyna materialized.
"Welcome to Galen," an Elven maid said, bowing slightly to Lyna. She nodded with a calm expression.
Perhaps because Lyna was a Dragon and also a Heavenly Ascension Stage cultivator, the Elven maid lowered her pride and greeted her.
Of course, if Lyna had shown her true self when she talked to the Ice Demon, that cunning bastard would have quaked in his boots.
However, she merely put on a human appearance and masked her aura, making her appear both weak and less important. This allowed her to move much more freely and avoid many gazes.
Now, however, she had reached where she wanted, so she took on her demi-dragon form, allowing her to have golden hair, a golden and beautiful pair of horns, and, well, golden eyes.
She was from the Supreme Golden Dragon Race, one of the most powerful beasts in the Immortal World. They had several gods and even a supreme among them.
Even her mother is a god.
"I would like to be taken to the High Priestess of this kingdom," Lyna said.
"Of course. Please follow me."𝒇𝒓𝙚𝒆𝔀𝓮𝓫𝒏𝓸𝙫𝓮𝓵.𝓬𝙤𝙢
The Elf led Lyna out of the teleportation gate, causing many who saw them to start wondering why there was a dragon among them now.
"I am sure she is here to seek an alliance with our race."
"I guess so. However, why come alone?"
"I wondered the same thing. If she and her kind wanted to seek an alliance with us, why then come alone? Why not bring more people as a sign of goodwill?"
"She even came through a teleportation gate. That doesn’t scream alliance-worthy to me."
"What do you losers expect? She is a dragon, and dragons are known for their arrogance."
More people wondered about various things as they watched the dragon being led toward a different teleportation gate.

On Planet Mekyn, the Elves were the smallest race, yet the strongest. They had more capable warriors who could easily dominate any battlefield, so from time to time, different races came to seek alliances with them.
Today, in their eyes, there was no difference. However, they couldn’t help wondering why Lyna came alone. Many came with dozens of people; however, she came alone.
Of course, they could only speculate because, in the end, she was here, and they had no idea why she came.
Soon, however, Lyna and the maid entered the teleportation gate and arrived in a different part of the city.
Lyna was led to a large mansion made from jade glass. At the entrance, three Spirit Lord Elves stopped them.
"This place is off-limits to anyone. The High Priestess is busy, and she would love not to be disturbed," one of the guards said, a smirk forming on his lips.
The maid turned and looked at Lyna, unsure of what to do. She was but a maid, after all.
Lyna, however, studied the guard for a few seconds before she lost interest.
Her eyes then glowed golden, and in a voice that shook the very ground, throwing the guards back and echoing across a several-mile radius, she spoke.

"My name is Lyna Thalindra Drakana, a messenger of the Flame Lord Agni, who is a direct subordinate of the Primordial Chaos Dragon. He has a message for the High Priestess, and I would very much like to deliver it before it is too late."

By the time her voice receded, the three guards had passed out. The authority she used wasn’t entirely her own. It was a combination of hers and the authority of the Chaos Dragon given to Lord Agni, the demigod Kent met in the Flame Tower back in Sonox.
The three Spirit Lords stood no chance at all.
Suddenly, three powerful figures appeared—two Elves and one Succubus.
The blue-haired Elf spoke, "I am High Priestess Runa. This is Protector Enyo and Lady Adina."
Lyna nodded. "I am Lyna. I have a message from Lord Agni, the Flame Lord, and one of the demigods in the Holy Fire Demon Castle."
The three ladies raised their brows, hearing what Lyna had just said.
"An immortal," Adina suddenly panicked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1128: Lyna’s Message
paragraphs: It had been months since Kent and Adina parted ways back in the Valley of Torture.
Back then, Kent wanted only one thing, and that was for her to make it safely to Planet Mekyn, where she would get to live in peace, at least for a while, before those chasing her caught up.
Months had passed, and she had been living in peace until three days ago.
Three days ago, they received word that the Flame Humans had colluded with the Incubus of Planet Vornix—the same people chasing after her—and would be attacking them in two days’ time.
Naturally, this was unexpected, considering nobody knew she was there.
However, as it turned out, one of the Elven maids serving in the Elven Gardens was a spy planted by the humans. This has left her on edge, considering she had nowhere else to go.
So she and her two sisters, High Priestess Runa and Lady Enyo, have been working around the clock to prepare for battle.
Now, there is a literal immortal standing before them. Even though she had been suppressed to the Heavenly Ascension Stage, she is still a danger.
But what is worse is that she is also a messenger of a demigod who is related to demons.
Adina had been running from a Succubus Supreme this entire time, so she and the demons don’t see eye to eye. Now, there is a messenger from one of them.
Lady Enyo, sensing Adina’s mood, took her hand and gave it a gentle squeeze.
"Please, let’s go inside and talk." That sounded like a logical solution since Adina seemed to be on edge. They soon entered the mansion and took a seat in a large hall.
Adina remained by Lady Enyo’s side. She is one of the Planet Protectors, so being by her side seems like the safest place.

They still don’t know if this lady is after her or merely a harmless messenger, so they have their guards on high alert. It would be too bad if they were to lower their guard and let this dragon lady do anything to Adina.
"Pardon the tardiness, but if you don’t mind me asking, what is the message you have for me?" High Priestess Runa asked, keeping a polite smile to mask the nervousness in her eyes.
"No need to bother with that. I have been on the move for many months, so I don’t have any problem with a little inconvenience." Lyna smiled before taking out a scroll from her space ring.

"I am here merely to deliver this. Lord Agni would have come personally, but he has some personal issues to take care of, and so he instructed me to deliver it on his behalf." Lyna handed the scroll to High Priestess Runa.
She then added in a calm and cautious tone, "He said Lord Chaos will come for it, so you should keep it safe."
"Who is Lord Chaos?" High Priestess Runa asked.
Lyna, who had already been told how to handle this question, smiled. "Oh, Lord Agni said you people may know him by the name Kent Madson."
"Kent." Hearing a familiar name, all three ladies lightened up.
Kent’s name was like cold water poured on their beating hearts. Although Lyna is not a direct subordinate of Kent, she is a trusted subordinate of a subordinate of Kent who is also a demigod.
There is no way somebody like that will harm them. Kent would never harm Adina, for he had promised to protect her.
So, hearing that the scroll was for him, the three ladies calmed down.
However, Lady Enyo, who quickly traced back all Lyna said, widened her eyes when a thought suddenly surfaced in her mind.
"You called him Chaos and even said Lord Agni is the direct subordinate of the Primordial Chaos Dragon. Are you saying Kent is the legendary Primordial Chaos Dragon?"
Lyna, who was equally stunned when she learned of this from Lord Agni, nodded.
Several million years ago, Lord Agni saved Lyna’s mother from certain death. To pay him back, she vowed to serve him for all eternity.
However, Lord Agni had to go into hiding when he stole the first form of the legendary Primordial-grade technique—Finger of Destruction.
Due to this, the dragon lady he had saved long ago became a god.
This means she cannot serve him like she could if she were still an immortal.
The past year, Lord Agni went on a mission given to him by the Universe. This mission, unfortunately, exposed him, and his enemies started chasing after him, so he had to go on the run again.
However, he cannot be on the run and also deliver the scroll he retrieved from the Underworld to Planet Mekyn.
That would be too dangerous, so he sought out this Dragon Goddess, who assigned her youngest daughter, who is merely a True Immortal.
Lyna wasn’t prepared when she found out the owner of the scroll was the same person every god, demigod, and immortal has been relentlessly looking for.
Now, Lady Enyo, who also has her secrets, found out that one of the prominent figures to have ever lived is actually the same brat she had been dreaming about for months now.
"Lord Agni said this cannot be spread, not when Lord Chaos is still weak and cannot contend against immortals and gods.
So please keep it hush and don’t forget to keep the scroll safe."
The three ladies nodded. However, Lyna noticed a frown appear in their eyes, causing her to ask what was wrong.
"It is just that we are preparing for a war that is coming in two days, so the chances of keeping this scroll safe are very low. However, even if using our lives, we will keep them safe."
Lyna gritted her teeth slightly and then turned toward Adina. "Does this war have anything to do with her?" The ladies felt their backs break into cold sweats at her question.
Seeing this, Lyna smiled. "Don’t get me wrong. I have no plans to kidnap a succubus with an Extreme Yin Body Constitution.
However, I am an immortal, and I know how important people like her can be to immortals, gods, and even Supremes."

She turned and looked at High Priestess Runa and continued, "People like you two are destined to become Celestials. Your bodies are pure, and once you reach the Immortal Stage, your true potential will be unlocked.
So I can understand why your lives will be in danger."

Lyna sighed. "Since it has come to this, I will stay and fight with you. I will also send a message to a few friends I met along the way. I am sure they would love to have a good battle, especially if they knew they were fighting for a demigod."
"Thank you."
"Don’t bother. I am a dragon. As you already know, we dragons love to fight, so this is right up my alley. However, you three should be prepared to flee.
The fact that Lord Agni was instructed to deliver this scroll here is a clear indication that you are important to Lord Chaos. Protecting your lives is the only important mission for me."
The three ladies nodded.
Soon, they began planning for the coming battle. They had already sent word to the Ice Demons asking for assistance, but they were also preparing.

chapters.title: Chapter 1129: Ascension [End of Volume VI]
paragraphs: After spending time telling his wives all about the amazing people he met when he traveled to the past, Kent decided to spend some more weeks having sex with them, since the first few weeks after he ascended would be him entering seclusion to raise his strength and handle other issues.
Kent had a lot to do, but thanks to the tower, he was able to accomplish most of them while in his bed, surrounded by his wives.
In the end, however, he had to handle everything else that the tower couldn’t.
"You seven will go to Elarion; it is a kingdom of half-elves. You will stay there and use the treasures I have given you to grow stronger.
Afterward, the King and Queenie will open the Ascension Tower for you to ascend to a Supreme High World called Nictus.
Once you get there, visit the palace and tell whoever is there that Lord Chaos sent you. They will allow you to stay there as an honored guest.
After you break through to the Spirit Ascension stage, visit an auction house called Brown Maple. When you arrive, be sure to show them this badge; they will follow your command.

That will be your chance to get what you wanted. Personally, I would recommend finding a suitable sect to join. Knowing the kind of auction house they are, they will surely have some connections with power sects."
The seven disciples from the Celestial Gate Sect nodded in agreement.
Kent waited for them as promised, even though he could have ascended and come back later.
However, planning to end all things in the medium world before leaving, he waited for them, and now that they are here, he made arrangements for them.
"Thank you, Kent," Antlia, the captain of the team, said, bowing slightly.
"No need for that. You have long reached the stage to ascend, so take this as the final push to send you into glory," Kent said with a small smile before turning to Elder Lance.
"I was told you, too, will be ascending soon?" Kent asked, and Elder Lance nodded.
"Since you have provided ways to ascend to dozens of worlds, I think it is time to ascend. After all, I have already become much stronger now... all thanks to you."
Kent nodded, knowing it was indeed the fact. All the elders in the sect have become so much stronger now. In fact, they are all ready for the Supreme High Worlds.
It was all thanks to Kent’s generosity.

"Just don’t forget to take your care package from King Thalirion and Queen Jascia," Kent said in a calm tone. He had already made plans for all of them and would continue providing for them even after he was gone.
After all, they are all working toward making him a powerhouse one of these days. Their influence will also spread his power, so things will become much more vast in the future.
"Thank you, Kent."
The handsome dragon nodded.

He had already informed everyone that he was leaving—Nyss, Princess Elowen (Half-Elf Princess), and Princess Freya (Dwarven Princess), the seeded candidates, and Kent’s friends he had made in Elarion are all coming with him.
He planned to personally send them to a sect that would benefit them. He wanted them to grow independently, so separating them was his goal.
The sect had gathered to bid him farewell and good luck.
"Just take it easy, guys. In 12 years, win the Interplanetary Sect Competition again and then ascend to the next level. Trust me, there is so much fun in the high worlds."
The disciples nodded. To them, Kent is their idol, so his words are law. They will strive to work hard and chase after him.
"Also, follow all arrangements the elders will make for you when ascending. This way, you will have it much easier."

They nodded again. Kent then looked toward King Thalirion and Queen Jascia and smiled. "Don’t worry, I will take care of your daughter. She will be happy and well, so when you ascend, try to hold on till we meet."
They smiled and nodded to his words.𝒻𝘳ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝒷𝘯ℴ𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝑐ℴ𝑚
Suddenly, the sky began to darken. Kent waved at everyone and teleported away, appearing 12 miles away.
The tribulation was here, and he looked more relaxed than anything. This sight baffled everyone; however, Kent didn’t seem to care.
Soon, however, a bolt of lightning formed in the clouds, causing many to step back. They were far away, but they felt the danger.
RUMBLE
The bolt fell, and Kent, who was at the receiving end, raised his hand, and the bolt landed on his palm, sending a tickling sensation through his body.
This sight caused many to take a deep breath.

However, a few seconds later, the second bolt fell, this one much stronger and thicker than the first one. However, instead of raising another defense, he merely raised his hand and defended against the bolt.
"Damn."
The sight caused many to take a deep breath once again.
Finally, the last phase of the tribulation came. This time, the lightning was much deeper and darker. However, Kent merely raised his hand, and the lightning landed on his palm.
The moment he defended against the third lightning bolt, a portal opened in the air, and then a powerful sucking force locked on Kent.
Kent waved at everyone, and they also waved back.
Soon, Kent’s body was lifted off the ground and entered through the portal...
[Planet Mekyn]
On a grim battlefield where thousands of Elves, Incubi, Ice Demons, Dark Elves, and Flame Humans were locked in a deadly battle, one can sense the aura of death emanating everywhere.
From a quick observation, one could see the Incubi, Dark Elves, Ice Demons, and Flame Humans ganging up on the Elves.
However, despite the many of them ganging up on the smallest race on Planet Mekyn, they weren’t having it easy at all.
Still, no matter how strong they were, they were locked in with warriors from four powerful races. This meant they were not going to have it easy—and indeed, they were not having it easy at all.
Hundreds of Elves were dead, and more kept dying by the second.
"Runa, take Adina to the teleportation gate and prepare to send her away. Be sure to destroy it when she is gone," Lady Enyo, the Elven Planet Protector, said in a grim tone.
She had made arrangements to send Adina away to a random place and hoped she would end up in a good place. That was their last resort, considering the people were after her.
"Please, don’t send me away," Adina said, playing her zither, sending thousands of haunting sounds, runes, and wraiths at the attackers.
"You have to leave, Adina. We will buy you enough time," High Priestess Runa said, cutting through the torso of a Dark Elf, only to be pushed back by an Ice Demon.
Lady Enyo saw a dagger arrive before the High Priestess’s neck, and so she teleported before her and defended, only for an arrow to land on her shoulder, sending her flying hundreds of meters away.
High Priestess Runa and Lyna, the dragon lady who was making things hard for everyone, tried to move to her rescue. However, they were blocked, which left her exposed and at risk.

However, she was an experienced warrior, so she managed to regain her composure. The next second, though, three Heavenly Ascension Stage warriors appeared one meter from her—two stabbing their swords at her while the third locked an arrow aimed at her chest.
However, just when the arrow and the swords could land on her body, a beam of light filled with lightning descended and swallowed both Lady Enyo and the three Heavenly Ascension Stage warriors.
A second later, all three of them were thrown out, their bodies littered with burn marks.
Soon, the light beam dispersed, revealing a new person..
Lady Enyo, who seemed to have been poisoned, looked at the face of the new arrival, and her eyes widened.
"KENT!"
"MOM!"
(A/N: End of Volume VI: To Hell and Back. It was one hell of a ride and, well, much shorter compared to the previous volumes. However, it was a wild one nonetheless.
Next, Volume VII: Overlord in the High Worlds.)

chapters.title: Chapter 1130: Exterminate Them
paragraphs: Two days ago, the Elves on Planet Mekyn received word from the Ice Demons that they would aid them in the joint attack from the Flame Humans and the warriors from Planet Vornix.
This news came as a shock yet a welcome surprise to them.
Also, Planet Mekyn itself is a Legacy High World, while Planet Vornix is a Supreme High World.
They have more Heavenly Ascension–stage warriors than the Elves.
Of course, if it were only the Flame Humans, then perhaps, despite being outnumbered, they would have managed to withstand their attacks.
However, the Dark Elves and incubi of Planet Vornix are bad news. They have the numbers and the warriors, making them very difficult to deal with.
Getting confirmation that the Ice Demons would help them, since they were one of the few people with whom they had a good relationship, made them feel confident.
Nothing, however, prepared them for what happened when the armies from Planet Vornix and the Flame Humans arrived.
It is already a well-known fact that demons are cunning, so one would expect them to be cowards, too. As expected, they were indeed cowards.
They came as expected, not as allies but as enemies. They joined forces with the enemy, and that was what the Elves never saw coming.
---𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝚠𝚎𝚋𝗻𝗼𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝚘𝐦
[20 minutes ago]
"Traitors," High Priestess Runa shouted as she fired a powerful arrow formed from lightning at the Ice Demons. The arrow exploded into thousands of smaller arrows that rained down on them.
Hundreds died, with hundreds more sustaining injuries. Some of them managed to dodge and defend against the arrow.
However, despite all this, the Ice Demon king had a calm smile on his face as he gazed at the hopeless struggle of the Elves who had been besieged from both sides.

"No need to struggle, Runa. You should have accepted my offer and become my woman. None of this would have happened to you and your people if you had chosen to say yes. Now, I will be forced to kill your poor long ears and then claim you for myself."
A pale-faced demon with white ice horns spoke, looking at the struggling priestess who wanted nothing more than to drive an arrow through the bastard’s head.
The more she fought back against her enemies, the more they came.
Adina was seated at the back of the line playing her zither.
Mostly, when she played her zither, people felt their minds calm down, their brains lighten, as they entered a dreamlike state where, to them, nothing else mattered.
Many Elves had gained enlightenment through her music in the past months she had stayed with them.
However, today her music produced haunting sounds and wraiths, which kept devouring the souls of the incubi, Dark Elves, Flame Humans, and Ice Demons.
In essence, she had become a death composer whose music, instead of healing, was, rather, killing.
That was the kind of person she had to become in order to survive the evil of men aiming to take her freedom away. Her heart was now colder than ice, and so she could only continue to play her music.
As for Lady Enyo, she was being held back by three Heavenly Ascension–stage warriors. Two were from the Ice Demon and Flame Human races, while the last was an incubus.
However, one could tell she was proving her nature as a warrior by fighting them off while managing to kill a few randoms at the same time.
Lyna, however, was like a plague moving around the battlefield. Everywhere she passed, flames engulfed everything...
Perhaps thanks to her, the Elves were actually holding on to their dear lives...

Up in the clouds, inside a large ship, a rather handsome, pink-haired incubus sat in a majestic diamond throne, with two guards—a male and a female—standing behind him. They were both Peak Heavenly Ascension–stage warriors.
Standing in front of him were three Dark Elf Heavenly Ascension–stage warriors. One wielded a bow, while the two wielded swords.
"Kill that bitch with green hair and capture the blue- and pink-haired ones. The rest can be exterminated for all I care."
He spoke to the three warriors, who nodded and vanished from sight.
After they were gone, the lady guard spoke, "My king, we should leave soon. I was told the Midnight Shadows had sent an assassin after you. Knowing them, they will use this chaos to strike."

Supreme High King Bowie smirked, "Relax, Thana. I have you two protecting me. Plus, the whole of this ship is protected by a Tier 12 defense and offense array that can easily kill even a Peak Heavenly Ascension–stage cultivator. I couldn’t be safer than I am right now."
The female guard nodded and smiled.
Back on the battlefield, the three warriors appeared and immediately targeted Lady Enyo. The one carrying the bow aimed at her and fired an arrow, landing a perfect shot on her shoulder.
The impact from the arrow sent her flying back.

At that very moment, when she was sent flying, the two swordsmen lunged at her. The archer also did, but was a little behind, knowing that if his paralytic arrow didn’t work, he would have to land another one.
However, just when they thought victory was at their fingertips, a powerful beam came from the heavens and swallowed them.
The light even contained traces of lightning that burned and hurt like hell. The moment it swallowed them, they felt their stamina and health drain.
However, they were experienced warriors, so they sensed a powerful attack coming for them, causing them to use the momentum to escape the beam.
"What the hell?" the archer muttered, seeing he was burned in more than forty places. His body was virtually littered with burn marks.
The swordsmen didn’t have it easy either. They were equally burned in many places.
However, the beam soon cleared, and that was when they saw their attacker...
"A mere Spirit Ascension–stage warrior." One of the swordsmen felt his anger flare and was about to lunge at Kent when the green-haired beauty, who was slowly being paralysed, spoke.
"KENT!"
Kent’s focus was on the three warriors, so he only snapped back to the lady when he heard her speak. That voice he had heard many times. So when he heard it again, something snapped in him.
Turning his focus, he saw the face of a woman he had known for many years.
"MOM!"
The lady, with her eyes wide, let a smile appear on her face before she passed out.
Princess Lovina immediately jumped out of the tower and quickly cast a healing spell on her, taking the poison from her blood.
"She will be fine. It was a simple poison meant to paralyse her," Princess Lovina said in a reassuring tone. She was the poison expert, after all.
Hearing his mom, whom he thought he would never see again in this life or the next, is fine, Kent sighed. Kent took a deep breath and nodded.
"Take her to the Mountain Garden"
Princess Lovina nodded and teleported away with Lady Enyo.
He felt powerless for a moment. However, he recovered, and then his gaze turned to the three warriors.
Kent raised his hand, and 2,000 blood runes activated, causing him to exert so much pressure that it immediately sent the three crashing to their knees.
Kent’s gaze turned cold as he took one step forward. The ground beneath his feet cracks. However, it wasn’t the only thing that cracked.
CRACK
As if he meant it, the void cracked, and a wave of pressure descended on everyone.
"Exterminate them," Kent muttered coldly, causing the air to freeze.
Then a voice came from the void.
"Here I come."

This news came as a shock yet a welcome surprise to them.
Also, Planet Mekyn itself is a Legacy High World, while Planet Vornix is a Supreme High World.
They have more Heavenly Ascension–stage warriors than the Elves.

As expected, they were indeed cowards.
They came as expected, not as allies but as enemies.
They joined forces with the enemy, and that was what the Elves never saw coming.

chapters.title: Chapter 1131: Clearing Scums
paragraphs: Kaizo fell from the void, landing with a devastating thunder that instantly blasted away everyone in the impact zone.
Of course, he made sure he dropped in a zone dominated by the enemy soldiers, so all those who died from the shockwaves and those who were merely injured were all the enemy soldiers.
He stood up from the dust, standing 3 meters tall, his body covered in lightning armor.
Kaizo didn’t have to use his bloodline for this small battle; however, he had to, considering he was still in the process of breaking through to the Spirit Ascension stage.
"Die for me faster." With a single dash, hundreds were thrown into the air.
From within the void, all of Kent’s legion and wives started pouring out.
Alina, who saw the nature of the battle, quickly sealed the space, preventing anyone from leaving. Afterwards, she activated her killing formation and started targeting more enemies.
By then, Sylara had already begun her blood harvest.
There were hundreds of thousands of warriors to pick from, so she started, and in a way, she would be reforming her Blood Hunger Seal faster than she had hoped.
Kent wanted to take her to the savage region after they settled down in the high world, so she could form her Blood Hunger Seal. However, it seems she is way ahead of him now.
Selene took to the skies and started cutting through the warriors in the air. Unity, who had become much stronger, joined her while the rest of her sisters handled issues on the ground.

"Those Nethrans and Kathorians were too ugly, so I merely took their bodies from the Paragon Universe. However, now that I have more handsome and beautiful vessels, it looks like I will be having me some handsome incubus undeads soon."
Veera, the true necromancer in Kent’s legion, smiled as she unleashed her undead legion into the battle. She was one of the few who benefited greatly from their time in the Paragon Universe.
Thanks to the limitation lift in the Paragon Universe, she managed to gather undead that were comparable to Empyrean and even Life stage warriors in this universe.
Of course, thanks to the limitation in this universe, they were all now peak Heavenly Ascension stage warriors.
However, that is thousands of Heavenly Ascension stage warriors.
In no time, hundreds of Angels, Neburians, Nethrans, and more filled the entire battlefield. This sight sent everyone into a state of panic.
But she wasn’t the only one who had become a monster. Nykali, the Shade King, had also unleashed his thousands of undead spirits (Wraiths), filling the battlefield with howling and screeching sounds.
Naturally, those sounds were mixed with the true screams of the enemy, who started panicking.
Just Veera and Nykali were already enough to end this battle, considering all their undead legions were Heavenly Ascension stage warriors.
However, Kent wanted the enemy to feel true despair, so somebody like Neomi was on the battlefield killing like the mother of killers she was.
Lani’s laughter also filled the battlefield as she worked to remove more tattoos on her skin.
"Take no hostages. Kill them all."
Kent said as he unleashed three powerful swings, each releasing 450 sword arcs, shredding through the enemy.
His eyes were completely cold, killing intent radiating off them. The fact that he nearly lost his mother again, even if she had no idea how she was still alive, scared him.
So he was angry, and now, he was making them all pay.
"Kill them all," Kaizo echoed, and soon, the slogan "Kill them all" filled the battlefield.
"All Elves should retreat," High Priestess Runa shouted after she, Lyna, and Adina managed to move away from the chaos.
They lost thousands of warriors, but they are no longer needed on the battlefield.
"So that is Kent?" she asked, looking at the purple-haired, handsome young man whose sword was claiming lives on the battlefield.
"Yes," Adina nodded with a small smile as she watched the brat she had been missing for the past month. They had parted ways in the Valley of Torture, yet she couldn’t get him off her mind.

"I guess I now understand why the entire universe is searching for him," Lyna said, and then added, "He is beyond a monster. Just look at him; he is killing beings realms above him like it was nothing."
The two ladies nodded.
Just a minute ago, they were at the brink of death, but now, it seemed they would live to tell the tale of what happened here today.
"Runa, tell your people to stop this senseless massacre. We surrender," the same Ice Demon King who teased Runa now wanted to beg for his life.
His expression was dark.
Runa smirked and answered, "They are not my people, bastard. Can’t you see, or are you telling me those ugly eyes can’t see his ears are shorter than mine?"
Adina tried to laugh, but she managed to hold herself back.
Lyna, meanwhile, burst out in resounding laughter, one that made the expression on the Ice Demon’s face turn even darker.
"Maybe you should look behind you before asking for mercy."
The Ice Demon turned at once, sensing someone had appeared behind him. However, just when he turned, his gaze met the gaze of a one-eyed vampire demon.
"Hi, my name is Sylara." With that, the vampire lady’s fangs sank into his neck and sucked his blood and life out of him in one go.
His body instantly became weak. Sylara made sure to suck in his lifeblood so his stamina was drained, and so was his life.
"He is all yours," Sylara tossed his body toward High Priestess Runa, who unleashed four arrows, pinning the poor coward bastard to a large tree not far from them.
This is the elven garden, so there are trees around.
Kent turned and looked at the High Priestess, then at Adina and Lyna, before turning his gaze toward the ship hiding in the clouds.
A few seconds later, two heads fell from the clouds and landed with splat thuds. They burst open like watermelons before even landing on the ground.
The lady guard who stood behind the Incubus King appeared in the air and gave Kent a nod before vanishing into thin air.

It turned out the assassin sent from the Midnight Shadows had been her all along. Her mission was to kill the bastard, but because he was always surrounded by the three warriors that Kent killed using his blood runes’ pressure, she couldn’t.
Now, she had the chance, and it was all thanks to Kent.
Soon, only a few hundred enemy warriors were left, so Kent retreated and approached Adina, Lyna, and High Priestess Runa.
"Kent." Adina jumped into his arms, not caring whether or not she could control herself around him. Right now, she wanted to be in his arms.
Kent, of course, hugged her, making sure she felt safe and protected.
He looked at High Priestess Runa and Lyna and said, "I am Kent."
The two ladies nodded, already aware of his identity.
"I am High Priestess Runa of the Galen Elven Kingdom..." High Priestess Runa also introduced herself in the most polite way possible.
"I am Lyna Thalindra Drakana, a subordinate of Flame Lord Agni."
Kent raised his brow upon hearing Lyna’s words. However, before he could say anything, Vexthra appeared beside him.
"She will be waking up soon. Maybe take things inside. I will make sure the Elves prepare for migration."
Vexthra looked at Lyna and High Priestess Runa, then she turned her attention to Adina, who was curled up like a rabbit in Kent’s arms, and sent him a telepathic message.
’I approve.’
Kent smiled. "Thanks, Vex. I will reward you later."
High Priestess Runa wanted to ask a question; however, the next second, she found herself standing in a garden in a completely different place.

chapters.title: Chapter 1132: Lady Enyo is Awake
paragraphs: Kent’s gaze locked on the woman sleeping on the bed, and a wave of happiness washed over him. Despite having a stunned beauty in his arms, his focus was on the Elf lady sleeping.
"How is she?" Kent asked, and Princess Lovina smiled before giving him an answer.
"She should be waking up any moment now."
Kent nodded and looked at Adina. "If you will excuse me for just a moment,"
Adina nodded, knowing when to excuse herself. Lady Enyo seems like an important person to Kent, so she moved back.
Kent then moved toward the bed and sat down.
Meanwhile, Lyna and High Priestess Runa were stunned, looking at the majestic city below the mountain they were on.

Looking at the clouds, floating boats, butterflies, and many more, they were immediately captivated. They had seen many cities, but this was their first time seeing one mixed with a touch of something they hadn’t seen before.
Gaia blended modern and futuristic designs in building both Gaiaville and Blood City. So, watching the two cities, they were stunned.
Adina walked toward them, also taken aback by the breathtaking view.
Princess Lovina, who saw this smile, decided to excuse herself from Kent and his mom and instead focus on the three ladies who were brought into the tower by Kent.
Since he had made the decision to bring the elven race into the tower, there was no harm in taking them in with him.
Meanwhile, Kent took the woman’s hands and gave them a gentle squeeze. At the same time, she opened her eyes.

The first thing she saw was her son’s eyes. Although they were purple now, she could tell those eyes belonged to her son. She had been dreaming about him for months, but only remembered when she saw Kent in person.
"Kent," she called out, reaching for his face with her other hand.
Kent bent his head down, allowing her to touch his face.
"Mom, it’s me, your son," Kent said, tears forming in his eyes. Lady Enyo pulled him closer and gave him a hug, too, tears forming in her eyes as well.
Soon, the mother and son duo started shedding tears as they were finally reunited after years apart.

When Kent was 21, his parents got in a car accident and died. Their deaths shattered Kent very much. Of course, he missed them dearly, especially his mom, who had been his friend throughout his struggles.
When even his father gave up searching for ways to solve his erectile dysfunction problem, his mom kept on going until her last minutes.
She had worked extra hard, always making sure Kent had it all so that he would forget about his inconvenience and focus on other positive things.
In a way, she had been the main reason why Kent lived for as long as he did. He never remained the same after she died. So, Kent missed her, and now he couldn’t get enough of her.
"Mom, I miss you so much."
"I miss you too, my little pumpkin... Mom misses you so much."
The four ladies watching this could only sigh in their hearts. Princess Lovina, who wanted to give them some privacy, waved her hand, and a floating boat stopped by the edge of the mountain.
"Let’s go for a ride."
There was no way the ladies would reject such an offer, so they jumped onto the ship and left, leaving only Kent and his mom inside Mountain Garden.
After a while, the two managed to calm their emotions down.

Kent lifted his mom’s body and sat her on the bed, then sat beside her. He was extremely happy that, at the moment, all he wanted was to keep hugging her. However, he understood that catching up by understanding what happened was the key.
"So, how are you here?" Kent asked.
In his eyes and mind, his mother died 14 years ago. So how then is she here?
Lady Enyo took a deep sigh and started revealing what happened.

"So it turned out that making a wish when at your death’s door does move the hearts of the gods." She smiled weakly and added, "To you, it may be less than 20 years ago, considering you are just 21 years old now; however, to me, it has been 5,000 years already."
Kent raised his brow.
His mom died 14 years ago in an accident, so why has she been here for 5,000 years already? ’Did she time-travel?’ Kent wondered.
Lady Enyo smiled, looking at the expression on his face.
"Well, if I am to count the life of my half soul, then I have been living here for the past 67,000 years."
This time, Kent’s confusion became too much. "What do you mean by half soul?"
"So it turned out the me who gave birth to you on Earth was merely half of my soul. The other half had been living in a completely different world for thousands of years already."
"Wow... I didn’t see that coming."
"Yeah, your father didn’t see that big truck coming either," Lady Enyo joked, causing Kent to smirk.

"Now is not the time to make a joke about how you died, Mom. I already had to endure the pain, especially after that detective told me you and the old man had been arguing about me before the accident."
Lady Enyo’s expression turned dull, recalling what caused the accident. "I am sorry, Kent. I shouldn’t have joked about that."
"It’s okay, Mom. Let’s just focus on things that happened after your death."
’He is still being haunted by what happened to me.’ Lady Enyo had lived for a long time, so she knew when someone was traumatized by something.
’He cannot have this; else his journey in this life will be difficult.’ Obviously, they would have a big talk soon to clear this up.
This is a cultivation world where cultivation is a trial against nature. The stronger one grows, the freer they become of the Dao of the heavens.
That is how it had been designed.
Of course, things are much more complex than that, but to be free from the binds of the heavens, one has to go through many challenges, and often, most of these challenges deal with the heart.
The clearer one’s heart is, the smoother the ride. A tainted heart cannot become free of the heavens since a tainted heart is not perfect enough to attain divine sentience.

If Kent has a darker stain on his heart, that will become a blockage in his path to ascension. He will develop an unknown heart demon, the kind that has a tendency to block his path to what was promised to be a good ascension.
It will weaken him and eventually destroy him.
So Lady Enyo, who saw her son still hasn’t recovered from what he perceived as the cause of his parents’ death, knew this was something she could not allow to continue eating at him.
’I must deal with this early to avoid future complications.’
She noted that down.

She had only one son, and just when she thought she had lost him forever, he came back to her. Obviously, she was going to ensure nothing happened to him—not when, in this life, he had the means to protect himself.
She failed to give him the life he wanted back on Earth, but this time, she would not fail.

sentences.text: Kent’s gaze locked on the woman sleeping on the bed, and a wave of happiness washed over him.
Despite having a stunned beauty in his arms, his focus was on the Elf lady sleeping.
"How is she?" Kent asked, and Princess Lovina smiled before giving him an answer.
"She should be waking up any moment now."
Kent nodded and looked at Adina.
"If you will excuse me for just a moment,"
Adina nodded, knowing when to excuse herself.
Lady Enyo seems like an important person to Kent, so she moved back.
Kent then moved toward the bed and sat down.
Meanwhile, Lyna and High Priestess Runa were stunned, looking at the majestic city below the mountain they were on.
Looking at the clouds, floating boats, butterflies, and many more, they were immediately captivated.
They had seen many cities, but this was their first time seeing one mixed with a touch of something they hadn’t seen before.
Gaia blended modern and futuristic designs in building both Gaiaville and Blood City.
So, watching the two cities, they were stunned.
Adina walked toward them, also taken aback by the breathtaking view.
Princess Lovina, who saw this smile, decided to excuse herself from Kent and his mom and instead focus on the three ladies who were brought into the tower by Kent.
Since he had made the decision to bring the elven race into the tower, there was no harm in taking them in with him.
Meanwhile, Kent took the woman’s hands and gave them a gentle squeeze.
At the same time, she opened her eyes.
The first thing she saw was her son’s eyes.
Although they were purple now, she could tell those eyes belonged to her son.
She had been dreaming about him for months, but only remembered when she saw Kent in person.
"Kent," she called out, reaching for his face with her other hand.
Kent bent his head down, allowing her to touch his face.
"Mom, it’s me, your son," Kent said, tears forming in his eyes.
Lady Enyo pulled him closer and gave him a hug, too, tears forming in her eyes as well.
Soon, the mother and son duo started shedding tears as they were finally reunited after years apart.
When Kent was 21, his parents got in a car accident and died.
Their deaths shattered Kent very much.
Of course, he missed them dearly, especially his mom, who had been his friend throughout his struggles.
When even his father gave up searching for ways to solve his erectile dysfunction problem, his mom kept on going until her last minutes.
She had worked extra hard, always making sure Kent had it all so that he would forget about his inconvenience and focus on other positive things.
In a way, she had been the main reason why Kent lived for as long as he did.
He never remained the same after she died.
So, Kent missed her, and now he couldn’t get enough of her.
"Mom, I miss you so much."
"I miss you too, my little pumpkin...
Mom misses you so much."
The four ladies watching this could only sigh in their hearts.
Princess Lovina, who wanted to give them some privacy, waved her hand, and a floating boat stopped by the edge of the mountain.
"Let’s go for a ride."
There was no way the ladies would reject such an offer, so they jumped onto the ship and left, leaving only Kent and his mom inside Mountain Garden.
After a while, the two managed to calm their emotions down.
Kent lifted his mom’s body and sat her on the bed, then sat beside her.
He was extremely happy that, at the moment, all he wanted was to keep hugging her.
However, he understood that catching up by understanding what happened was the key.
"So, how are you here?" Kent asked.
In his eyes and mind, his mother died 14 years ago.
So how then is she here?
Lady Enyo took a deep sigh and started revealing what happened.

"So it turned out that making a wish when at your death’s door does move the hearts of the gods." She smiled weakly and added, "To you, it may be less than 20 years ago, considering you are just 21 years old now; however, to me, it has been 5,000 years already."
Kent raised his brow.
His mom died 14 years ago in an accident, so why has she been here for 5,000 years already? ’Did she time-travel?’ Kent wondered.
Lady Enyo smiled, looking at the expression on his face.
"Well, if I am to count the life of my half soul, then I have been living here for the past 67,000 years."
This time, Kent’s confusion became too much.
"What do you mean by half soul?"
"So it turned out the me who gave birth to you on Earth was merely half of my soul.
The other half had been living in a completely different world for thousands of years already."
"Wow...
I didn’t see that coming."
"Yeah, your father didn’t see that big truck coming either," Lady Enyo joked, causing Kent to smirk.
"Now is not the time to make a joke about how you died, Mom.
I already had to endure the pain, especially after that detective told me you and the old man had been arguing about me before the accident."
Lady Enyo’s expression turned dull, recalling what caused the accident.
"I am sorry, Kent.
I shouldn’t have joked about that."
"It’s okay, Mom.
Let’s just focus on things that happened after your death."
’He is still being haunted by what happened to me.’ Lady Enyo had lived for a long time, so she knew when someone was traumatized by something.
