chapters.title: Chapter 1133: Split Souls
paragraphs: After calming her mind down, Lady Enyo started to reveal what happened to her.
"Back on Earth, I was known as Renia, a mother and a psychiatrist. I was merely a human who loved her son more than anything."
Kent smiled, knowing his mom did love him... she loved him since he was an infant, and she did till her very last moment alive.
She provided for him and made sure he had everything he wanted.
Hearing her say all these words made him smile happily, knowing that if she had been alive, he would have made sure she never lacked anything.
He would have ensured she also had everything she wanted, just as she had provided for him.
Too bad she died before he had the chance to spoil her rotten.

"However, while that life sounded fun and amazing, somewhere far away, I was Meeri, daughter of the Nature Goddess Asterin. I was an immortal loved by my mother, who made sure I had everything, even when she had long become a god."
This time, Kent raised his brow, not understanding what was happening.
"It is not so complex, pumpkin. I was someone whose soul was separated at birth. My soul was, in a way, divided in half, one sent to a mundane world where I became your mother.

The other half was the prodigy daughter of an Elven Goddess who had climbed the ladder to the ranks of an Immortal Monarch before she was unceremoniously murdered by enemies of her mother, who sought to take everything from her."
Kent scratched his head, trying to make sense of what was happening.
"So you are saying you, my mother, had two lives and had lived the same in two different worlds — one as a mundane mother and the other as the goddess of war?"
Lady Enyo smiled. "I wouldn’t call myself the goddess of war, considering I nearly died from an arrow. Well, technically, I did die twice, as a mundane and an immortal."
Kent just smirked. He knew his mom too well. As a psychiatrist, she consistently found ways to connect with her patients.

One could see that Kent was her most beloved patient, considering she had used all the tricks in the book to get him, so she could sell him a life that had some semblance of peace and a sense of belonging.
She always had her humor and jests that made her likable and funny, often making one want to laugh when one most certainly didn’t want to.

"But yes, I was both. My immortal soul lived for 62,000 years before reuniting with my mundane soul. Now, I am whole, and it is all thanks to a rather handsome god who came to my rescue just when I needed a second chance."
Kent seemed to have grasped his mom’s situation.
She was an immortal with half her true soul. The other half was the mother he knew, but now she is whole, making her complete.
However, something wasn’t right.
If she were an immortal, then why is she a Heavenly Ascension Stage warrior right now?
"I know what you are thinking in that beautiful brain of yours," Lady Enyo said, taking Kent’s hand and giving it a gentle squeeze.
"You are wondering why an Immortal Monarch is now a Heavenly Ascension Stage warrior, huh?"
Kent nodded. ’I hate it when she reads my mind.’
He pursed his lips and smiled inwardly. This mother of his always found ways to know what he was thinking by merely looking him in the eyes.
Perhaps because she had been with him from when he was a mere infant, she knew him all too well, to the point that she could tell what he was thinking from his expressions and body language.
"The answer is rather simple. I am hiding from my enemies." Kent, of course, had this reason on his mind already. She did say she died twice.
The mundane death was due to a car accident. However, for an immortal to die, she might have met someone stronger than her.
"I told you I died twice, well, technically, I died one and a half." She paused and narrowed her eyes...
"Now that I think about it, can half a soul dying be considered full death? I mean, it was merely half of my soul, so if that is not full death, then technically, I only died once.
You know, mundane death and immortal death. Half plus half is one, according to my math teacher, Sir Godwin.

But then again, the immortal death was merely a way for me to slip away and buy myself some time to recover. So well, that does make me only half dead if you put everything into perspective... I mean that make—"
"Mom, please focus."
Kent had to cut his mom off, or else she would start on and on about the percentage of her death and would never stop until she figured out the missing x in the equation.
"So yes, I died as a mundane and as an immortal, and that dashing god brought my soul together and brought me to this world.
Thankfully, Lady Enyo, the name I am using right now, was my lookalike who had just died from her own enemies, so this handsome god gave me her life so I could have some semblance of peace and heal.
Then, when I am ready, I can go back home for revenge.
So, I suppose I have been recovering my immortal heart for 5,000 years now."
"This ’dashing’ god, do you happen to catch his name?" Kent asked, already suspecting someone.

"I don’t, but he said one day I will find out. He said that when I meet someone I trust and tell them about how I am still alive, I should say, ’No matter how handsome you are, you can never reach my level.’
You are the only one I trust and will trust, so I suppose I’ve finally gotten to say it. A very weird thing to say, but I can’t deny his words; he does look damn ripped for the picking."
Kent scoffed, but he couldn’t wipe the idea that his own mother thinks Paragon is more handsome than him.
"No need to look at me like that, pumpkin. He is eye candy for sure, but you are on another level."

"Tch, you don’t have to lie to me, Mom. That bastard is certainly handsome, but that is because the version of him that you met was a god, and I am mortal now. Just give me a few years, and I will cause celestials to drool."
"Somehow, I know you will pull it off."
The mother and son duo laughed.
The only person who can take two souls and put them together is the Paragon. He is that kind of person who does the impossible as if it were a normal thing to do.
’Just how deep did my relationship with Paragon go? So far, he had helped me three times, and each instance of help was major. What is his end goal here?’
Kent couldn’t help but wonder what Paragon’s endgame was.
He gave him the ’Soul Universe’, then he went ahead and gave him his sword ’Gaap’, which led him to Hell, where he became one of the Kings of Hell.
Now, he had saved his mother, whom he thought was long dead. All these events seemed to have shaped his life in ways he couldn’t begin to comprehend.
So he just didn’t understand why Paragon was going through all this trouble to help him.

If only Kent knew that saving Paragon and his wives during the world awakening was an event that Paragon had been trying hard to pay him back for years, yet he still didn’t think he had done enough, so he would keep doing it until he had done enough.
That is how grateful a Paragon is to his friends, especially one who had saved him from certain death.

chapters.title: Chapter 1134: Catching Up
paragraphs: Kent allowed himself to calm down first before considering what all this meant.

’So, mother is on the run from her enemies. Thankfully, she managed to find a place to hide and recover from her injuries. However, she is also now exposed, considering this battle has drawn attention.
Mainly, because my name will soon spread, and if linked to the Galen Elven kingdom, all the Elves will be in trouble.
Thankfully, I have the tower and the tower points to accommodate them. That is one issue solved. Now, I have found a way to cure her and take her back home.
Naturally, she would love that, considering no immortal would like to run from trouble, especially an Elf who is also an immortal Monarch. Her pride will now allow her to run.’
Kent sighed and then lay his head on his mom’s shoulder, asking, "Mom, do you want to go back home?"
"Of course. I want to kill those bastards with my own two hands... I will kill them and their entire generation for thinking they can come against me and go scot-free."
Kent smiled. ’Ah, she never changes, huh?’
Of course, the mother he knew was a mundane, but she takes her threats very seriously. He remembered his sophomore year when he was bullied by Big Billie.
When his mom found out, she stormed Big Bill’s dad’s firm and threatened to burn the poor man’s scrotum with a blowtorch.
The next day, Big Billie was transferred, and that was the last time anyone dared mess with him in that school.
Hearing her words and knowing she now had the power, he had no doubt that she would indeed go through with it.
’She never changes.’
"You will get your revenge because I will make sure of it. However, let’s focus on what we can handle first, and that is finding out what happened to your heart and how to cure it."
Lady Enyo nodded and was about to speak when Kaizo appeared in the tower.
"Kaizo, buddy, what is wrong?" Kent asked, seeing the battle-mad undead standing before them.
Kaizo looked at Lady Enyo for a couple of seconds and then smiled. "Nice meeting you, Mother. I am Kaizo, the one who kept him alive all these years."
Kent clearly didn’t see that coming, so his brows furrowed on their own.
"Thank you, Kaizo. I appreciate you protecting my son. He can be hotheaded sometimes, but seeing him alive and well, I have no doubt you did an amazing job."

"Thank you, Mother." Kaizo grinned and then turned to Kent. "Oh, we have killed all the scums, and Lady Neomi suggested we expand the horizon, so we are going to the Ice Demon Kingdom next and make sure all parties involved are handled. Then we will go to the Flame Human Nation to handle them too.
Afterwards, we will head to Planet Vornix to exterminate those horny bastards and the long ears... no, no offense, Mother."
"None taken."
Kaizo smiled and asked, "Of course, the innocent will be spared. So what do you think?"
Kent was still in shock, so he said nothing. Naturally, this was a mistake...
"Wonderful. They mostly say silence means yes, so see you later, master."
With that, the undead bastard teleported back to the outside world, and soon, he led the legion and Kent’s wives away to commit mass massacre.
"Who is that? He is a delight, almost like a more muscular version of you," Lady Enyo said, causing Kent’s mouth to twitch.
"I am nothing like Kaizo."
Of course, that is a lie. Kent created Kaizo based on his own personality. He is unyielding, battle-hungry, and very adamant about seeing the matter to an end.
He knew he would have made the same decision Kaizo made, even if he used Neomi’s name to ask, knowing Kent would soften and approve his request if it was from his wives.
However, he would have probably killed billions if he had been too late to his mom’s rescue.
Lady Enyo seemed to be enjoying the myriad of expressions on Kent’s face. "You know, before we talk about my issues, how about you tell me about your life?"
Lady Enyo asked, and Kent could only sigh.
Kaizo was just too unyielding. However, he knew it had to be done, since these people had dared to come after his mother and her people.
They’d crossed a line, and so they must pay the consequences.
Kent pulled his mind back to his mom’s request, and so he decided to tell her what had happened to him after she died.
He told her everything, from how he earned his degree and PhD in computer science and engineering. However, instead of working on solving the world’s problems, he decided to become a movie director.
This point took his mom aback; however, as someone who had always wanted her son to be happy, she knew that if movie-making was what made him happy, she was more than happy for him.
Then he told her about the many awards he won. However, he excluded the part where he pivoted to directing adult films and even started his own adult movie studio, which ultimately led to his death.
Of course, he made sure she understood that he was murdered by a jealous and overly competitive rival.
Then, just when he thought his life had come to a bitter end, he got a second chance at life, where he got to have all he couldn’t have on Earth.
By the time Kent ended his narrative, Lady Enyo was hugging his arm tightly.
"I am sorry, Kent. I had no idea you had it that bad after I died."

"Nothing to worry about, Mom. You did your best for me, and that was what helped me keep moving even after you were gone. If anything, I should be thanking you for giving me an amazing life. Not many get to have an amazing mother like you."
Lady Enyo nodded. She had missed her son so much, even if she had just remembered him. To someone who had lived for thousands of years, it felt like she hadn’t seen him in thousands of years.
That was a very long time for someone to be apart from their loved ones.
"So you have wives, huh?" Of course, hearing he had wives made her happy. He never got to have that in his life on Earth, so hearing he was living a good life now made her happy.
"Yes. I have 19 of them now, but more will be added soon."
Lady Enyo smirked. "I suppose Adina is one of the ’soon,’ huh?"𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
"That is only natural."
"Tch." The woman smirked, but she was genuinely happy for her son.
"I want to meet them," she requested, and Kent nodded in agreement.
"You will, when they are done releasing their anger on the bastards who dare hurt their mother-in-law."
Talk about leaving a good impression. Naturally, there was nothing better than going on a revenge killing for one’s mother-in-law after she had nearly died at the hands of the enemy.
That would certainly give them a good score.
Even Vexthra, who was a goddess, was out there making sure she also scored some brownie points by helping the elves migrate into the tower.
Kent scoffed, "You three do know we can see you hiding behind the tree, right?"
Gaia, Dori, and Akira poked their heads from behind a tree and looked at Kent and his mom. When Lady Enyo saw the three troublemakers, her expression brightened.
"Who are these adorable little nuggets?"

"Oh, we have killed all the scums, and Lady Neomi suggested we expand the horizon, so we are going to the Ice Demon Kingdom next and make sure all parties involved are handled.
Then we will go to the Flame Human Nation to handle them too.
Afterwards, we will head to Planet Vornix to exterminate those horny bastards and the long ears... no, no offense, Mother."
"None taken."
Kaizo smiled and asked, "Of course, the innocent will be spared.
So what do you think?"
Kent was still in shock, so he said nothing.
Naturally, this was a mistake...
"Wonderful.
They mostly say silence means yes, so see you later, master."
With that, the undead bastard teleported back to the outside world, and soon, he led the legion and Kent’s wives away to commit mass massacre.
"Who is that?
He is a delight, almost like a more muscular version of you," Lady Enyo said, causing Kent’s mouth to twitch.
"I am nothing like Kaizo."
Of course, that is a lie.
Kent created Kaizo based on his own personality.
He is unyielding, battle-hungry, and very adamant about seeing the matter to an end.
He knew he would have made the same decision Kaizo made, even if he used Neomi’s name to ask, knowing Kent would soften and approve his request if it was from his wives.
However, he would have probably killed billions if he had been too late to his mom’s rescue.
Lady Enyo seemed to be enjoying the myriad of expressions on Kent’s face.
"You know, before we talk about my issues, how about you tell me about your life?"
Lady Enyo asked, and Kent could only sigh.
Kaizo was just too unyielding.
However, he knew it had to be done, since these people had dared to come after his mother and her people.
They’d crossed a line, and so they must pay the consequences.
Kent pulled his mind back to his mom’s request, and so he decided to tell her what had happened to him after she died.
He told her everything, from how he earned his degree and PhD in computer science and engineering.
However, instead of working on solving the world’s problems, he decided to become a movie director.
This point took his mom aback; however, as someone who had always wanted her son to be happy, she knew that if movie-making was what made him happy, she was more than happy for him.
Then he told her about the many awards he won.
However, he excluded the part where he pivoted to directing adult films and even started his own adult movie studio, which ultimately led to his death.
Of course, he made sure she understood that he was murdered by a jealous and overly competitive rival.
Then, just when he thought his life had come to a bitter end, he got a second chance at life, where he got to have all he couldn’t have on Earth.
By the time Kent ended his narrative, Lady Enyo was hugging his arm tightly.
"I am sorry, Kent.
I had no idea you had it that bad after I died."
"Nothing to worry about, Mom.
You did your best for me, and that was what helped me keep moving even after you were gone.
If anything, I should be thanking you for giving me an amazing life.
Not many get to have an amazing mother like you."
Lady Enyo nodded.
She had missed her son so much, even if she had just remembered him.
To someone who had lived for thousands of years, it felt like she hadn’t seen him in thousands of years.
That was a very long time for someone to be apart from their loved ones.
"So you have wives, huh?" Of course, hearing he had wives made her happy.
He never got to have that in his life on Earth, so hearing he was living a good life now made her happy.
"Yes.
I have 19 of them now, but more will be added soon."
Lady Enyo smirked.
"I suppose Adina is one of the ’soon,’ huh?"𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
"That is only natural."
"Tch." The woman smirked, but she was genuinely happy for her son.
"I want to meet them," she requested, and Kent nodded in agreement.
"You will, when they are done releasing their anger on the bastards who dare hurt their mother-in-law."
Talk about leaving a good impression.
Naturally, there was nothing better than going on a revenge killing for one’s mother-in-law after she had nearly died at the hands of the enemy.
That would certainly give them a good score.
Even Vexthra, who was a goddess, was out there making sure she also scored some brownie points by helping the elves migrate into the tower.
Kent scoffed, "You three do know we can see you hiding behind the tree, right?"
Gaia, Dori, and Akira poked their heads from behind a tree and looked at Kent and his mom.
When Lady Enyo saw the three troublemakers, her expression brightened.
"Who are these adorable little nuggets?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1135: The Three Cosmic Troublemakers
paragraphs: "Mom, meet Gaia, Akira, and Dori. They are my cosmic assistants," Kent introduced the three troublemakers to his mom, who seemed already charmed by how cute and tiny they looked.
’She is a lost cause. At this rate, when Li Hua, the scammer, is added, she will sell all her belongings and spend the money on them.’
Kent shook his head.
Gaia was a good girl until she met Li Hua. Now, she is also a lover of money, and while Kent had no idea what she needed the money for, she had already spent a substantial amount of his wealth.
Not that he minded that.
The three cosmic lolis and their money-loving sister Li Hua are just too cute to be mad at.
"Come here, little ones," Lady Enyo opened her arms, and the three lolis jumped in for a hug.
"Big brother’s mom is very beautiful," Gaia said, and her two sisters nodded in agreement.
"Well, thank you, ladies." Lady Enyo smiled and looked at Kent... She was happy to have finally reunited with her son, but who would have thought he came with three added packages?
"Have you been treating them well?" she asked with a gaze that said, ’better not lie to me.’
Kent smirked, seeing this was just a ploy his mom was using to make the three lolis in her arms like her more.
"I have been good and hospitable to them. You can ask them and they will tell you how amazing I was to them."
Lady Enyo looked at the ladies and winked...
Gaia smiled evilly and answered, "Big brother is good to us. He made sure we got to do everything and also made us work construction just to build a fancy city for people."
"What?"

Lady Enyo glared at her son, causing Kent to raise his hand in surrender. "Don’t look at me. They wanted to do it, and frankly speaking, there is nobody more qualified than them... and I meant that literally, they are the best."

"That is true. We are indeed the best," Akira said, her shoulders raised, before adding, "However, big brother never even checked up on us to see if we were able to lift the iron rods, glass windows, and all the other heavy stuff.
One time, I tripped and nearly fell to my death. Meanwhile, big brother was away enjoying life out there."
"Dori is telling the truth. I even pricked my finger when cutting a glass." Gaia showed her tiny finger to Lady Enyo, who saw that there was indeed a prick.
"Come here," Kent moved toward his mom, only to get his ear pulled and pinched, sending a tickle of pain through his neck and body.
"How can you make such adorable nuggets work in construction? If you want a fancy building, why don’t you build it yourself? Or are you telling me you are not man enough?"
"Yes, are you telling Grandma you are not man enough?" Akira said and grabbed the other ear. However, because she had tiny hands, there was enough room for Gaia and Dori to join in.

Soon, Kent’s ears had turned red, and he could only admit his mistakes and plead for mercy. "I admit I was wrong in making such adorable fairies work in construction. I will not make such a mistake ever again."
"You better," Lady Enyo said with a small smile.
"Yes, you’d better," Akira and her sisters said before releasing Kent.
The Chaos Dragon looked at the three troublemakers and smiled. When they saw this smile, their little bodies shuddered, causing the smile on Kent’s face to bloom.
"If he bullies you again, report to me."
However, they recovered the next second, hearing Lady Enyo’s words. They knew that with her around, Kent could not do anything to them.
However, just for confirmation, Akira asked, "Grandma, will you be staying with us from now onwards?"
Lady Enyo cupped Akira’s little cheeks and answered, "Of course. This is my son’s home, so I will be staying here from now on. Of course, he can try sacking me and see what I will do to him."
"Yay."
The three comic troublemakers jumped down and started celebrating.
Kent just shook his head, knowing this was all part of life. However, the fact that his three little assistants told on him and even made him appear like the bad guy clearly took him aback.
After all, the three ladies begged him to allow them to build the city. Gaia even named the First City Gaiaville, where she is the mayor.
So, where does the blame lie, making it seem like he was the one who made them carry blocks and iron rods?
"Since Grandma will be staying here, it means there is going to be a new city." Gaia adjusted a small pair of eyeglasses that miraculously appeared on her face.

She then waved her hand, and a large scroll appeared, even taller than her. "Since Grandma and her people will need a city, I took the liberty of creating a design plan for a nature-inspired city, something that will suit the elves and also add a touch of natural flair to the city.
It will be a blend of nature, modern, and futuristic design, one that will become their home for generations to come."
Gaia looked at her sisters and nodded. "Of course, based on the urgent nature of how this project will be undertaken, it will cost you three times what it usually costs."

Kent glared at Gaia, who puffed her cheeks and raised three tiny fingers. "That will be three billion in tower points. You have 3.4 billion tower points, and so if we take the three billion and 200 million as our workmanship, you will be left with 200 million to spend on yourself.
All you have to do is sigh or thumbprint here."
Before Kent could even move, somebody pushed his hand, and he thumb-pressed on the paper. Turning around, he saw Akira smiling at him.
"Nice doing business with you, big brother. We will get to work right away and have a city ready by the end of the week."
Kent could only stare at the three lolis running away, his expression ugly.
His mom was holding her stomach since she couldn’t hold back her laughter.
"These little nuggets, I will get them later," Kent sighed and sat beside his mom.
"They are adorable." She seemed chummy with them already, so seeing them mess with Kent was a welcome addition to her joy of finally reuniting with her son.𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂
"You shouldn’t enable them, Mom. Trust me, they are troublemakers who would use every opportunity they get to mess with me.
Now knowing you are their bestie, my life will be miserable from now onwards."
"I see nothing wrong with that. In fact, I like them more knowing they are capable of doing so much with their little bodies," Lady Enyo chuckled.

"They are cosmic beings, Mom. Even if a planet falls on them, they wouldn’t feel a thing. The only person in the universe that can hurt them is me, and so they want to use you as their shield, so I can’t give them a proper spanking."
Lady Enyo chuckled and slowly stood up. "I don’t mind becoming their shield if it means enabling them to make you pay back all the troubles you have caused me when growing up."
"You—"
Kent sighed and also stood up. "I will just kick you four out and have my peace of mind then."
They left the garden and started exploring the two cities.

chapters.title: Chapter 1136: Meeting In-Laws
paragraphs: Kent and his mom left the mountain garden and headed to Gaiaville, where the humans who once worked for the Alderfords’ (Lilian and Elsa’s family) now live.
They had to come here since their lives were in danger back then.
Kent knew if he hadn’t taken them away, the Hand would have killed them all just to get back at him. Now, a lot has happened, and they are thriving in their peaceful utopia.
Most of them are in seclusion in a place Gaia calls the Cultivation Garden to break through to the Spirit Ascension stage.
It turned out that right when Kent ascended, the tower underwent some upgrades and changes. One of the upgrades is the time running in the cities.
Now, the times running there have synced with the outside world. So, in both Gaiaville and Blood City, one hour corresponds to one hour in the outside world.
This was done because, despite 24 days being 24 hours on the outside, the people living there are not aging that fast. Their aging is being calculated by the time in the outside world.
So the tower had corrected that.
Naturally, a lot of work went into that.

However, one of the best and most unique aspects of the tower is its time difference. Twenty-four days inside are equivalent to one day outside. That sounded like a haven for cultivators, and so Gaia and her sisters aren’t about to take that from them.
So they fixed it by creating places where they can have the same time advantage. They called it the Cultivation Garden, where 24 days inside are equivalent to one day in the city.
However, the Harem, Alchemy, Sword, and Legion Towers have the same time as before.

Aside from that, the spiritual energy in the air is rather thick and potent. Kent had been to Supreme High Worlds, but he knew for a fact that the concentration of Spiritual Qi inside the tower was very potent.
Too bad he doesn’t level up using Spiritual Qi, but blood.
Of course, he already has plans to raise his cultivation once he has shown his mom around and ensured she has settled in.
"This place is very beautiful," Lady Enyo said, holding Kent’s hand as they walked down the street of Gaiaville.

Only a few people were present. Most of the buildings didn’t even have occupants, so this wasn’t a new sight to Kent. He knew adding more people to the tower was the only way to solve the emptiness of the city.
The Elves are coming, and so he knew for a fact the empty houses would have people living in them soon.
Of course, Gaia and her sisters are building them a city, but many will soon come to occupy the empty houses.
"This is a place only those who have my permission can enter, so of course, it ought to be beautiful," Kent bragged, feeling like he had accomplished something grand.
And well, he did accomplish something grand. Having something as powerful and magical as the tower is already an accomplishment.
Lady Enyo turned and looked at her son. The sight of him smiling made her smile also. "I am so proud of you."
Kent nodded and led her toward a building that was surrounded by plants and herbs. This is the building where Elaine’s parents live.
When they reached one of the herb gardens, they saw Elaine’s father watering some of the herbs with nothing but a mere wave of his hand.
Not far from him, his wives were also growing seeds. Thanks to Alina, she now has the means to cultivate herbs.
She may not have Elaine and her father’s bloodline; however, she is perfect in her own way, thanks to Alina and her Primordial Spirit.𝘧𝑟𝑒𝑒𝘸𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝓁.𝘤𝘰𝓂
"Kent, you are here." Elaine’s mom was the first to notice them.
Kent waved at her, and she waved back. "Long time no see, Mother-in-law. Father-in-law," Kent said, feeling glad these two had yet to enter seclusion. He really wanted his mom to meet them after all.
"Glad to see you again, Kent," His father-in-law said.
Kent nodded and then turned to his mother.
"Mom, these are my in-laws. You are yet to meet their daughter, but she is one of my many wives."
Kent then turned to his in-laws and said, "Everyone, this is my mom."
The two in-laws were visibly surprised, causing them to furrow their brows in stunned silence. They turned and looked at each other before turning back to Kent and his mom.
Their eyes switch between them, many questions popping up in their heads.
Lady Enyo smiled weakly and spoke.

"No need to wonder. I am an Elf, and my son is a dragon. It will be hard to explain this weird genetic make-up, but he is indeed my son." Lady Enyo had already read their minds from their expressions.
However, she indeed has no way of explaining why her son is a dragon while she is an Elf. It simply doesn’t make sense, and they are aware of that.
Even Kent had to scratch his head a bit. "She is telling the truth, I am indeed her only son."
"No need to explain yourselves. It was our mistake in making such expressions," Elaine’s mother said with a small smile. Her husband nodded.
"Nice meeting you, my Lady. Your son has been a pleasure to have around. Thanks to him, we got to reunite with our daughter, and now he is making her the happiest woman in the universe."
Lady Enyo nodded. "He takes after me."
Kent nodded; he indeed took after his mom, but in good looks and intelligence. His shameless womanizing lifestyle, however, came from his father.
That man was one dangerous player, and Kent is making him proud wherever he is.
"We just came by to say hi and continue to Blood City. However, we will be back for dinner, so please prepare the usual."
Elaine’s mom smiled and nodded. "I know you like it more than my daughter, so don’t worry, I will cook the usual."
Kent smiled. "Don’t be silly, Mother-in-law. You know your daughter is everything to me. Though don’t mention it to her, she will probably bury me in one of her many graves."
Kent and his in-laws laughed while Lady Enyo wondered what the usual food was that her son seemed to love more than his women.
’Traitor. He used to like my cooking more than anything, but now it seems I have been replaced.’ Lady Enyo gave Kent a vicious stare, which made the poor dragon shudder like a puppy.
’Just wait, I will get back at you.’
"See you this evening, Father-in-law, Mother-in-law." Kent knew staying any longer and laughing with his in-laws would sign his early death certificate, so he pulled his mom away.
Once they were gone from sight, Elaine’s father and mother sighed.
"Like mother, like son, I guess," Elaine’s father said, taking another deep sigh before adding, "That woman is dangerous."
"I know, right? It felt like I was staring into the eyes of an immortal."
"Same here. We must make sure to impress her with our food, so please, go all out on the cooking today. Bring out the genius I know you have and make it a memorable one."
"I will do my best."
Kent intentionally used the Soul Map to listen to what his in-laws were saying. Hearing them plan a good meal made his stomach excited.
Lady Enyo smirked, but she felt happy inwardly that at least her son had a mother and a father figure who seemed to have won him over with their food.
Kent was all about food back when he was a teenager. Now, it seems he hadn’t changed, even though he can go a thousand years without food.
They soon reached Blood City; however, only a few children and their mothers were around. All warriors and new cultivators are inside the Cultivation Garden cultivating.
Kent knew they would have to come back later, so he and his mom left the tower to handle the migration of the Elves.
Since the time difference has been resolved in the cities, they will return in the evening to have dinner with Elaine’s parents.
Meanwhile, Kaizo and his team had started making waves all over Planet Mekyn and beyond.

It will be hard to explain this weird genetic make-up, but he is indeed my son." Lady Enyo had already read their minds from their expressions.
However, she indeed has no way of explaining why her son is a dragon while she is an Elf.
It simply doesn’t make sense, and they are aware of that.
Even Kent had to scratch his head a bit.
"She is telling the truth, I am indeed her only son."
"No need to explain yourselves.
It was our mistake in making such expressions," Elaine’s mother said with a small smile.
Her husband nodded.
"Nice meeting you, my Lady.
Your son has been a pleasure to have around.
Thanks to him, we got to reunite with our daughter, and now he is making her the happiest woman in the universe."
Lady Enyo nodded.
"He takes after me."
Kent nodded; he indeed took after his mom, but in good looks and intelligence.
His shameless womanizing lifestyle, however, came from his father.
That man was one dangerous player, and Kent is making him proud wherever he is.
"We just came by to say hi and continue to Blood City.
However, we will be back for dinner, so please prepare the usual."
Elaine’s mom smiled and nodded.
"I know you like it more than my daughter, so don’t worry, I will cook the usual."
Kent smiled.
"Don’t be silly, Mother-in-law.
You know your daughter is everything to me.
Though don’t mention it to her, she will probably bury me in one of her many graves."
Kent and his in-laws laughed while Lady Enyo wondered what the usual food was that her son seemed to love more than his women.
’Traitor.
He used to like my cooking more than anything, but now it seems I have been replaced.’ Lady Enyo gave Kent a vicious stare, which made the poor dragon shudder like a puppy.
’Just wait, I will get back at you.’
"See you this evening, Father-in-law, Mother-in-law." Kent knew staying any longer and laughing with his in-laws would sign his early death certificate, so he pulled his mom away.
Once they were gone from sight, Elaine’s father and mother sighed.
"Like mother, like son, I guess," Elaine’s father said, taking another deep sigh before adding, "That woman is dangerous."
"I know, right?
It felt like I was staring into the eyes of an immortal."
"Same here.
We must make sure to impress her with our food, so please, go all out on the cooking today.
Bring out the genius I know you have and make it a memorable one."
"I will do my best."
Kent intentionally used the Soul Map to listen to what his in-laws were saying.
Hearing them plan a good meal made his stomach excited.
Lady Enyo smirked, but she felt happy inwardly that at least her son had a mother and a father figure who seemed to have won him over with their food.
Kent was all about food back when he was a teenager.
Now, it seems he hadn’t changed, even though he can go a thousand years without food.
They soon reached Blood City; however, only a few children and their mothers were around.
All warriors and new cultivators are inside the Cultivation Garden cultivating.
Kent knew they would have to come back later, so he and his mom left the tower to handle the migration of the Elves.
Since the time difference has been resolved in the cities, they will return in the evening to have dinner with Elaine’s parents.
Meanwhile, Kaizo and his team had started making waves all over Planet Mekyn and beyond.

chapters.title: Chapter 1137: Revenge
paragraphs: "Listen up," a voice boomed across a vast city where the temperature had plummeted to nearly zero. Many hearts shuddered at the harrowing tone that entered their ears.
"My name is Kaizo, number one servant of the legendary Kent Madson." Sylara, Vaelros, and the rest of Kent’s legion smirked, but Kaizo didn’t mind them.

"If you are hearing my name now, then know that the only reason why you are alive is due to the mercy of my master. However, that mercy only extends to some people, meaning if you are hearing my voice, then you are about to die.
Your useless king and his lackeys thought they could take advantage of the misfortune of the Elves and use it to plunder. However, they met me and my friends.
This means we are here for revenge. So please, do well to say your goodbyes and prepare to die."
After saying that, Alina produced a scroll and unfurled it, opening it wide. In an instant, runes started glowing on it.
Soon, the air behind Kaizo and the legion turned into a beautiful painting of a garden.
Alina smiled and then formed a hand seal before shouting, "Celestial Portrait of the Eternal Garden, activate."
The large, picturesque painting hummed to life as more runes appeared. Then it began to change, becoming real.
However, this change stopped a few seconds in. But by then, the painting had turned semi-real. A powerful pressure came from it, forcing many in the city to their knees.
A staff came from the painting and landed in Alina’s palm.
She then pointed it at the painting and called out, "Come forth, Merizi; you are summoned."
The moment Alina said that, a portal opened in the painting and an ethereal figure appeared from it, holding a wooden staff.
She stopped before Alina and bowed. "I am at your service, my queen."
Alina smiled and nodded.
"You already know what to do with those who deserve to die."
"As you command, my queen."
Merizi flew into the air, positioning herself at the center of the city. Nobody dared attack her. After all, attacking an immortal was bad news, and they could sense that.
The limitation is not working on Merizi, so her Immortal King aura is bearing down on them.
After she reached the center of the city, she waved her wooden staff, and runes started appearing in the air.
"Who is that?" Lilian moved closer to Alina and asked.

"She used to be my servant in my past life, I guess. After all, I painted the Celestial Portrait of the Eternal Garden to keep those I wish to carry with me and criminals I couldn’t bring myself to kill."
"Oh, so how do we know that Merizi isn’t a criminal but a servant?" Elsa asked a follow-up question, to which Alina laughed.
"She couldn’t rebel if that is what you are worried about. The garden is a Celestial Item. Unless those housed inside are stronger than Celestial, breaking free is impossible.

Of course, I didn’t know much yet, since I had just gained the authority to use the Celestial Portrait of the Eternal Garden again. However, I did know Merizi would get the job done without any mistakes."
The ladies turned and looked at Merizi, who was deep in drawing the runes...
"What is her ability?"
"She can isolate scums from the innocent ones. Just watch and you will understand."

After a few minutes, the runes merged, and a large formation appeared in the air. Just when it appeared, thousands of ice demons vanished from wherever they were hiding, leaving the whole city in chaos.

"Where did they go?" Kaizo asked, not understanding what had just happened. Alina had told him she had a way to pick the bad seeds from the good ones. So in his heart, he was expecting her to pick the bad so they could massacre them.
However, now the targets are gone, and he has no idea where they are.
Alina smiles and shrugs. "I have no idea, Kaizo."
"What do you mean you have no idea? Aren’t you the same person who let out Merizi? Ask her."
"Okay."
Alina flew toward Merizi and asked, "Where did you send them?"
Merizi looked at Alina and answered, "I have no idea."

"Told you. Even she doesn’t know where these people will end up, so maybe we should handle the flame humans next, seeing Merizi still has a couple of hours left before she has to return to the garden."
Kaizo smirked.
When he brought up the idea that they should attack the Flame Humans and Ice demons, he had no plans on how to actually do it. All he knew was they wouldn’t be killing the innocents.

However, as to how they would handle those who deserved to die, he had no plan for that. Perhaps he was hoping that since word had already reached the ice demons and flame humans, they would be met by an army.
However, he was shocked when they all seemed to surrender.
Luckily, Alina proposed that she had a way to fish out the bad ones, and Kaizo, who was ready for battle, couldn’t have been any happier.𝒻𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝘯𝘰𝑣ℯ𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝘮
However, it turned out the help Alina had was as strange as not knowing where she had transported a group of scums.
"Look, Merizi’s ability is strange. She doesn’t know where those she filtered out would end up; however, she has a track record of making sure whoever she picked dies wherever they ended up."

Kaizo smirked again and then issued one last warning. "Take this as a sign that whatever you do, one day you will atone for it. Today, we showed you mercy; tomorrow, it will be complete annihilation."
After saying that, they left. It was only after they left that the ice demons sighed.
They came this close to death since their king and all seven generals were among the thousands who died in the Elven kingdom. They were basically defenseless and could only bow their heads.
Thankfully, their walls still stood and only the scums died. That was indeed a huge mercy that they could not take for granted.
A few hours later, Kaizo and his team arrived at the borders of the flame humans, where a large army was waiting for them.
"Finally."
Kaizo smiled cheerfully, then, with no pleasantries before bloodshed, he lunged forward. "Here I come."
The flame humans were ready.
They had prepared, and because only two out of the seven generals had gone to attack the Elves, the other five and their king had mobilized the rest of the army, ready to face Kaizo and his team.
However, despite their preparations and planning, when Kaizo lunged forward, their formation was shattered.
He was just too destructive.
However, his teammates joined in the next second, and the chaos everyone had been hungry to unleash was poured onto the battlefield.
"Annihilate them all. Feed on their souls," Veera said, letting loose her undead legion.
"Don’t let them outshine you. You are the Spectral Army, so their souls are rightfully yours," the Shade King Nykali said, unleashing his wraiths.
Soon, blood stained the battlefield, revealing the chaos that ensued.
The flame humans clearly underestimated their opponents. After all, Veera and her 1,200 Heavenly Ascension–stage undead were more than enough to annihilate them.
It took just two hours, but soon all flame humans were dead, with Kaizo’s side sustaining only minor injuries.
Once every last one died, Merizi did her thing, and the scums still living in Flame City vanished.
"To Planet Vornix then."

chapters.title: Chapter 1138: Gratitude
paragraphs: By the time Kent and Lady Enyo arrived on the outside, Vexthra, Princess Lovina, Adina, Priestess Runa, and Lyna were already making sure every last Elf was ready to migrate into the tower in five hours’ time.
Five hours will be a long time for Gaia and her sisters to build the new city for the Elves, so they are working around the clock to get them ready.
They will be the biggest race in the tower yet.
The humans were only 121, while the Bloodveins were less than a million.

However, there are 6 million Elves getting ready to migrate, and every last one of them is a cultivator. So naturally, they will be adding more to Kent’s strength than the humans and Bloodveins have contributed so far.
However, he wasn’t about to give them priority over everyone, since this was merely him ensuring his mom’s people were safe and sound.
Of course, calling them her people is ridiculous, considering she is merely using the identity of Lady Enyo, the once-brave protector of the Galen Elven Race.
She explained that when Paragon saved her, the Lady Enyo, who was the kingdom protector of the Galen Elven Race, had just died from an injury she sustained in a battle with an external force.

Nobody knew she was injured, and so Paragon gave her that body and identity, since the only thing different about them was that Kent’s mom was an immortal, and the real Lady Enyo was merely a Heavenly Ascension stage warrior.
The two of them are carbon copies of each other, so Paragon helped her inherit the real Lady Enyo’s memories just so she could take her life and wear it like her own.
That was how she became the new guardian and had been protecting the Elves all this time.
Of course, things are very different now since she gets to live with her son in a safe place. She can choose to reclaim her true identity.
However, when Kent suggested this, she said no, citing that she wanted to remain Lady Enyo.
This means she wants to keep protecting them—not that they will need any more protection, considering where they are going.
However, she decided to continue as Lady Enyo for now.
"Ladies," Kent said when he and his mom approached his wives and the new friends they had made.
Vexthra smiled and came to hug him.
Princess Lovina, Adina, Priestess Runa, and Lyna were supposed to be exploring the city; however, they decided to go help Vexthra a couple of minutes into their exploration.
They will have more than enough time to do that later.
They stood behind Vexthra with happy smiles.
After the hug, Kent pulled back and turned to his mom.𝘧𝘳𝘦ℯ𝓌𝘦𝒷𝘯𝑜𝑣𝘦𝓁.𝒸𝘰𝓂
"Mom, this is Vexthra. She is my first wife and the one responsible for me getting a second chance at life."
Lady Enyo raised her brow and smiled. "Thank you, Vexthra. I am Lady Enyo."

Vexthra smiled. "No need to thank me, Mother. Kent is an amazing person. Had it not been for him, I would not know what love and happiness are. So if anything, I should be the one thanking you for gifting the universe such an amazing soul."
Lady Enyo smiled happily. She let go of Kent’s hand and took Vexthra’s. Talk about betrayals on a certain level.
Kent just smirked and turned to his Poison Princess. "This is Princess Lovina, the one who saved you from that poison arrow."
Lady Enyo grabbed her hand too, and soon, she started having hushed conversations with them, leaving Kent to stand there on his own.
Seeing she had intentionally done that, maybe as payback for choosing Elaine’s mom’s cooking over hers, Kent just ignored the three of them and turned to Adina.
"How has it been, Adina? I can see you have become more beautiful and comfortable in your own body."
Adina smiled.

She had disguised herself back when she and Kent met in the Valley of Torture, so seeing her in her full-on succubus form meant she had finally gotten comfortable and wanted to be who she is instead of hiding herself.
"I took your advice and decided to live life. I suppose becoming who I really am while living is the path without regret."

"That is true. I, for one, had my fair share of dilemmas before ascending; however, a certain beautiful goddess told me hiding is not the way forward. You have to embrace who you are and fight to create your own path."

Kent gave Vexthra a sidelong glance before turning back to Adina. "So you becoming your true self is the right path. And now that I am here, I will help you grow much stronger so that roaming the universe will become something much simpler for you.
That Supreme can only wash her neck and wait for my sword."
Adina nodded with a small smile. Kent promised her when they were parting ways back in the valley of torture that he would help her kill the Succubus Supreme.
Hearing him speak now, she knew he still stood by his words.
She had calmed down a bit, so she was now feeling shy to hug Kent.
"That goes to you two also. You have protected both my mom and Adina. In my book, that is a debt that paying back will take thousands of years."
Priestess Runa and Lyna smiled.
To Priestess Runa, meeting the person the entire universe is looking for is all she could ask for. However, Lyna, who is a dragon, felt like she had just met her ancestor.
The dragons see the Primordial Chaos Dragon as their true ancestor. So to her, Kent is the legend who rose above all and stood at the pinnacle of power back during the Primordial Era.
"Are you really the Chaos Dragon?" Lyna asked, wanting to hear from Kent’s own mouth.
He smiled and changed his eye color from purple to reddish gold. The moment that happened, Lyna felt her bloodline getting suppressed.
Naturally, as an immortal, she knew that when someone with a more powerful bloodline unleashes their power, the weaker one would get suppressed very easily.
Now, she, who possesses a divine bloodline, seemed to have started getting suppressed from a mere eye color change.
Lyna went down on her knees and bowed to Kent. "This weak one pays her respect to the Primordial Chaos Dragon."
Kent smiled and shook his head. "No need to be overly dramatic about it, Lyna. I am not fully the Chaos Dragon yet, so seeing me as a big shot is a little over the nose."
He helped her to her feet and added a few words of encouragement. "You have saved my family and protected everyone, so in my eyes, you are very important.
And since you and Agni are related, you are now a part of my family."
Lyna nodded with a small blush. She was very happy, in fact.
Becoming a member of the Chaos Dragon family is more than anything she could ever be given. Kent is a legend in her eyes, and now she will get to watch him rise to the peak like he was back then.
Kent turned to Priestess Runa next and thanked her as well for saving Adina and his mother’s lives.
She was still wrapping her mind around the fact that Kent is Lady Enyo’s son.
The Lady Enyo that she knew had no husband and no secret child. In fact, she was a maiden, and that was why she allowed her to live in the Elven garden in the first place.
So how come she now has a son, and her son is Kent Madson, the most wanted brat in the entire universe?
She couldn’t wrap her mind around that. However, she knew the air would be cleared soon.
Four hours later, Gaia informed Kent that they had finished building the Elven City.

I am not fully the Chaos Dragon yet, so seeing me as a big shot is a little over the nose."
He helped her to her feet and added a few words of encouragement.
"You have saved my family and protected everyone, so in my eyes, you are very important.
And since you and Agni are related, you are now a part of my family."
Lyna nodded with a small blush.
She was very happy, in fact.
Becoming a member of the Chaos Dragon family is more than anything she could ever be given.
Kent is a legend in her eyes, and now she will get to watch him rise to the peak like he was back then.
Kent turned to Priestess Runa next and thanked her as well for saving Adina and his mother’s lives.
She was still wrapping her mind around the fact that Kent is Lady Enyo’s son.
The Lady Enyo that she knew had no husband and no secret child.
In fact, she was a maiden, and that was why she allowed her to live in the Elven garden in the first place.
So how come she now has a son, and her son is Kent Madson, the most wanted brat in the entire universe?
She couldn’t wrap her mind around that.
However, she knew the air would be cleared soon.
Four hours later, Gaia informed Kent that they had finished building the Elven City.

chapters.title: Chapter 1139: Migration
paragraphs: Kent pulls his wives, his mom, Adina, Lyna, and Priestess Runa into the tower to see the city Gaia and her sisters had built.
Kent didn’t lie when he said Gaia and her sisters are the best and most qualified people to build cities in the tower. They pulled it off with Gaiaville and did the same thing with Blood City.
Now, they had done it again with the new Elven City.
The moment they arrived in the tower city, a majestic, nature-inspired city stood before them, painting the scenery with both elegance and peace.
All of them had different yet shocked and stunned expressions appear on their faces.
Kent and his mom, who were from Earth, had seen some fictional Elven cities in movies and knew Gaia and her sisters had outdone themselves this time.
It’s as if they had tapped into their genius and brought out a different type of city this time.
The first thing everybody noticed was two large trees standing tall and proud. They’ve been grown and designed to act as the City Entrance.
A jade glass path suspended in the air led to the city, where buildings made from both jade and plants were scattered throughout in perfect alignment and design.
Glass and jade buildings rose from the ground, towering above even some of the trees. There are calm and serene waterfalls pouring from small pebbles and even through the branches of some trees.
Of course, as elves, Gaia and her sisters knew they would love to be in the embrace of nature.
Most of the buildings were designed to from the trunks of colossal trees, literally allowing them to evoke a sense of nature.
The luminous ambiance of nature lit up the city, sun rays filtering through the leaves giving it a natural glow and filling it with a wealth of healing and natural energy.
"This is beautiful," Lady Enyo muttered, mesmerized by how beautiful the city looked.
"It is indeed beautiful." Kent couldn’t deny it. He looked at Gaia and her sisters, who winked at him.
They had taken the city design to a whole different level.
"Wait for the best part," Gaia said as she and her sisters clapped their tiny hands and shouted, "Rise."
The moment they did, a large tree rose from the ground somewhere at the center of the city and slowly rose into the air. The elves immediately widened their eyes when they saw this tree.
"That is the World Tree," Priestess Runa muttered, her expression filled with shock.
"That is indeed true. We decided to give you a World Tree where all your lives will be tied to it. Of course, it will need a priestess who actually links the life of every elf to it.
However, once it is done, you will begin to enjoy the benefits the World Tree has to offer your people. You wouldn’t have to depend on Mother Nature directly from now onwards."
The World Tree is something that all elves respect and value above all else. To them, the World Tree is the source of their longevity and strength.
It is what makes them who they are, and so, under no circumstances would they do anything without consulting it.
In essence, most say as long as the World Tree stands, the elven race will never die. That, in a way, is true, so every elf race would, without a doubt, be pleased to have its own World Tree.
Gaia and her sisters managed to get one for them, and now, the Galen Elven race will have their own fate in their hands. They would no longer depend on anyone.
"Thank you," Lady Enyo said, looking at her son. Kent could see she was emotional right now, so he just nodded and let her have this moment.
To her, the Galen Elves are her family, too. She had been with them for the past 5,000 years.
So this was something she seemed happy about, and the fact that her son was responsible for it all made her extremely proud of him and very happy as well.
"Not only is the spiritual qi here denser, but the air is also clean, and just standing here seems to have calmed me down considerably. This place is a haven for everyone who seeks peace."
Gaia and her sisters smiled, hearing Lyna’s words. "We have put more work into making sure every soul that will be living in the city never dreams of leaving.

We want them to live here for generations to come. Of course, when they find out the cultivation gardens will help them grow 24 times faster, I am sure they will be more pleased to never want to leave."

Adina and the ladies who are unfamiliar with the tower’s true advantage turn and look at Kent. They want to hear from him first before they believe something as ridiculous as a 24-times boost in growth.

"They are not lying. The cultivation gardens run at different times. The 24 days spent there are 1 day spent in the city. So, in a way, what you can achieve in a day on the outside can be achieved 24 times faster inside the cultivation gardens."

The ladies could only turn and stare back at the three lolis. Gaia adjusted her small glasses and winked at them, while Akira and Dori gave them the "no need to thank us, we are just that awesome" look.
Kent smirked and chose to handle the next most important part.
"How are we going to name it?" He turned to Priestess Runa, who also turned to Lady Enyo.
"You are the priestess, so give it a name."
"This..." Priestess Runa thought for a moment before a name popped into her mind. As the Priestess, she most certainly has the right to name the city
"How about we call it Nature City from now on?"
Although she made it sound like a question, everyone didn’t really care what it was called, as long as the people living there were happy.
So they nodded to the name she suggested, and that is how the new home for the Galen Elves would be called from now onwards.
With that settled, the only thing left to do was begin the migration.
"I guess it is time we move the elves here. We will soon be having visitors now that Kaizo and the others are out there making waves. So I want everyone inside the tower before they arrive."

The fact that his name had started spreading didn’t mean he must meet all of them. If he were to meet a few while he explored the universe, that would be fine, but for now, he had things to take care of, and waiting to say hi to his potential stalkers wasn’t one of them.
Soon, under the guidance of Kent and his women, the elves started entering the tower.
The tower could have just teleported all of them inside; however, Kent wanted them to walk into their new home with their own two legs, so he summoned portals for them.
They didn’t even have to wait too long before the millions of elves entered and started settling in. As expected, they were captivated by the city’s beauty.
Once they all settled in, Kent left with his mom to go have dinner with Elaine’s parents. It was almost time for dinner, and they had promised to come.
Vexthra and the rest choose to stay and ensure that all arrangements to keep everyone sustained were put in place.
Gaia, Akira, and Dori also stayed to add some finishing touches to a few things and plan how to implement the currency system so people could live in a more civilized economy.
More cities would be added soon, and one day, Tower City would be transformed into Tower World. Therefore, establishing a way to regulate it was the path forward now.

chapters.title: Chapter 1140: Split Heart
paragraphs: Kent and his mom spent nearly three hours with Elaine’s parents before they left. The dinner was exactly as Kent expected it—delicious in every way.
"We will come back again," Lady Enyo said, waving goodbye as she and Kent left.

She may have been jealous of Elaine’s mom’s cooking being picked over hers. However, now that she had the privilege to taste it, she couldn’t help but finally understand why Kent was keen on her cooking as usual.
After they left, Kent took her to Nature City, where the Elves were still settling in. There were millions of them, so it was only right to take some time to fully settle in.
"I will stay here for a while and make sure everyone has settled in, then I will enter seclusion to handle a few things.
Once I come out, I will then come and spend time with my daughter-in-law," Lady Enyo said, using her hand to brush a strand of hair from Kent’s face.
"Okay, Mom. I also need to enter seclusion and attend to some matters. It will be a while before we meet again. However, now that I know you are here, I won’t have to worry about anything."
Lady Enyo nodded and went to join Vexthra and the rest of the ladies.
After she left, Priestess Runa and Lyna approached him.
"Are you leaving?" Lyna asked, seeing that Kent was just about to leave, before she approached him.
"Something like that. But I have time for you ladies."
Lyna took a scroll from her space ring and handed it to Kent. She had given it to Runa; however, seeing that she would stay with them for a while, she handed it back to her to give it to Kent.
"Lord Agni said I should give this to you."
Kent received the scroll, but he didn’t open it right away. He first asked about Agni, "How is the Flame Lord?"
Lyna’s expression turned dull. "He is on the run again. I don’t know where he went, but he returned all of a sudden and handed me this scroll before leaving in haste.
He only told me that when I meet you, or in case I happen to meet you one day, I should tell you to never visit the Flame Demon Temple."
"Wait, isn’t he one of the fourteen Flame Lords?"
"He is. However, I believe they are the ones after him."
After Agni handed the first form of the [Finger of Destruction] technique to Kent back inside the flame tower, they had some interesting conversations.
It was through their conversation that Kent found out Agni was the 14th member to join the Flame Demon Tower - beings who have dedicated their time and life to studying the Flame Art.
Becoming a member, even if only a member under a flame lord, is an honour demi-gods will kill for.
According to him, he reached this stage after forming four flame cores.
He even told Kent to come there when he reached the Immortal World, citing that if he wanted to walk the true path of the flame, visiting the Flame Demon Tower was the path forward.

Of course, Kent was more than willing to visit there one of these days. However, it now appears that he will be visiting for a different reason. Agni helped him, and now, it looks like he needs his help.
"Thank you, Lyna." Kent put away the scroll. "If you need anything, ask Vexthra or the three troublemakers over there."
Kent then turned to Gaia, who was looking at him with a smile while hugging his mom’s hand. This sight made him smirk.
"When you are done messing around, take Lyna, Adina, and Priestess Runa to the system store to pick some treasures and techniques."
"You don’t have enough tower points for that, big brother."
Kent smirked. "Put a negative there. I will pay later."
"If you say so. In any case, don’t blame me for putting you in debt. Of course, if you think you can scam me and get away with it, then think a million times."
"Are you threatening me?" Kent teleported, and before Gaia could react, she was hanging upside down.
"Hey, put me down."
"Ouch."
"Put me down."
"Ouch."
"Grandma, save me!"
Finally, Kent stopped spanking Gaia’s tiny butt and set her down. "Next time, don’t hide behind my mom and try to play pranks on me. I know you have taken more than is required to build the city."
"Use the tower points you are hoarding to pay for the stuff they will be buying."
"You..." Gaia pouted, but when Lady Enyo brushed her head, she puffed her cheeks and made a funny face, telling Kent he was doomed.
"Tch," Kent just smirked and left. He needed to attend to some important matters, so messing with Gaia could wait.
Soon, he appeared in the Sword Tower and sat on the Sword Bridge, which had been transformed after the requirements to become a Sword Saint changed when he traveled to the past.
Initially, he was meant to challenge all 13 levels; however, that requirement was scrapped.
Now, instead of facing clones of himself, he would be facing Sword Kings and Emperors who walked the sword path and were now dead or had ascended to godhood.
He wasn’t about to take on that trial yet, so he sat at the edge and took a deep sigh.
"Okay, Tower, tell me what is wrong with my mom’s heart." One of the many things Kent wanted to figure out was the issue with his mom’s heart.
According to her, when she died and escaped to Planet Mekyn with Paragon’s help, her heart started to give out sometimes when she was stressed or extremely tired.
Whenever this happened, she would have to go into seclusion for years and suffer alone. So Kent asked the Tower to examine her and provide a solution.
⟦I have scanned and examined Lady Enyo’s condition and discovered she has something called Split Heart. This is due to her merging with her other half’s soul. Her hearts hadn’t fully merged yet⟧
"Strange, but how come her soul merged, but the heart couldn’t? Also, shouldn’t it merely be her soul merging?"
From what Kent learned about his mom, she had two souls—half souls—that lived in separate bodies. Now, she had merged with her other half, making her whole.
This process said nothing about whether or not her heart should merge. In a way, it was only her soul that should have merged. So, how then was her heart now having an issue?
⟦I am not sure why, but I believe whoever saved her had literally saved her from the jaws of death. They might have even gone against the Dao of Death, saving her.
And since this body isn’t her original immortal body, there may be some struggle between her immortal body and this mortal body.⟧
"I see. That does make some sense. In any case, do you happen to have a cure for it?"
⟦I do. She just needs to consume a drop of Spirit Ascension Dew.⟧
"Wonderful. How much does it cost?" Kent asked, already prepared to owe more Tower Points. However, if it were for sale outside the tower store, he had more than enough money.
Unfortunately, neither of the two methods he envisioned was an option.
⟦The master would have to travel to an Immortal World to get it. The Spirit Ascension Dew can only be found in an Immortal World, unfortunately.⟧
"Just great," Kent sighed, feeling another headache coming. This one, however, he knew no amount of preparation would ever prepare him to face all threats easily like he did with the High Worlds.
’No need, I will find a way. For now, I need to focus on what I can solve without much difficulty.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1141: Destiny Map
paragraphs: Kent has a lot to do now that he has arrived in the High World.
His mom’s health issue is one of many, so now that he knows he can’t help his mom as soon as he expected, he has decided to handle what he can while in the High World.
The first thing on his timeline is using the Destiny Map.

Kent quickly retrieves a scroll that is completely blank and unfurls it. This scroll is the Destiny Map, an item that would allow him to find anything and anyone as long as they share a common destiny.
He received this item as a reward in the quest that required him to kill the Planet King. Since he accomplished that, the item is now his.𝐟𝕣𝕖𝐞𝐰𝕖𝚋𝐧𝗼𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝗰𝐨𝐦
It was as if the universe knew what he wanted, and so they gave him a way to get it.
As Kent held the blank scroll, the only thought filling his mind was finding Elina.
His one true love, who died during the Primordial Era before he learned to love and reciprocate her feelings, is the only person he now wants to find.
The scroll can be used one at a time.
This means that if he uses it on Elina, he cannot use it again until it leads him to her. Naturally, Kent didn’t care. The earlier he finds Elina, the better.
So he bit his finger and focused on Elina’s name before dropping his blood on the scroll. He doesn’t care if she is in a medium world, a high world, an immortal world, or even a Supreme world.
As long as she had reincarnated—which Kent believed she had—then he would find her no matter what.
The moment he did, the scroll glowed faintly a few times before lines started appearing on it.
As the lines spread, they began to take shape, forming an intricate map. Kent relaxed and waited with bated breath as he watched the changes happen.
A couple of minutes later, the map formed, and Kent could see a red dot appear somewhere on it.
"Tower, project the map in 3D."
The Tower obeyed, and soon, a 3D map that led to one of his destinations appeared in the air. Kent focused on the location of the red dot.
However, only a single name was written there.
"Tenebral Crown," he read the name with a frown. This is his first time hearing such a word or perhaps a name.
However, he didn’t think for long.

"Tenebral Crown, you say."Dori suddenly appeared behind Kent and took his hand. She was a Mind Weaver, and as someone connected to Kent’s mind, she knew when the Chaos Dragon needed help, so she came to assist.
"Do you know where it is located?" Kent asked, knowing only a cosmic being could help him at this point.

Dori nodded and first zoomed out on the map, making the red dot vanish from sight. However, a few more objects appeared. Most of them were rings, with some stars, moons, and even odd shapes that shouldn’t be on a map.
"All these are galaxies," Dori said, pointing at these odd shapes. "Tenebral Crown is the skull shape on the map, and this galaxy we are in is the ring shape.
It is called Nebulous Cluster. As you can see, it is much closer to Tenebral Crown now that I have zoomed out."
Kent nodded, now having some understanding of the map.
"This means to get the specific location of this red dot, you must travel to the Tenebral Crown Galaxy. Then, find the star system in which the dot is located.
Afterwards, you find the planetary system and the planet it is located on, and you will find the person there."
Kent sighed deeply, seeing he had a very long journey ahead of him. However, knowing Elina is alive is a relief.
’At least she had reincarnated just like how I suspected. Nowever, how is she faring? Is she having a good life? Does she have friends like she did back during the primordial’

Kent smiled, recalling the many friends Elina introduced him to. He hated most of them; a part of him, despite his emotionless nature, wanted to make Elina happy, so he put on an act and ensured all her friends had a good time with them.
The years they spent travelling, she made so many friends that even Kent couldn’t count them.
’She has her way with people, and that is why the ladies are going to love her.’
Dori saw the smile on his face and smiled in return. "You will need a lot of money to go on this long trip. You will also face so many challenges, so prepare for them now.
I will let Gaia tinker with this map and find some shortcuts that will hasten your trip."
Kent nodded and then asked an important question. "How long do you think it will take me to travel to this galaxy?" Kent asked, pointing at Tenebral Crown.
"I can’t say for sure, but judging by how fast planetary travel has become now, reaching there within 50 years is possible.
But then again, this is the universe; you might just face some challenges that will delay you considerably or meet good fortunes that will hasten it for you.
Naturally, my sisters and I will do our best to ensure you get there much faster."
"Thank you, Dori."
The Mind Weaver nodded and soon vanished with the map. Kent then focused his attention on the 3D projections and sat down to think.
A couple of minutes later, his sword appeared and transformed into its human form. Gaap then sat beside Kent and also started looking at the map.
"It will be a long journey for sure," Gaap said, looking at the distance between the Nebulous Cluster and Tenebral Crown.
"There is no doubt about that, Gaap. However, no matter the distance, danger, or setbacks, I will never stop until I reach my destination."
Gaap nodded. "I will be right beside you. No matter the danger, we will face them with everything we’ve got."
The universe is vast and dangerous, after all. Kent may be strong, but he is not invincible. So even he would have to be careful when traversing the harrowing corners of the universe.
"When do you plan on embarking on this journey?"

"As early as possible. I have no idea how the person I am going to is faring, so the earlier I leave, the better. However, before leaving, I want to form my second blood core gate and handle some minor tasks first.
It will take me a couple of years, but since time inside the Tower is much faster than the outside world, we will be leaving in a couple of months."
"In that case, I will go prepare then." Gaap stood up and stretched.
Although he is a sword, he is no ordinary sword, so stretching is normal.
"Do your best, Gaap. We will keep growing as we embark on the journey, so do what you can do now."
Gaap nodded and entered Kent’s soul sea. After he was gone, Kent turned to the Tower.
"Tower, I want you to pick the worlds I have been to and recorded on the Planet Teleporter. Then map them in the direction that leads to the edge of this galaxy.
Also, if you can locate the Sword Worlds, do the same thing with them. Right now, I need to be able to move closer to the edge of this galaxy with a few clicks of a button."
⟦I will get on that now⟧
"Thank you, Tower." Kent stood up from the sword and teleported away, stopping in front of the Sword of Enlightenment.
He went into a lotus posture and took a deep breath. ’Too bad I can’t use the Starbound Compass.’
The compass he used to travel to Vexthra’s domain back then would have worked in this situation; however, using it runs the risk of weakening the very fabric of the universe.
If the creations of the dark sense the fabric thinning, they will surely force their way through, and that will be catastrophic for Kent and everyone.
So for now, he must do it the hard way.
’Let me focus on my cultivation then. My target is to form the second blood core gate. I will handle everything else after that.’
Kent waved his hand, and thousands of Blood Essences appeared in the air. He then began absorbing them to form his blood core.
