chapters.title: Chapter 1142: How Did We Get Here
paragraphs: BOOM
Kaizo was sent flying 3 miles away. His body slammed into the ground, creating a thudding and bone-breaking sound. A large cut pouring out blood lines his chest.
On the ground, Vaelros lay weak and broken. He had lost one hand, while the other was broken. He could barely stand as his thick chains supported his weight.
Unity’s bow was broken. Thankfully, she was in good shape. However, without her bow, she could only take out a paintbrush and start painting arrows.
Of her sisters, only Alina, Val, Neomi, and Selene still stood. The rest had lost consciousness, with some barely holding on.
Most of them had sustained some life-threatening injuries.
As for the undead and Eternal Wrath Legion, only Kaizo, Krex, and Aetheris continued to fight—well, defend against a barrage of golden swords bombarding them.
Most of the undead had already died.
However, because they were undead, they could be summoned back as long as their master was alive. Even the Eternal Wrath Legion was akin to the undead.
As long as the dungeons remained safe inside the towers, they could respawn there. Of course, they would lose a few levels, but they would live.
The only ones in actual danger were Kent’s wives, who only had one life.

Thankfully, although Alina had no way to dismantle the killing formation bombarding them with the swords, protecting her sisters by isolating them from the formation after they passed out was possible.
Thanks to that, they were not being attacked after they passed out.
Val, Selene, and Neomi were protecting her.
However, with Val unable to summon her goddess form, they were basically waiting for death. Thankfully, Selene was capable in defense.
So for now, they were holding on.
Kaizo, who had been blasted away, rose to his feet but was sent flying again by a thick golden sword. The wound on his chest opened, and more blood started pouring out.
"How did we get here?" Kaizo screamed at the top of his voice as he looked around, seeing his team broken beyond repair.
’Master is going to be so pissed’
At this rate, if they don’t find a way to regain their connection to the tower, most of them will die.
Like Kaizo asked, how did they get where they are now?
It all started three hours ago:
After annihilating the Flame Human army, they made their way to Planet Vornix. It was the world the Succubus King came from, so they went there for revenge.

As planned, they managed to handle them since getting there was rather easy. It took them just six hours. However, after they had exacted their revenge, killing all those who came against them, they finally had nowhere else to go.
Naturally, that meant they should go back to the tower.
However, just when they were about to leave, a lone figure appeared in the air and activated a Tier 18 killing formation.
They had no idea where this person came from. He suddenly appeared, activated the formation, and then vanished.
The formation cut off their connection to Kent and the tower. And since Kent didn’t come to their rescue, it meant he hadn’t noticed anything wrong.
It had already been three hours, and Alina, despite her knowledge in formations, couldn’t come up with a counter for the Tier 18 formation that only an Array Sovereign could make.
Alina was only an Array King, so her limit was Tier 14 formations. This meant that all her tricks were ineffective against this formation, and as a result, her sisters were now in danger.
But then again, she was not in any way qualified to defend against a formation that only an Immortal could make.
This also meant the formation came from an Immortal.
However, that was just not possible.
The people on Planet Vornix were all mortals. But even if they were Immortals, the moment they appeared in a high world, they would be suppressed to the Heavenly Ascension stage.
This meant even if they had an Immortal-grade (Tier 18) formation, using it was impossible. They shouldn’t have the required spiritual energy to power it.
Yet somehow, this person was able to unleash the formation, and for three hours, it remained active.
"Alina, stop protecting me. I am an undead, so death is not something I am worried about," Kaizo shouted as he punched away a golden sword.
Alina turned and looked at his sorry state but said nothing.
As long as Kaizo still stood, she believed there was a way.
They were losing, but the fire in Kaizo’s eyes was still burning. He was determined, and as someone designed for battle, he kept rising to his feet despite knowing it was all pointless.
Of course, if the power in the formation ran out, they would be able to escape and come for revenge later.
So whenever he is struck down, he rises to his feet, hoping the formation will lose its power.

On the outside of this killing formation, fourteen people stood in the air looking at the red killing formation. One of them held a disc-shaped artifact in his left hand, while his right hand continued to form seals.
"They are relentless; however, it will soon be over," the formation expert said, a happy expression appearing on his face.
"Indeed. As long as we have his subordinates, he will come looking for them. That will be our chance to capture him."
"As long as we catch him, wasting a formation disc capable of killing even a True Immortal isn’t too painful."
The fourteen people were all Peak Heavenly Ascension stage. However, judging by their auras, one doesn’t need to know they are suppressed immortals.
They came to hunt down Kent. Words had begun spreading, claiming that he had appeared on Planet Mekyn and that his army had already started making moves.

These fourteen came from a powerful Immortal family specializing in the art of the sword. They were a swordsman family who wanted to capture Kent and force him to divulge all he knew that led to his name appearing on the Sword Dao Tablet.
They had been walking the sword path for eons, but never had even one of them appeared on the Sword Dao tablet.
So they are jealous and hungry for power.
Unlike the many sects searching for Kent to recruit him, this group of immortals wanted his knowledge, and so they came after his subordinates, planning to use them to lure him out.
However, while they expected them to fall much faster, it had already been three hours, yet some of them still stood.
"Should we attack them?" one of the fourteen asked, but the formation expert shot him a fierce look.
"Adding external power will not do us any good. It will even damage the formation, allowing them to escape."
"No need to be overly dramatic, Lansi. I merely made a suggestion, considering it has been three hours and your fancy formation couldn’t handle a bunch of nobodies."
Lansi, the formation expert, gritted his teeth and formed more complex hand seals, activating more mechanisms in the formation.
"Any moment from now," he muttered.
Inside the formation, Kaizo was pierced through the chest, sending him flying back again. Selene also turned pale as more bombardment kept landing on her shield.
On the ground, protected by the shield, Unity slowly burned her divine energy to heal her injuries while painting more arrows to defend against the swords.
If she had been able to isolate the divine energy before this battle, perhaps they wouldn’t be in this situation. By now, she would have broken through the formation.
However, she had no handle over it, and thus, she was now in a sorry state.
’I am sorry, Kent... I couldn’t protect them,’ Unity said inwardly as she drew more arrows.
Suddenly, the temperature inside the killing formation dropped, freezing the hundreds of swords falling down on them.
This change caught everyone’s attention.
Then the space cracked, releasing green flames—the kind that burned both body and soul.
From the crack, a lone figure with two swords sheathed on his back walked out. The person looked at Kaizo, then at Unity. He then looked at everyone else.
"Hmm, looks like you guys need saving."
Uncle Drew pulled out one sword but returned it to the sheath the next moment. A second later, the formation was cut in half.

chapters.title: Chapter 1143: I am Uncle Drew.
paragraphs: Nobody saw when Uncle Drew drew his sword and unleashed the attack. His hand just went behind him and pulled one of his swords, which he returned to the sheath the next second.
However, he did unleash an attack, and the result was now visible.
The formation that Kaizo and his team had been trying to destroy for the past 3 hours was cleaved in half, freeing them from its hold.
On the outside, the 14 people widened their eyes, seeing the formation no mortal had business being at its mercy cleaved in half.
The Formation Expert sensed a presence entering the formation. However, he didn’t think too much about it. Now, however, he had seen that the person he had underestimated was no simple person at all.
The formation disc he was holding cracked, rendering it useless.
Blood seeped from the corner of his lips, suffering a soul backlash.
As the formation became undone, the connection to the tower that Kaizo and the others had lost for the past 3 hours was recovered.
"Tower, take us away," Alina commanded, and the next second, they vanished into the body tower, where Vexthra and the rest of the ladies inside Nature City were waiting for them.
The moment they arrived, they quickly helped every last one of them into the healing chambers Gaia had developed for moments like this.
"I am sorry, big sister. I was powerless to protect them," Alina said, tears falling down her face.
Vexthra hugged her and patted her on the back, "It is okay, Alina. You are not Kent; you cannot protect everyone."
Although she kept her sisters alive, she failed to protect them from being injured.
"Should we inform Kent?" Alina asked, but Vexthra shook her head.
"He is busy right now, and disturbing him will be bad for him. Now that you are all safe, let’s focus on your recovery. I will tell him everything when he is out of seclusion."
Vexthra was indeed right; Kent was currently at a critical junction where stopping would not only be a waste of thousands of blood essence, but the backlash would also put him in danger.
He could not afford to stop now, so they could only wait until he was done. Even the tower refrains from disturbing him, knowing Kent will drop everything to go to his women’s rescue.
Meanwhile, back on Planet Vornix, Uncle Drew stood calm, his gaze fixed on the fourteen people who had nearly killed his friends and his master’s wives.
Had it not been for Alina, most of them would have died.
Uncle Drew was having his morning tea in the underworld, planning when to come back to the land of the living, when suddenly, he sensed Nara, Eryndor, and Saden’s lives were in danger.
As the captain of the Nigh Riders, whenever they are in danger, he can sense it from wherever he is. In fact, all Night Riders have this connection.
The moment he did, he dropped everything and decided to leave ahead of time. He already had plans to return to the land of the living, but not today.
Thankfully, what should have been a day’s travel, considering how long he had stayed in the underworld, was hastened by Nyx.
Since a power beyond mortal comprehension was being used against Uncle Drew’s people, the people involved were going against karma, so Nyx balanced it out by hastening Uncle Drew’s return.
But even with her demigod strength, she was only able to reduce the time to 3 hours.
Thankfully, he wasn’t too late. One of his master’s wives came through for them, saving everyone at the expense of her own soul.
Alina might have been putting on a brave face, but the moment she closed her eyes, she wouldn’t be waking up for a couple of years. She had practically burned her soul to save everyone.
Nyx had already told Uncle Drew how to help her recover early, so, looking at the 14 people involved, he couldn’t help but smile weakly.
"Who are you?" Lansi, the Formation Expert who had suffered a soul backlash, asked, looking angrily at Uncle Drew.
Losing the formation disc that contained the formation he had spent 35,000 years making struck him close to home.
"You really have no idea what you have done, huh?" Uncle Drew replied with a question to him.

"What the hell is that supposed to mean?" a swordsman, who, had it not been for the restriction of the High Worlds, would have been at the True Immortal stage, asked, pointing his sword at Uncle Drew.
"Nobody points their sword at the great Karl Duskbane." Uncle Drew pulled his sword again, and just like before, this person was cut in half, his soul extinguished.
The thirteen remaining jumped back in fright when they saw how easily Uncle Drew killed the strongest swordsman in their team.
"You losers clearly don’t know the calamity you have called on yourselves and your families, huh?" Uncle Drew decided to make them aware of what they had done.
"Not only did you losers stupidly attack the legion of the one person you shouldn’t have, but you even killed some of his people and severely injured his wives.
I’m not sure what you know about my master, but he is someone who takes revenge seriously. He will not stop until every last person involved dies.
Of all the people you could have chosen to offend, you losers messed with the people he holds dear to his heart.
That is a great calamity that your families will have to pay for because none of you will be alive long enough to answer for it.

He is going to kill everyone you hold dear, and I am going to help him." Uncle Drew, who was not being affected by the restrictions of the high world, unleashed his Death Stage Aura, sending all 13 immortal warriors crashing to the ground.
"How? How can you be at the Death stage in a high world?" One of them, who immediately sensed the nature of Uncle Drew’s Aura, asked, his expression pale.
"I am Uncle Drew...bitch"
With this answer, Uncle Drew raised his hand and gestured down with his finger. The next second, the swords on his back flashed out, and a second later, they returned to their sheaths.
On the ground, 12 of the warriors died, leaving only one of them.
"You will lead us to your employers, so you can’t die now." Uncle Drew punched the bastard in the face, knocking him out.
He waved his hand, and the space rings of all 14 warriors flew toward him.
They were immortals, after all, so looting them was the only way.
"Welcome back to the land of the living, Uncle Drew." Vexthra suddenly appeared beside Uncle Drew, who nodded and handed the space rings to her.
"Good to be back, My Lady."
Vexthra nodded with a small smile. Then she waved her hand, and the body of the warrior Uncle Drew had knocked out vanished into the tower.
"I will handle a few things out here before coming back home," Uncle Drew said with a smile. Vexthra nodded, and she vanished back into the tower.
After she left, Uncle Drew looked into the distance as if staring at someone. After a few minutes, a chuckle escaped his lips. "Cowards."
He expected the dozens of people staring at him from afar to attack, but it seemed they were scared of him.
The strength he had revealed wasn’t one they could go against, even if they were immortals currently suppressed to the Heavenly Ascension Stage.
"If you are too scared to die, then why come looking for my master?" His mocking words reached everyone, causing their expressions to twist into anger.𝕗𝐫𝐞𝕖𝕨𝐞𝗯𝚗𝕠𝘃𝐞𝚕.𝐜𝗼𝚖
However, despite the obvious provocation, none said anything or even tried to confront him. A few seconds later, Uncle Drew sensed two people moving toward him.
Two people responded to his words, but not in the way he had expected.
Two beautiful ladies, one with blue eyes, the other with dark hair and petite features, teleported and appeared 4 meters from Uncle Drew.
"Mr., do you know Big Brother Kent?" the dark-haired beauty asked.
Uncle Drew, who thought he was about to kill two more, raised his brow, not expecting this.
"And who might these two adorable fairies be?" Nonetheless, he chose to ask who they were.
"My name is Yuna, and this is my sister, Purity. We came from the Immortal World to look for Big Brother."

chapters.title: Chapter 1144: First Clue
paragraphs: "Your big brother, you say." Uncle Drew studied the two petite ladies and smiled.
’They are harmless, almost as if they hadn’t killed a fly before.’

As someone who had killed his fair share of people and beasts, he knew when he saw a dangerous person and a harmless one. Of course, there are many assassins who appear harmless but will strike when you least expect it.
Uncle Drew had met dozens of them in his time in the underworld and in his past life as Kael Duskbane—general and right-hand man of the Wraith Queen.

He saw how an ally could easily turn and stab you in the back. He had witnessed many betrayals, and so his senses had been tuned to the point that even the faintest killing intent wouldn’t escape him.
So, looking at the two ladies, he knew they were no killers.
However, he couldn’t just take them into the tower without Kent’s permission.
"I do know your big brother. He is my master," Uncle Drew said, making Yuna and Purity happy.
They had just arrived in the High World, and coincidentally, the world they had arrived in was under attack by a group of people who claimed to be legions under the same person they were seeking.
Yuna and Purity were happy about that; however, they also knew interfering in their battle was not the way forward. So they relaxed and waited for the battle to come to an end.
However, just when they could approach them, the fourteen immortals attacked, and they were powerless to stop them.
Like Uncle Drew said, the two were harmless. They couldn’t even kill a fly if they wanted to.
Of course, causing trouble here and there was within their capabilities; however, engaging in full-on combat, knowing someone would die, was beyond them.
They just couldn’t do that.
Just like everyone else, they could only stand by and watch. Thankfully, just when things turned dire, Uncle Drew returned to save the day.
"Mister, can you take us to him? We miss Big Brother so much," Yuna said, her expression brightening up as she stared at Uncle Drew with puppy eyes.
Uncle Drew smiled weakly and decided to talk to Vexthra first.
’My lady, I have a little issue on my hand here. There are two adorable ladies here who claim they are Master’s sisters. They came from an immortal world, and they want me to take them to him.’
Vexthra, who had finally managed to send Alina to sleep by using her divine energy on her, sighed and responded to Uncle Drew.
’Ask where they know him from.’
"Question, where do you ladies know my young master from?"
"Big Brother saved me 370,000 years ago and took me to Pyris Pill Alliance, where I met Big Sister Nefeli. Big Brother promised to come back for me soon, but he didn’t, so I came looking for him."
Uncle nodded and turned to Purity. "How about you, Little Flame?"

Purity clearly didn’t like being called Little Flame, but to leave a good impression, she smiled and answered, "I came from the Pill Ascension Realm. Big Brother Kent gave me to Yuna as her guardian and friend."
"I see."
Uncle Drew relayed their response to Vexthra, who immediately knew they were telling the truth. Kent had already told them about all the amazing people he met when he traveled to the past.
She was already aware of Yuna, so hearing she had come to look for him made her happy. She knew Kent would be happy to meet her.
’Bring them in. However, Kent is in seclusion, so they will have to spend time in the tower city for the time being.’
Uncle Drew nodded and then turned to Yuna and Purity.
"Looks like your big brother is in seclusion, but his amazing goddess wife is not, so I will be taking you to her now... She wants to meet you ladies."
Yuna and Purity became happy hearing that.
Uncle Drew smiled and looked at the people staring at them from afar one last time before waving his hand. The next second, they vanished into the tower, leaving everyone stunned.
"Where did they go?" one of them asked.
His friend turned and looked at him. "Why ask me? It is not like I know where they went."
Some of them spread their senses, hoping to find a trace of them. However, they underestimated their current strength. As suppressed immortals, they could not sense as deeply as they used to.
So, seeing that they couldn’t find them, they turned their focus to figuring out who the two ladies were.
Some of them started pulling all the knowledge they had. However, they couldn’t figure out who Yuna and Purity were.
Of course, as time went by, some started getting clues until someone suddenly figured out who Yuna was, thanks to her sterling reputation.

"Initially, because she didn’t have her immortal aura, I didn’t recognize her. However, now that I have taken my time to examine her appearance, I think... no, I believe the one with the dark hair is the infamous Silver Tongue of Pyris Gate."
"You mean that troublemaker who every immortal wants dead has a relationship with Kent Madson?"
"Looks like it."
"Damn, if that is the case, then the Pyris Immortal Pill Alliance has some explanations to give us."
"Yes. They must explain to us why they are keeping someone like Kent Madson hidden."
"Greedy people. Instead of sharing the knowledge with all of us, they are keeping it all to themselves. Makes me wonder just what else they are hiding."

Soon, people started shifting the blame to the Pyris Pill Alliance in the immortal world. However, the sound ones knew things were much deeper than that. Some even started to see something many couldn’t.

"Those who saw Kent Madson said he is no immortal. So if that is the case, does it mean he has yet to reach the immortal world, or did they send him to the High World to hide him from the gods and immortals?𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝙬𝙚𝓫𝒏𝓸𝓿𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝙤𝓶
After all, I learned that the Pyris Pill Alliance formed in the immortal world about 200,000 years ago, but has already reached the top ten pill alliances in the Immortal Pill World.
If that is the case, then does it mean they all came from High Worlds and established themselves?"
This question prompted many to realize that things aren’t as simple as they appear.
"If that is indeed the case, then going to confront them is a bad idea. I learned their leader is just a True Immortal, but she can easily kill Immortal Monarchs and even Immortal Lords."
Hearing this, many started hesitating.

Nobody knew who was secretly protecting the Pyris Pill Alliance, but they were certain that such an organization, which had risen to prominence all of a sudden, would have someone powerful protecting it.
"We should hold back for now. I am sure wherever this Kent is hiding, he will one day appear. When he does, getting to him will be easy then."
They nodded.
However, many still wanted to confront the Pyris Pill Alliance, as rumors began spreading that they had a connection to Kent Madson.
Naturally, the impatient ones would go and meet their end in the most tragic way.
After all, a certain vengeful sword goddess who is just biding her time to get her hands on Kent is protecting them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1145: Second Blood Gate
paragraphs: Inside the sword tower, Kent sat with his eyes closed, a potent blood aura pouring out of his body.
He is like a blood demon who has submerged his soul and body in blood, and he is now consumed by bloodlust. His entire being is as if he were made from blood.
If anyone with a weak will were to see him now, they would, without a doubt, break into a cold sweat and collapse.
His aura at the moment is dangerous.

When Kent formed his first Blood Core Gate, he used blood essence from beings within the range of a high world. Although most of those beasts were suppressed to the Heavenly Ascension stage, they were powerful.
However, the ones he is absorbing now are even more powerful. He obtained this blood essence from Paragon’s universe, so the suppression has no effect on them.
In fact, the Nirvana stage warriors he fought and killed were all adding to his strength now, and as such, the aura pouring from him is just too potent.
Inside his soul sea, the second red gate appeared, and the core was forming inside.
The first gate had already saturated after absorbing more blood essence. Thanks to it saturating, he had already reached the Spirit King stage.
And now, as the second Blood Core Gate is forming, his cultivation is slowly rising.
The gate rose into the air, towering several kilometers high.
Kent hasn’t attempted to use the seven Blood Essences he took from the gods Vexthra defeated back in the Paragon universe.
He had no reason to use it. Of course, using it now is very dangerous since he runs the risk of dying or worse, damaging his cores.
Even at his current level, absorbing immortal blood essence will be extremely dangerous. However, with his second Core Gate forming, he will soon be able to do more than absorb blood essence.
He is making so much progress now.
He already has enough blood to use for his first Blood Cleansing Bath.
He is ready to become a true Blood Lord.
After bathing in his first blood ritual, he will finally be recognized as a true Blood Lord.
Weeks passed, but Kent still remained in a lotus posture, focusing on absorbing more blood essence.
Eventually, the required amount of blood essence to form the second Blood Core Gate had been reached, and so, a powerful blood aura burst out of Kent’s body.
Inside his soul sea, the second gate opened wide, featuring a red core with two golden rings spinning around it.
Comparing the second Core Gate to the first one, the difference is plain. The first Blood Core Gate has two cores: one red and one green.
The red core is the Blood Core, which has one golden ring lined with runes spinning around it, while the green is the flame core he had formed back in Hell.
Now, he had formed the second, and it has two golden rings.
However, just when the second core is formed, the rings around both cores start spinning.
Kent, who never expected this, snapped his eyes open, releasing a wave of pressure.
The blood essence in the air and all those stored in his soul universe are being absorbed by the two cores at a rapid pace.
As they do that, messages keep flashing across Kent’s eyes...
⟦You have absorbed enough blood essence to level up⟧
⟦You have absorbed enough blood essence to level up⟧
⟦You have absorbed enough blood essence to level up⟧
⟦You have reached Spirit Emperor stage⟧
Kent widened his eyes, seeing more of the blood essence still getting absorbed.
"No way. So that is how it works, huh."
Because he had formed the first Blood Core Gate back when he had already reached the Peak Core Formation stage, he didn’t know that saturating the cores is the only way to level.

To him, forming the Blood Core Gates is the only way. But now, he seems to have seen the path forward, and knowing he was nowhere near saturating both cores, his blood boiled to go on a rampage and absorb more blood.
However, he would have to hold on for now. He still has a lot to do, so going on a slaughter now is not the way forward.

Thankfully, three weeks later, every last blood essence except for the seven god blood essences was absorbed, but he had yet to saturate both cores. Kent looked at the final message, and he was shocked by what he saw.
He expected to make some progress, but he never expected to have made this much progress in a single seclusion.
⟦You have reached level 7 Spirit Sovereign stage⟧
"I am only 2 levels away from reaching the Spirit Lord stage." Kent smiled happily. He didn’t really expect this much progress, not when he had just gotten to the High World.
He expected to at least reach the Spirit King stage for now. However, he underestimated the effect of blood essence from beasts and people who are much stronger than him.
"This is good. With this, unless I meet an actual immortal on my journey to find Elina, then nothing could stand in my way."
Kent clenched his fist, feeling energized just from seeing the message that had appeared before him.
If it were only Heavenly Ascension stage cultivators coming after him, he wouldn’t have minded. However, there are immortals now in his wake, and killing them will not be easy.
Of course, since they would be suppressed, he knew they would die if they came after him.
However, he knew immortals had treasures that could pose a threat to him, so he was now preparing well before leaving.
"I just need to have my blood bath before leaving. However, before that, I must handle my Sword and Alchemy path. I must become a Pill King and Sword King."
Kent is a Pill Saint; however, he had already met one of the two requirements to become a Pill Sage. Now, all that is required of him is to concoct one Tier 9 pill.
He is now ready for that. Once that is done, he will tackle Pill King...
However, before that, he must first fulfill his requirement to become a Sword King, which is as simple as gaining six more Sword Enlightenments.
He has a sure way of attaining four, and the last two, he already has an idea.
"I must use the four memory keys for Jest and level up my swordsmanship before leaving. Knowing the kind of danger I will be facing, it is better to be ready."
Of course, he also has some memory keys for the Faceless Assassin; however, he knew that he could wait for now. He will have plenty of time to handle that later.
He then retrieved an item from his space ring. "I really should use it before leaving."
The item is a treasure that can help him create any technique of his choice by sacrificing other techniques.
He bought it from the tower when he had enough tower points. It was one of the reasons why he learned all the flame techniques in the Flame Tower.
Now, he wants to use it to create a powerful flame technique that he will utilize while working on forming his second flame core.
For now, he can use the Finger of Destruction twice, maybe thrice, before running out of energy, so he needs something to replace it for now.
Sacrificing dozens of weak flame techniques to form one powerful flame technique is worth it.
Kent looked at some other messages that had appeared. Soon, however, his expression changed.
"The hell," he teleported away the next second.
⟦Your Undead Warrior Elyndra Virellia has died⟧

chapters.title: Chapter 1146: Anger
paragraphs: Kent appeared inside the body tower, where most of his legions were spending time healing. Not all of them have recovered, so they are still in the healing chamber.
Kent had already seen the messages and knew most of his undead had died. As for the Eternal Legion, some are up, others are still in the healing chamber.

It had already been 17 weeks inside the tower since the battle happened. That was about 17 hours on the outside. However, thanks to the time difference, most had recovered, or at least, they are out of the chamber.
Most of the undead warriors used their bodies to shield those who were vulnerable, so while most of Kent’s wives and the Eternal Wrath legion only sustained minor injuries, the undead actually died.
Before their battle with the Immortal Killing Formation, Kent had ten undead. However, because of their bravery and the near-impossible odds they went against, seven of them died.
The only ones still standing were Kaizo, Sylara, and Varyn.
Kaizo survived because, well, he was Kaizo. His defense was much stronger than the rest, and so he managed to keep his life with Alina’s assistance.
They all knew that as long as one stayed alive long enough for the formation to lose its power, they would be saved. And they came close.
The formation would have lost its power exactly 15 minutes into the 3rd hour.
However, Uncle Drew returned from the underworld and saved them before that happened. But if he hadn’t come, then perhaps only Kaizo would have made it.
But then again, he was perfect for the role, knowing he would keep rising back up like the undead he was.
Sylara survived because she had formed the Blood Hunger Seal, and yet again, she burned it to empower herself.
It was rather heartbreaking, considering she formed her Blood Hunger Seal only to burn it again to keep herself and her friends alive.
But thanks to her, most of Kent’s wives survived.
As for Varyn, he survived thanks to his dual nature as an Assassin and a Knight. Thanks to his Divine Shield, he was able to keep his sorry undead life safe and others safe, too.

Right now, Kaizo, Sylara, Varyn, Unity, and a few of her sisters, alongside Aetheris, Nykali, Veera, Yi Lai, and Krex Nithal, were the only ones who had somehow recovered and were out of their healing chambers.
Krex is the undying cockroach, so it is not shocking that he survived. Killing him is nearly impossible.
When Kent saw this sight, his anger bubbled, threatening to consume him.
His just-formed blood core started to surge, causing a potent killing intent to wash out of his body.
Kaizo and the rest who saw him sighed, and they shuddered. Kent is like a blood demon, one who has just returned from slaughter.
⟦The master is advised to keep his emotions in check, else he risks entering a bloodlust state⟧
Kent took a deep breath and then calmed down. However, even so, the aura around him is extremely potent.
"What happened?" Kent asked in a cold tone, causing Kaizo and the rest to feel his anger.
Unity walked toward him with no fear in her eyes. When she got close, she hugged him, which helped calm him down a bit.
The people involved were now dead, and so they could only bide their time until they got to where their employers were and made them pay.
So for now, there was no need to invoke such a powerful and angry reaction.
Unity led Kent to sit down first before Kaizo explained what had happened to him. By the time he was done, Kent was bubbling with anger.
He was angry that he had no idea his wives and legion came this close to death—well, some actually died.
He was angry that the connection he shared with them became useless just when they actually needed help.
Although Gaia had told him the connection was not absolute, that there were things out there that could render it useless, Kent never expected it to happen this early in their journey.
He was angry that his stalkers got to his wives and legion instead of him. In a way, he blamed himself for what happened.
If nobody knew he had arrived in the high world, nobody would have chased after his legion and nearly wiped them out all in the name of flushing him out.

However, even if that were the only case, he knew for a fact that one of these days, his name would spread and the danger would come, so perhaps getting a warm welcome and an idea of what to expect was also beneficial.
But since it came at the expense of losing seven undead and nearly losing his wives, with Alina even in a coma and not knowing when she would wake up, it sure left a bitter taste in his mouth.
"So Uncle Drew came to our rescue, and he even killed the fourteen, leaving only one alive for us to interrogate. The bastard is in the Tower Prison," Kaizo said, and Kent nodded.
Hearing Uncle Drew was back made him happy. At least he saved them and was finally back among the living.

"I am sorry, master. If I hadn’t insisted we hunt down those involved in the attack against the Elves, none of this would have happened. I deserve to be punished." Kaizo sure felt more guilty than everyone else.
It was his idea, after all. So while his warrior spirit still remained strong, he had been feeling guilty ever since he woke up.
In his heart, he nearly got his friends and his master’s wives killed.

Kent patted him on the shoulder and said, "It is not your fault, Kaizo. It was a setback for sure, but at least we now know that the people after me have no good intentions, so next time, we will also show no mercy.
"Until we start killing them in masses, will they learn to back off? So heal for now. I will resurrect the others, and once everyone is up, use the dungeon to strengthen yourselves.
"Rest assured that we will get our revenge, and it will be bloody."
Kaizo nodded and responded with the enthusiasm everyone knew he had. "I will be ready for battle when it comes, master."
Kent nodded and walked into the building, where the healing chambers were located. It was Gaia’s idea to build them since she wanted to remain ahead of the chaos.
Thankfully, it came in handy now.
Seeing his wives and legion sleeping in the glass chambers, he could only sigh. For now, he couldn’t storm the Immortal World and demand revenge.
That would be suicide.
So he would bid his time, grow stronger, ascend, and get his revenge.
’Tower, add this to my revenge list’
⟦List updated⟧
"Don’t worry, Kent, they will be fine. Once Elaine wakes up, she will speed up their healing. So for now, go handle your training; we will be fine."
Kent hesitated, but he nodded.
"Oh, you also have some visitors. Big sister is spending time with them in the city, so when you are done, go talk to them."
Kent nodded.
"How about Uncle Drew?"
"He left the tower to go look for some herbs Alina needed to heal her soul. Knowing you were in seclusion, he decided to handle it."
"I see."
Kent thought for a moment and then planted a kiss on Unity’s forehead before teleporting away. He appeared inside the Mountain Garden, where Vexthra was having tea with two ladies.
The moment his eyes landed on them, a smile appeared on his face.
"Big brother!"
Yuna practically jumped into his embrace when her eyes landed on Kent. Purity maintained her dignity and only took a sip of her tea before walking toward Kent.
Kent’s brow furrowed when he discovered Purity’s true nature.

chapters.title: Chapter 1147: Catching Up with Yuna and Purity
paragraphs: Kent clearly didn’t expect to see Yuna and her Primordial Flame Spirit standing before him.
Well, Yuna was clinging to him like a koala bear while Purity stood in front of him smiling.
This sight warmed his heart. He had just learned that his wives and legion came this close to death, filling his heart with anger and pain.
If the people who dared hurt them were ordinary folks in a high world, he would have long stormed there and killed everyone involved.
Thankfully, things were much more complex, so for now, he would hold on to his anger and wait for when he got his hands on them.
So now, meeting Yuna and Purity, his anger had calmed down considerably.
"What are you ladies doing here?" Kent asked, a mix of happiness and fear.
He knew coming to a high world was risky. Even an Immortal Lord could easily die since down here they lacked the immortal soul, body, and strength.

They would be regressed to mortals, leaving them vulnerable and extremely weak. So the two ladies whom he knew deep in his heart were as harmless as they come, most certainly would be prey for the picking.
Back in the Immortal World, Yuna and Purity rode on the fame and strength of Pill Immortal Nefeli to cause trouble and get away with it.
They had messed with countless immortals to the point that they wanted them dead. However, thanks to Nefeli, nobody dared touch them.
However, the moment they stepped out of the Immortal World, they ran the risk of dying. This scared Kent.
"Yuna and Purity miss Big Brother, and so they came looking for him. Is Big Brother not happy to see us again?" Yuna asked with a sad expression.
"No, I am happy seeing you two well and grown up. I miss you both." Kent would be lying if he said he wasn’t happy to meet two of the people he met 370,000 years ago.
"Then why is Big Brother not smiling?"
Kent was forced to smile. This made Yuna very happy.
Vexthra smiled, watching this interaction. He most certainly knew Kent had finally met someone who could pull his strings like Li Hua used to do.
Now that Li Hua was busy training to become an assassin, she had no time to pull Kent’s strings, so Yuna would fill that role perfectly.
Kent spread his other arm for Purity, too, to come for a hug. She was part of Yuna, so in a way, they were the same person yet completely different.
"Let’s sit down first."

Kent walked toward the table Vexthra was sitting at and sat down. Yuna and Purity pulled their chairs close to Kent and sat on either side, making sure a part of their body was touching his.𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
Kent could only smile inwardly and turn to Vexthra.
"How have you been?"
"I am fine, Kent. I am a goddess, so nothing can happen to me."
"I know, but there is no harm in asking, I guess."
Vexthra smiled, and so did Kent. After checking up on her, he turned to Yuna. "What about you two? How have you been treating yourselves?"
"We miss Big Brother. It has been many years since we last saw you. You said you would only be gone for a while, but Purity said many centuries had passed already."
Purity nodded.
Kent shook his head. To him, a while was a few months. But to them, it had already been 370,000 years. That was a long time for someone who wanted to spend time with her big brother.
"Sorry, ladies, I was held up by something."
"It is okay, Big Brother. Now that we are here, we are okay. No need to feel sad."
Kent nodded.
"How is your big sister?"
Yuna sighed and answered, "Big sister left a couple of months ago for a distant place I have no idea about. It seems it has something to do with your name appearing on the Sword Dao Tablet."
"Is she in any danger?"
"No. Big sister is a sword immortal; unless anyone is stupid, then coming against her is their own downfall."
Kent smiled. "So she has revealed her true nature, huh?"
"Yes. Big sister is feared by many. All those who came after her died in the most painful way possible. They all fear her, and so they would be stupid if they dared come against her on her travels."
"Good to hear that." Kent seemed pleased to hear Nefeli was fine. He had already suspected her to be much more dangerous, but he never expected to hear that immortals feared her.
’I guess I underestimated her too much back then,’ he thought
"How about the others?" Since Nefeli was fine, he then wanted to find out about the others.
"Big sister parted ways with the others many years back; however, she has been in contact with them. The last I heard, Big sister Sylvara had returned home since her mother had become a god.

Also, Big sister Veth and Lady Wu have become big shots in the immortal worlds. They are both influential and extremely rich. Purity and I tried to go see them many times, but Big sister didn’t allow us.

As for Big sister Flura, she is now a Pill Immortal who is making waves in the Pill World. I learned she is having her fair share of troubles, but Big sister Ursa is protecting her, so nothing to worry about there."
"As for the others, I have no idea how they are doing."
"Thank you, Yuna. I will go see them when I find a way to get to the Immortal World. For now, you must stay here and don’t go out."
"Don’t worry, Big Brother. We have no plans to go anywhere," Purity said with a smile. "This place is amazing, and since you are here, we will spend as much time as we can with you."
Kent nodded and turned to Vexthra. "Take care of them for me. I still have some things to handle, so I will be gone for a while."

Vexthra nodded with a calm smile. "Don’t worry. I will make sure everything is handled. And you shouldn’t be worried about my sisters and the legion. Uncle Drew is out there looking for ways to save them."
Kent nodded and then turned to Yuna and Purity. "Spend time with Big sister Vexthra for now while I handle some personal business. I promise I will spend some time with you once I am done."
Now that they are with their big brother, there is no way they would mind if he left for another hundred thousand years. As long as they are within his domain, they are fine.
"We will wait for you, Big Brother. And once Big Brother Uncle Drew brings the herbs, we will concoct Tier 18 pills for everyone." Yuna looked at Kent with a smug expression.
"In case Big Brother is not aware, I am a Pill Divine, just one step away from becoming a Pill Immortal."
Kent just smiled, already aware of Yuna’s true nature. As a Divine Pill Body, she was only destined to become a good alchemist. So hearing she had become a Pill Divine didn’t come as a shock to him.
"I will be counting on you then to give me some pointers when I am out of seclusion."
Yuna puffed her chest and replied, "Big Brother shouldn’t worry. I will help Big Brother."
Kent nodded, and then, after a few minutes of catching up, he left to continue his training. However, before he got to it, he had to resurrect his undead warriors.

Thankfully, things were much more complex, so for now, he would hold on to his anger and wait for when he got his hands on them.
So now, meeting Yuna and Purity, his anger had calmed down considerably.
"What are you ladies doing here?" Kent asked, a mix of happiness and fear.
He knew coming to a high world was risky.
Even an Immortal Lord could easily die since down here they lacked the immortal soul, body, and strength.
They would be regressed to mortals, leaving them vulnerable and extremely weak.
So the two ladies whom he knew deep in his heart were as harmless as they come, most certainly would be prey for the picking.
Back in the Immortal World, Yuna and Purity rode on the fame and strength of Pill Immortal Nefeli to cause trouble and get away with it.
They had messed with countless immortals to the point that they wanted them dead.
However, thanks to Nefeli, nobody dared touch them.
However, the moment they stepped out of the Immortal World, they ran the risk of dying.
This scared Kent.
"Yuna and Purity miss Big Brother, and so they came looking for him.
Is Big Brother not happy to see us again?" Yuna asked with a sad expression.
"No, I am happy seeing you two well and grown up.
I miss you both." Kent would be lying if he said he wasn’t happy to meet two of the people he met 370,000 years ago.
"Then why is Big Brother not smiling?"
Kent was forced to smile.
This made Yuna very happy.
Vexthra smiled, watching this interaction.
He most certainly knew Kent had finally met someone who could pull his strings like Li Hua used to do.
Now that Li Hua was busy training to become an assassin, she had no time to pull Kent’s strings, so Yuna would fill that role perfectly.
Kent spread his other arm for Purity, too, to come for a hug.
She was part of Yuna, so in a way, they were the same person yet completely different.
"Let’s sit down first."
Kent walked toward the table Vexthra was sitting at and sat down.
Yuna and Purity pulled their chairs close to Kent and sat on either side, making sure a part of their body was touching his.𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
Kent could only smile inwardly and turn to Vexthra.
"How have you been?"
"I am fine, Kent.
I am a goddess, so nothing can happen to me."
"I know, but there is no harm in asking, I guess."
Vexthra smiled, and so did Kent.
After checking up on her, he turned to Yuna.
"What about you two?
How have you been treating yourselves?"
"We miss Big Brother.
It has been many years since we last saw you.
You said you would only be gone for a while, but Purity said many centuries had passed already."
Purity nodded.
Kent shook his head.
To him, a while was a few months.
But to them, it had already been 370,000 years.
That was a long time for someone who wanted to spend time with her big brother.
"Sorry, ladies, I was held up by something."
"It is okay, Big Brother.
Now that we are here, we are okay.
No need to feel sad."
Kent nodded.
"How is your big sister?"
Yuna sighed and answered, "Big sister left a couple of months ago for a distant place I have no idea about.
It seems it has something to do with your name appearing on the Sword Dao Tablet."
"Is she in any danger?"
"No.
Big sister is a sword immortal; unless anyone is stupid, then coming against her is their own downfall."
Kent smiled.
"So she has revealed her true nature, huh?"
"Yes.
Big sister is feared by many.
All those who came after her died in the most painful way possible.
They all fear her, and so they would be stupid if they dared come against her on her travels."
"Good to hear that." Kent seemed pleased to hear Nefeli was fine.
He had already suspected her to be much more dangerous, but he never expected to hear that immortals feared her.
’I guess I underestimated her too much back then,’ he thought
"How about the others?" Since Nefeli was fine, he then wanted to find out about the others.
"Big sister parted ways with the others many years back; however, she has been in contact with them.
The last I heard, Big sister Sylvara had returned home since her mother had become a god.
Also, Big sister Veth and Lady Wu have become big shots in the immortal worlds.
They are both influential and extremely rich.
Purity and I tried to go see them many times, but Big sister didn’t allow us.
As for Big sister Flura, she is now a Pill Immortal who is making waves in the Pill World.
I learned she is having her fair share of troubles, but Big sister Ursa is protecting her, so nothing to worry about there."
"As for the others, I have no idea how they are doing."
"Thank you, Yuna.
I will go see them when I find a way to get to the Immortal World.
For now, you must stay here and don’t go out."
"Don’t worry, Big Brother.
We have no plans to go anywhere," Purity said with a smile.
"This place is amazing, and since you are here, we will spend as much time as we can with you."
Kent nodded and turned to Vexthra.
"Take care of them for me.
I still have some things to handle, so I will be gone for a while."
Vexthra nodded with a calm smile.
"Don’t worry.
I will make sure everything is handled.
And you shouldn’t be worried about my sisters and the legion.
Uncle Drew is out there looking for ways to save them."
Kent nodded and then turned to Yuna and Purity.
"Spend time with Big sister Vexthra for now while I handle some personal business.
I promise I will spend some time with you once I am done."
Now that they are with their big brother, there is no way they would mind if he left for another hundred thousand years.
As long as they are within his domain, they are fine.
"We will wait for you, Big Brother.
And once Big Brother Uncle Drew brings the herbs, we will concoct Tier 18 pills for everyone." Yuna looked at Kent with a smug expression.
"In case Big Brother is not aware, I am a Pill Divine, just one step away from becoming a Pill Immortal."
Kent just smiled, already aware of Yuna’s true nature.
As a Divine Pill Body, she was only destined to become a good alchemist.
So hearing she had become a Pill Divine didn’t come as a shock to him.
"I will be counting on you then to give me some pointers when I am out of seclusion."
Yuna puffed her chest and replied, "Big Brother shouldn’t worry.
I will help Big Brother."
Kent nodded, and then, after a few minutes of catching up, he left to continue his training.
However, before he got to it, he had to resurrect his undead warriors.

chapters.title: Chapter 1148: Undead Resurrection
paragraphs: After leaving the mountain garden, Kent first went to the Legion Tower and entered the Necro Forge, where he would be resurrecting his seven undead.
As expected, the moment he appeared in the workspace, he found seven cocoons hovering in the air.
This sight caused his anger to rise again. However, he calmed himself down and focused on handling the resurrection ritual of his seven undead.
"We will get our revenge one day," Kent muttered before sitting in a lotus posture.
The process is very simple.
Since the body and essence of the undead always return to the Necro Forge after they die, Kent would just have to reconnect them to the forge and let their essence merge with their bodies.
They are undead, so their undead souls are basically their essence. Of course, the more frequently they die, the longer it will take to resurrect them.
However, as long as Kent is alive, then no matter how long it takes, as long as he breathes, his undead will never die. In fact, Kent’s life is their life, and so death has no hold on them.
The downside, however, is that whenever he resurrects them, Kent will feel his energy drained. Of course, the longer it took to resurrect them, the more it took.

For now, he can handle a couple of years, perhaps a decade for all of them. But if he doesn’t level up much faster, one of these days, if his undead keep dying, he will be forced to wake them one at a time.
Thankfully, he is much stronger now, so resurrecting all seven of them is within his capacity.

He took a deep breath and formed a hand seal, and at once, the forge came to life. The cocoons that had been hovering idle in the air began to glow as threads of energy emanated from the forge and latched onto them.
The moment this happened, Kent saw runes appearing on all seven cocoons.
These runes will help their essence merge back with their bodies. Of course, it will take some time, but now that the forge has been activated, the process will begin promptly.
⟦The resurrection ritual had begun. Duration: 2 years (Tower Time)⟧
"Good. With this, they will wake up with their strength and memories intact."
Kent became happy that the process had finally begun, and there is even a timeframe for when it will end. This means he can finally have a breather and get back to his training.
Kent stood up and issued an order to the tower.
"In case I am not available when they wake up, release them into the Legion Tower."
⟦I will do as the master commands⟧
Kent nodded and soon left the Necro Forge. A few seconds after he left, Gaia, Akira, and Dori appeared inside with smiles on their faces.
"Mission is a go, sisters. Let’s start the modifications."

The three troublemakers started tinkering with the seven cocoons. Nobody knows what they are doing, but given their character and track record, the seven undead will wake up in a much different state compared to how they were before they died.
Kent, who had no idea what his three assistants were up to, arrived in the Sword Tower and immediately sat in a lotus posture to think of the order in which he would be moving.
He has several tasks to manage, and so he wants to have a roadmap before he starts.
After a few minutes, he seemed to have finalized his plans.
He will first handle Lord Genesis’ memories, as he still has four memory keys to review his life back when he was Jest, the greatest swordsman to have ever lived.

The last time he retrieved those memories, he had just traveled from Fire City, a continent dominated by Flame Humans in the world of Eryndor, to Valyrion, a place said to be home to the best swordsmen in the immortal world.
Naturally, Jest wanted to train and expand his knowledge of swordsmanship, so he traveled there. The ship he boarded landed in a city called Shengdao.

It turned out that, in this city, there was an old rule that all those who wished to be challenged should have their swords out. Jest had no idea there was a rule like this, so he entered the city like the carefree human he was.
It turned out to be a huge mistake. A swordwoman called Seraphina, the Moonlit Dancer, challenged him, and when Jest declined, she started chasing him to kill him.
Kent now wanted to know what happened next. He is a sword King while his opponent is a sword emperor.
After that is done, Kent planned to refine the two Blood Life Seals and the two Blood Death Seals he received after killing the Planet King.
He is much stronger now, but he aspires to be even stronger.
What had just happened to his undead was a clear sign that he might be strong, but he was not invincible.

Then, once the issue with the four seals was resolved, he would have his first Blood Cleansing bath, where he would submerge his body in a pool of blood and employ a special technique to temper his body.
It may sound simple, but it is a very dangerous thing, something that could easily send him into a complete frenzy and cause him to literally lose his mind due to bloodlust.
However, if he managed to complete it, he would not only become much more dangerous, but his killing intent would become so much more potent.
In fact, if he managed to refine both Blood Death Seals and have his Blood Cleansing bath, his killing intent could rival even immortals.

Then, once that was handled, he would try his chances with the Claw Art and see if he could learn the first form. The last time he tried, he nearly died. So now, he wanted to be ready before trying again.
Once that was also handled, he would focus on creating the flame technique, then he would concoct a Tier 9 pill with a grey pill ring to become a Pill Sage.
Becoming a Pill King would be handled while on the road to find Elina.
Hopefully, by then, he would also become a Sword King.
As for the three memory keys for Faceless Assassin, he would handle them later...
Kent had a lot to handle; however, thanks to the tower time, he knew he would be able to tackle everything before time ran out.
Of course, he still had the second form of the Bone Tempering Art to cultivate; however, since he had yet to awaken all Blood Runes, he was not rushing that yet.
But just out of curiosity, he checked his progress.
"According to the details of the second form of the Bone Tempering Art, the maximum number of blood runes required to form a Blood Tattoo is 120.
However, seeing that I have the potential to awaken 500,000 plus Blood Runes, I should force and push the maximum number of seals to at least 300.
This way, my Blood Tattoos will be super powerful. I cannot measure my nature to the ordinary folk."
Kent smiled, knowing that if the Slaughter King heard him call him ordinary folk, he would be pissed.
"More to do and less time to do it. Elina is waiting for me, so I must hurry." Kent retrieved the first memory key for Lord Genesis’ memories and used it.
The next second, Kent felt a sharp sword move past his neck, leaving a mark.

chapters.title: Chapter 1149: Determined To Kill
paragraphs: Blood slowly trails down Jest’s neck as he moves back, creating a distance between him and a certain beauty who is determined to kill him.
She unleashes three sword slashes, sending crescent-shaped sword arcs at Jest.
He evaded and then, using a sleek movement technique. He further created a distance between them, ensuring the crazy woman didn’t make his life difficult.
"Transcendent Sword Art."
Jest activated the sword technique he had learned in the Sword Valley. It was the same technique that enabled him to open a portal to the Immortal World.
This technique was once used by a Sword Immortal during the primordial Era. So it is very powerful.
Ten swords appeared in the air and locked on the lady, causing her to frown and quickly raise a shield. Jest showed no mercy and unleashed the ten swords at once, slamming into the shield she raised.
"Endless Sword Arc." Jest didn’t hold back; he unleashed yet another sword attack, causing thousands of tiny sword arcs to appear in the air and rain down on the lady.
Her shield, which held firm against the ten swords, was shredded by the sword arcs, causing her face to pale.
"Impossible!"
She teleported back, but not before sustaining a few injuries on her arm and chest. However, distancing herself works in Jest’s favour.
He took a deep breath and retrieved a talisman from his space ring, activating it. At once, a large sword appeared in the air and locked onto the lady.
This time, the paleness on her face changed as fear gripped her. This is the first time Jest has used this technique in their many battles.
Her scalp went numb.
"I surrender!" she shouted, dropping her sword on the ground and raising her hand.
In swordsmanship, whenever the opponent drops their weapon, it means they have surrendered, and thus, you cannot attack.
However, Jest, who had suffered for months, narrowly evading death a few times, had finally had enough, so he attacked.
The lady, who knew she had no way to defend against the sword, closed her eyes as tears fell from them.
She clearly didn’t expect Jest to learn from his mistakes and finally figured out a way to kill her.
"DIE!"
Jest didn’t care about her tears and even exerted more of his strength, causing the sword to move even faster.
The quicker he kills the lady who has made his life miserable since he arrived in the Immortal World, the better.
However, just when the sword was a meter out, a medallion hanging on the lady’s waist glowed, and a striking beauty with flowing green hair appeared behind her and formed a shield around her.
Naturally, the new arrival was just a projection of a person, not a real one. However, she possessed the power to easily defend against the sword, bringing it to a complete stop.
Jest frowned when his sword was stopped.
However, a new talisman appeared in his hand, and he was about to activate it when the green-haired lady spoke.
"Young man, I think since she surrendered, spare her life."
Jest’s frown deepened when he heard her words. "So now that her life is in danger, I should spare her, huh? When she was chasing me like a criminal, nearly killing me a few times, where were you?"
The green-haired lady frowned; however, her body flickered the next second, showing she was losing her power.
Seeing this, Jest activated the talisman, causing another sword to appear in the air.
Then he waved his hand, and three more talismans appeared. When the green-haired lady saw this, she shuddered.𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
She could defend against one, maybe two, but three or four—she would be powerless, meaning Jest would get to kill the lady.
Seeing this, the lady swallowed her pride, and without Jest even knowing, an Immortal Lord went down on one knee.
"I am begging you, please, don’t kill her." Even the dark-haired lady seemed surprised to see the green-haired lady kneel down before a mere mortal.
A guilty expression appeared in her eyes.
Jest ignored her and focused on the green-haired lady.

"Why should I spare her? She was the one who wouldn’t listen to reason and tried to kill me more than a hundred times just because I wouldn’t accept her challenge. Now I did, and I have every right to determine her fate."
"I can assure you that killing her is the last thing you want. Trust me, she is not someone you can kill and get away with it.
However, since I am asking a favour, I am willing to compensate you for any trouble you may incur. Name anything you want, and I will grant it."
Jest took a deep breath, then paused for a moment to analyze his situation. He had just arrived in this world, and he knew nothing about it, so making unnecessary enemies was not something he wanted.
However, looking at the dark-haired lady and recalling the trouble she had put him through, the urge to kill her filled his mind.
But Jest was smart, and so he made a decision.
He deactivated the sword in the air and put away the talismans. Then he put away his sword. "The next time she points her weapon at me, even if she is the daughter of a god, I will kill her."
With that, Jest turned around and left, leaving both the green-haired and the dark-haired ladies stunned and in shock.
Jest was just offered a chance to ask for anything he wanted. But instead of using it to ask for wealth or many things, he used it to make a promise and left.
The green-haired lady was in shock, but she had little time to ponder it since her time was running out.
"Come back home, Seraphina. The others are back, so it is time for the unification ritual."

After saying that, her body flickered out of existence, and she vanished. The dark-haired lady, whose name was Seraphina, stayed behind for an hour before she managed to gather the strength and also left.
Jest, who had traveled thousands of miles, found a cave to relax and ponder his next move.
When he arrived in Shengdao City, Seraphina challenged him to a sword duel, but he refused. He had no idea that it was a serious crime in Shengdao City.
Soon, however, he learned it the hard way.
Seraphina started hunting him down, chasing after him from city to city, forest to forest, attacking him whenever she had the chance.
Jest, who had never gone through such a kind of torture, was forced to go on the run while learning from every encounter until finally, after surviving hundreds of battles, he managed to defeat her.
But then, just when he had the chance to kill her, someone much stronger came to her aid. Naturally, Jest knew he was no match for this person.

However, to save his skin, he had to be tough, so using the importance of Seraphina to the green-haired lady, he played the right cards, managing to pull out her true intention, which was to protect Seraphina at all costs.
However, just when she was out of options, Jest chose to walk away. This move, however, was to ensure he owed the lady nothing.
He just wanted to make her know that as long as he wasn’t bothered, he too would not bother them.
If he had requested something from her, she would have had a reason to either find a way to kill him and get it back or even be able to track him.
Jest had just arrived in an Immortal World, so he was paranoid and now extremely cautious.
A deep sigh escaped his lips as he closed his eyes to review the 127 battles he fought with Seraphina. A few seconds into it, he gained enlightenment.

Seeing this, the lady swallowed her pride, and without Jest even knowing, an Immortal Lord went down on one knee.
"I am begging you, please, don’t kill her." Even the dark-haired lady seemed surprised to see the green-haired lady kneel down before a mere mortal.
A guilty expression appeared in her eyes.
Jest ignored her and focused on the green-haired lady.
"Why should I spare her?
She was the one who wouldn’t listen to reason and tried to kill me more than a hundred times just because I wouldn’t accept her challenge.
Now I did, and I have every right to determine her fate."
"I can assure you that killing her is the last thing you want.
Trust me, she is not someone you can kill and get away with it.
However, since I am asking a favour, I am willing to compensate you for any trouble you may incur.
Name anything you want, and I will grant it."
Jest took a deep breath, then paused for a moment to analyze his situation.
He had just arrived in this world, and he knew nothing about it, so making unnecessary enemies was not something he wanted.
However, looking at the dark-haired lady and recalling the trouble she had put him through, the urge to kill her filled his mind.
But Jest was smart, and so he made a decision.
He deactivated the sword in the air and put away the talismans.
Then he put away his sword.
"The next time she points her weapon at me, even if she is the daughter of a god, I will kill her."
With that, Jest turned around and left, leaving both the green-haired and the dark-haired ladies stunned and in shock.
Jest was just offered a chance to ask for anything he wanted.
But instead of using it to ask for wealth or many things, he used it to make a promise and left.
The green-haired lady was in shock, but she had little time to ponder it since her time was running out.
"Come back home, Seraphina.
The others are back, so it is time for the unification ritual."
After saying that, her body flickered out of existence, and she vanished.
The dark-haired lady, whose name was Seraphina, stayed behind for an hour before she managed to gather the strength and also left.
Jest, who had traveled thousands of miles, found a cave to relax and ponder his next move.
When he arrived in Shengdao City, Seraphina challenged him to a sword duel, but he refused.
He had no idea that it was a serious crime in Shengdao City.
Soon, however, he learned it the hard way.
Seraphina started hunting him down, chasing after him from city to city, forest to forest, attacking him whenever she had the chance.
Jest, who had never gone through such a kind of torture, was forced to go on the run while learning from every encounter until finally, after surviving hundreds of battles, he managed to defeat her.
But then, just when he had the chance to kill her, someone much stronger came to her aid.
Naturally, Jest knew he was no match for this person.

However, to save his skin, he had to be tough, so using the importance of Seraphina to the green-haired lady, he played the right cards, managing to pull out her true intention, which was to protect Seraphina at all costs.
However, just when she was out of options, Jest chose to walk away.
This move, however, was to ensure he owed the lady nothing.
He just wanted to make her know that as long as he wasn’t bothered, he too would not bother them.
If he had requested something from her, she would have had a reason to either find a way to kill him and get it back or even be able to track him.
Jest had just arrived in an Immortal World, so he was paranoid and now extremely cautious.
A deep sigh escaped his lips as he closed his eyes to review the 127 battles he fought with Seraphina.
A few seconds into it, he gained enlightenment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1150: Ten Emotions Sword Dao
paragraphs: [Whispering Wind Sword Sect - Core Area]
Inside an immortal cave where the spiritual qi in the air was extremely potent, sat a green-haired lady who, at first glance, was clearly dangerous.
Although she looked beautiful and calm, the air around her was extremely sharp, filled with so much sword intent.
She is clearly the epitome of lethal beauty.

Naturally, even without the aura of an Immortal Lord, she could still kill an ordinary Immortal Lord. After all, her strength and killing intent were far more dangerous than those of an ordinary immortal.
Suddenly, she opened her eyes, and a wave of sword intent exploded out of her body, filling the air with so much killing intent.

If someone below the Sword Immortal stage were to be within a 30-mile radius of this immortal cave, not even their bones would have remained, considering the sword aura in the air was already enough to shred them down to the last atom.
The moment she opened her eyes, an image of a certain youngster appeared in her mind, causing her expression to turn dark.
"A mere mortal dares threaten me," she muttered coldly, causing the air to freeze. Suddenly, a pale smile appeared on her face, "How bold."

She looked into her space ring and pulled out a communication jade tablet. Channeling her energy into it, she spoke a few words, and a moment later, a white-bearded man and a much older woman entered the cave.
"Greetings, Sect Leader... Are you coming out of seclusion?" the white-bearded man asked, bowing to the beautiful, green-haired lady.
"Not yet. I have yet to merge back with my Dao bodies, so, for many reasons, I will remain in seclusion for another thousand years."
The old man and woman looked at each other and nodded in unison. The old lady then asked, "Since the Sect Leader has summoned us, it means she needs something."
The green-haired lady nodded, "I do need something. I would like you to dispatch some disciples to track down a certain swordsman for me.
I don’t know his name, but he is not older than 4,000 years. He has a youthful appearance, deep brown eyes, short dark hair, and is very handsome.
He walks around holding a brown and rusty sword sheath. The hilt of his sword is made from black leather. He is only at the Heavenly Ascension stage and is a Sword King.
However, he is close to the Sword Emperor stage, and even his cultivation is close to the Empyrean stage.
Once you find him, come and alert me. Do not engage him."
The old man and woman nodded, a little surprised their Sect Leader would have this much interest in a mere Sword King, even going as far as noting down every last detail about him.
This wasn’t like the woman they knew.
The sect leader they knew is ruthless and cunning. She didn’t raise the Whispering Wind sword sect to the top sect in their star system by being soft.
She had lived for a hundred thousand years already, but never once had she shown any interest in anyone, not even demigods and gods.
So this came as a shock to them.
However, they nodded, knowing this was important to their Sect Leader. "We will get right on it, Sect Leader."
She nodded, and they left. After they were gone, a vicious light flashed across her eyes.
"I have been cultivating the Ten Emotions Sword Dao for thousands of years. I have faced many experts and fought with many of them, yet this is the first time I have met someone who could defeat me.
This person is not simple; I must either win him over or eliminate him. My Ten Emotions Sword Dao cannot meet a setback, not when I am close to unification."
She muttered coldly.
Suddenly, ten ladies, each a beauty in her own right, walked into the cave. They all had the aura of True Immortals and the sword intent of Sword Immortals.
One of them was Seraphina, the lady who fought with Jest.
Of course, during their battle, she was an Empyrean and a Sword Emperor, but now, it seemed her true cultivation base had been revealed, considering she was now facing an immortal.
The rules of the heavens could not allow a part of the Sword Dao to roam without measures in place to keep it in check.
All ten ladies were the Ten Emotions cultivated by Lady Seraphina, the Sect Leader of the Whispering Wind Sword Sect, one of the best in the immortal worlds.
To cultivate the Ten Emotions, she had to send them out into the world to gain experience.
They had been out there for years, but now that she had met someone who had caught her interest, she called them back to merge and complete her Sword Domain (Concept).
Once that was done, she would be ready to become a demigod and pursue godhood.
But first, she must get her hands on Jest...
Months passed, and Jest still remained in his enlightened state, unaware that there were thousands of people searching for him.
The lady he came this close to killing was actually the Emotion of Arrogance of a certain Sword Immortal, and so, now, she wanted him found.
Thankfully, Jest didn’t take anything from her, or else by now he would have been found.
Thanks to his intelligence, he was able to keep himself hidden for the time being.
A year later, Jest opened his eyes, causing a wave of sword intent to pour out of his body. Jest’s eyes turned cold as he slowly pulled his sword out of the sheath.
If one paid close attention, they would see a hint of something much more deadly in both his eyes and around his sword.

"Sword Realm Manifestation," he muttered, then a frown appeared on his face. "How is this even possible? I haven’t formed my Sword Realm yet, so how can there be a hint of its manifestation on my sword?"
The reason he gained enlightenment was thanks to Seraphina.
Jest had always tried to understand every new thing he saw and make sense of how they worked. He fought 127 battles with Seraphina and lost 126 of them.
However, to many, he was a weakling who wouldn’t just accept death, but to Jest, it was an opportunity to learn.
He had experienced Seraphina’s Sword Realm several times, and as a result, he learned from it. Thanks to that, he gained enlightenment.
However, the problem was that, even after reaching the Sword King stage, Jest had yet to form his own Sword Realm.
While many had formed their Sword Realms and were now comprehending ways to make them domains and then create their concepts, Jest was still stuck.
It was one of the reasons why he came to the immortal world.
He wants to find a way to form a sword realm, considering he is walking his own sword path.
However, who would have thought that after gaining enlightenment from experiencing the same Sword Realm dozens of times, he would start manifesting Sword Realm energy on his sword?
Just out of curiosity, Jest decided to tap into the Sword Realm around his sword and unleash a powerful swing, sending out a sword arc.

A powerful sword arc flashed out, carving a crater through the land and splitting a mountain 40 miles away. In the air, a vicious cold energy that seemed to freeze everything in its wake filled the air.
"Damn, that is the Sword Realm of that vicious, arrogant lady."
Jest looked both shocked and happy.
He had just comprehended someone’s Sword Realm into a sword skill.
"This is not true, right?" He looked at his sword, and as expected, when he willed it, the same vicious and cold Sword Realm energy appeared around his sword.
"Damn..."
Jest took a deep breath, and then a determined look appeared on his face.
"If I can’t form my Sword Realm yet, then I must steal other people’s..."
